enemies.name: Abomination
enemies.desc: Defying all the laws of basic biology, this monstrosity of connected tissues and nervous dead ends displays the strength of the many body it is made of. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Amanita Obscura
enemies.desc: Purple fungus with white grains. Its flesh contains a paralyzing agent capable of halting respiratory functions in nearly every living creature. It moves slowly but with a rhythmic pattern, hinting at a form of sentience.

enemies.name: Ancient Ent
enemies.desc: Left undisturbed for millennia, this living tree grew to a massive size. Its body is covered in spikes, a mighty weapon along with its size to keep the forest safe against harmful intruders.

enemies.name: Arcane Assassin
enemies.desc: The Arcane Assassins were a special operation group under direct command of the Seer, Kasimir, employed across the realms to take out targets that aimed to deteriorate the fragile peace among the various factions. They wield magical daggers gifted by the Seer, whose origin is a mystery.

enemies.name: Archmage of Larox
enemies.desc: Extremely powerful and dangerous, Archmage is the title conferred upon the brightest mages in the city. They participate in the city's Higher Council, overseeing every major development.

enemies.name: Avatar of the Ancient
enemies.desc: A frail and feeble manifestation of an aspect of the Outer God. If the rituals were to be completed, it would bring dramatic and irreversible changes to life across the realms.

enemies.name: Banshee
enemies.desc: A terrifying breed of armored beasts that roam the Barren Wastelands. Due to their presence, this area was uninhabited since the beginning of recorder history, but fortunately they keep to their hunting grounds.

enemies.name: Beholder
enemies.desc: Extremely smart but evil creatures only found in the depth of the earth, beholder will smite their opponents with their eldritch powers.

enemies.name: Berserker
enemies.desc: An ancient warrior armed with twin mithril axes, his fury intensifies with every blow he endures, turning him into an unstoppable force as the battle rages on.

enemies.name: Bleak Deacon
enemies.desc: A corrupted bishop of an eldritch deity, wielding a grotesque form of magic gifted by their malevolent god. This power can heal extraordinary wounds but exacts a terrible price.

enemies.name: Bleak Disciple
enemies.desc: This humanoid of unknown origin, warped beyond recognition, has dwelled beneath these caverns for millennia. It toils ceaselessly to bring its long-forgotten god back into existence.

enemies.name: Boar
enemies.desc: Wild boars are omnivorous animals commonly found in the forest. They can be hard to kill due to their thick skin.

enemies.name: Celestial Destroyer
enemies.desc: Only a handful of these flying fortresses are sent with the first wave to limit the risks associated with their loss, but as the campaign advances they slowly cover the target world's surface to assist the ground troops in the eradication of any form of life present.

enemies.name: Celestial Lancer
enemies.desc: The backbone of the Celestial Army. These fearless soldiers push through foreign worlds animated by unwavering loyalty, counting on a supernatural agility despite their large size.

enemies.name: Centaur
enemies.desc: Half men and half horses, these magical creatures are skilled hunters that used to live in harmony within the forest.

enemies.name: Cerebrum
enemies.desc: A sentient brain encased in nearly indestructible glass. It cannot move, but can manipulate the surrounding world in other ways.

enemies.name: Chief Scientist Ava
enemies.desc: A pale girl draped in a grimy white coat. Her modest appearance betrays the enormous knowledge she possesses.

enemies.name: City Warden
enemies.desc: A law enforcement unit operating in the Capital. They are not part of the Imperial Army, and their responsibility is to maintain order and catch criminals.

enemies.name: Foundress Ilsa
enemies.desc: One of the three cultist rebels. An extremely powerful mage, still couldn't manage to make the Primordial corruption-proof.

enemies.name: Crusader
enemies.desc:
A member of one of the many crusades from the eastern cities to eradicate the evil that has been abducting their citizen. They wander the halls aimlessly, having lost their ego over time to the magical influences.
People from these lands seem to naturally display psyonic capabilities, and could present a formidable menace in large numbers.

enemies.name: Death Hound
enemies.desc: A war hound employed by the Imperial Army, reanimated by the corruption after falling in battle. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Deckhand
enemies.desc: A capuchin colored monkey commonly found in the exotic Skull Island, home of the pirates. It has been trained to perform the lowliest duties of a pirate crew, like cleaning the decks and bringing the rum. It has also been trained in using the knife, and is a surprisingly strong adversary.

enemies.name: Djinn
enemies.desc: Powerful, benevolent desert spirit said to grand a wish to lucky travelers. After he became corrupt, he unleashes his wrath on every poor soul he crosses.

enemies.name: Dreamwrought Beast
enemies.desc: An incorporeal creature resembling a horse, with a single horn on its forehead.

enemies.name: Dreamwrought Dragon
enemies.desc: This majestic, incorporeal dragon flies in hypnotic, looping patterns before striking with fierce power.

enemies.name: Dreamwrought Forge
enemies.desc: A mysterious, incorporeal figure seated behind an arcane instrument. Unfazed by the surrounding chaos, it is fully focused on its task.

enemies.name: Dreamwrought Swarm
enemies.desc: An endless multitude of spectral, ravenous insects that tear their prey apart in seconds.

enemies.name: Dryad
enemies.desc: Elusive magical creature found in the southern woods. Its origin is unknown, but the travelers that spotted it before the corruption struck reported a timid but kind temperament.

enemies.name: Eldritch Hound
enemies.desc: These twisted, wolf-like creatures relentlessly hunt any creature that dares to approach the underground temple.

enemies.name: Electric Slime
enemies.desc: Electric charge flows through this slime body, threatening to shock anyone getting close enough.

enemies.name: The Crowned Regent
enemies.desc: Regent of the new dynasty, chosen to keep the throne warm until the heir came of age. The Eye above found him first.

enemies.name: Enforcer
enemies.desc: A warrior grotesquely altered through agonizing experiments, gifted with immense strength and a towering size.

enemies.name: Ent
enemies.desc: Ancient guardians of the forest, these massive trees possess enormous strength.

enemies.name: Ethereal Soul
enemies.desc:
A fallen soldier of the Imperial Army, died during the last ditch effort of the Empire to stop the treacherous Seer.

It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Fire Slime
enemies.desc: This slime is engulfed by flames, but it seems okay with this condition.

enemies.name: First Minister Atos
enemies.desc: A powerful figure in the Kaunian hierarchy, who gained terrible powers through the manipulation of its own body.

enemies.name: Elder Spirit
enemies.desc: The oldest spirit of the Elderwood. It still remembers the guild that once camped at the edge of its trees, and it does not trust the one that came after.

enemies.name: Frozen Slime
enemies.desc: An extremely cold slime. Maintained the jelly-like texture despite the frozen coating, somehow.

enemies.name: G.C.S.S.
enemies.desc: Gaussian Coil Security Station. Accelerates a giant metal projectile through a mysterious field, reaching incredible speeds and causing devastating damage upon impact. It's heavily armored, to sustain a prolonged assault.

enemies.name: Ghoul
enemies.desc: For unknown reasons, sometimes undead are animated by a strong urge to feed on other dead bodies. These creatures often develop a more feral appearance, with longer teeth and sharper nails, and after some time they lose all of their similarity with human beings. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Giant Moth
enemies.desc: Flies thanks to a magic powder that covers its wings. This powder is known to irritate the airways of many other creatures, including humans.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.desc: This kind of spider is usually found in much smaller sizes around the northern kingdoms. Left undisturbed for decades in the darkness of the Obsidian Mines, it reached the size of a grown man.

enemies.name: Giant Tortoise
enemies.desc: A huge tortoise weighting several tons, with a very hard shell covered in sharp spikes.

enemies.name: Golden Rabbit
enemies.desc: Old legends speak of the pet of a forest spirit in the form of a golden rabbit, but despite a few sighting its presence was never confirmed.

enemies.name: Green Spitfang
enemies.desc: Large snake found in the southern regions that hunts by hurling saliva at its enemies at tremendous speed.

enemies.name: Headless Knight
enemies.desc: This nightmarish knight radiates an evil that defies imagination. Its own burning head, brandished as a morning star, grins malevolently as it is hurled at its foes.

enemies.name: Herald Ysolde
enemies.desc: The true form of the Seer Ysolde. Unlike her predecessor, she does not intend to be devoured when the Graft breaks.

enemies.name: Herald Maya
enemies.desc: A powerful servant of the Black Serpent. Maintains the link through the Core, and will replace the Seer if its mission fail.

enemies.name: Ysolde, Unbound
enemies.desc: The last form of the Herald of the second cycle, fused with the machine at the planet's core. She has stopped asking her master for forgiveness.

enemies.name: Herald Xavi
enemies.desc: A powerful servant of the Black Serpent. Maintains the link through the Core, and will replace the Seer if its mission fail.

enemies.name: Ice Elemental
enemies.desc: A mysterious creature that takes the form of extremely cold, inanimate rocks arranged in strange patterns. It appears to have complete mastery over the ice around, manipulating it offensively to dissuade attackers.

enemies.name: Iconoclast
enemies.desc: Slaves to the Celestial Goddess, abducted from the worlds she destroyed. Their bodies are modified to allow them to live through raging flames, and their mission is to cleanse the lands designated for the Cleansing.

enemies.name: Imp
enemies.desc: A small, winged servant of the Wizards of Larox, summoned through magic and lacking any will of its own. It is typically used for simple tasks but can also assist in defending the city when needed.

enemies.name: Imperial Guard
enemies.desc: A member of a special division of the Imperial Army appointed to the defense of the Imperial Palace and the many decentralized Imperial institutions. They are experts at protecting vulnerable targets, and can be formidable opponents even in their unhinged state.

enemies.name: Imperial Mage
enemies.desc: Strategically crucial in every Imperial Army division, these highly trained mages conjure thunders above the enemy ranks, dealing substantial damage and disrupting their strategy.

enemies.name: Insane Citizen
enemies.desc: A citizen of the Empire Capital, who lived among luxury and wealth, never knowing any real hardship. The eye's appearance stole their sanity, and now they wander the streets in a feral state.

enemies.name: Insane Merchant
enemies.desc: Merchants from distant lands often stopped by in the Golden City to sell exotic goods. They pose no greater danger than a normal citizen, but may carry more valuable resources.

enemies.name: Insane Priest
enemies.desc: A priest of one of the many places of worship in the city, used to offer guidance to the poor and the miserables. His strong faith granted him healing powers, that remained even after the loss of his sanity.

enemies.name: Ka'Bar, the Rotten
enemies.desc: A powerful mage devoted to the forbidden arts who successfully completed the transformation into a lich. It remained well hidden into the catacombs for centuries, taking advantages of the large number of fallen soldiers to build a huge army. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Ysolde, the Seer
enemies.desc: Advisor to the new dynasty, praised for bringing peace after a thousand years of quiet. She is the Herald of the second cycle, and she has studied every mistake of the one before her.

enemies.name: King Aino
enemies.desc: The enormous shell of what was once a man. Wheter its current state is the result of external deception or its own hubris remains unknown.

enemies.name: Lazarus
enemies.desc: This elegant, charismatic man conceals a dreadful curse behind his blood red eyes.

enemies.name: Legate Varro
enemies.desc: Hadrian's successor at the head of the Celestial Army. He has read every report of the first Cleansing, and he brought ten times the ships.

enemies.name: Lesser Titan
enemies.desc: The result of a botched conjuring ritual. It possesses great strength, but it's existence is suffering.

enemies.name: Lost Miner
enemies.desc: Clad in a broken brass diving gear, barely producing any noise despite their limping gait, they can be rarely spotted in the obsidian mines. Their origins and purpose are unknown, but they appear to come from the lowest levels of the mine.

enemies.name: Magic Armor
enemies.desc: Armor crafted from a unique metal and brought to life through a blend of technology and magic. The city is teeming with these constructs, ever vigilant and prepared to fend off any potential invasion.

enemies.name: Mimic
enemies.desc: Not unlike a usual old, worn out chest filled with treasures (or spiderwebs), the Mimic true nature emerges when a poor soul tries to reach for its contents, often leaving more than they can retrieve. They are rarely found in the places under the control of the Skull Island pirates, and no one knows exactly what animates them.

enemies.name: Mysterious Tentacle
enemies.desc: Viscid, lined with suction cups, and with a tendency to sink random ships passing by. The only scarier thing than this tentacle is the creature it is attached to.

enemies.name: Necrobot
enemies.desc: A soldier resurrected not by magic but through unknown technology, bound to carry out the commands of its masters.

enemies.name: Necrolith
enemies.desc: A colossal bone construct animated by forbidden magic. Bones are calcified together, therefore it can't move, but it's surface is harder than the hardest stone.

enemies.name: Nexus Researcher
enemies.desc: Lacking any magical power themselves, they work together to complete the Nexus of Larox and to discover new types of spells.

enemies.name: Obsidian Golem
enemies.desc: Animated by unknown forces, this massive obsidian creature is impervious to any magic damage thanks to this element's properties. While hard to take down without a strategy, the massive size hinders it's offensive capabilities.

enemies.name: Oculus
enemies.desc: Flying organic-machine hybrid used to map terrain, find enemy locations and generally gathering information on the battlefield. Equipped with a small but powerful magic cannon that allows, through unknown technology, to replicate a destructive spell usually casted by mages through their rituals.

enemies.name: Pale Hermit
enemies.desc: Lurking in the depths of the Obsidian Mines, this ancient horror made the original miners flee for their lives when it was mistakenly awaken. It strikes from the dark, leaving no chance to the unaware explorer.

enemies.name: Phantasm
enemies.desc: Almost imperceptible to the naked eye, this extremely fast assassin will meet unprepared victims with a tremendous fate.

enemies.name: Phoenix
enemies.desc: A massive bird resembling an eagle, with shimmering golden feathers and a gaze that burns like fire.

enemies.name: Pirate
enemies.desc: The most common member of a pirate ship crew, Skull Island pirates are feared all over the realms. Trained in the use of the Cutlass, a traditional piratesque sword, they also have access to an exclusive technology capable of shooting iron projectiles with incredible force.

enemies.name: Pirate Captain
enemies.desc: Only the most fearsome and ruthless pirates are given the command of a galleon. The pirate captains are formidable warriors, well versed in the art of diplomacy and rum drinking. They are in charge of some of the most difficult missions around the Realms.

enemies.name: Pirate Lieutenant
enemies.desc: Higher in the Skull Island pirate's hierarchy than the regular pirate, this seasoned lieutenant commands small crews in their plunders.

enemies.name: Primeval Wurm
enemies.desc: An ancient being of terrifying size, capable of devouring entire villages in a single bite. One of them is said to roam the ground below the Southern Grove, roaming in circle and unable to leave due to the rocky terrain surrounding the area.

enemies.name: Forged Titan
enemies.desc: The Primordial Titan was never destroyed, only chained. The cult that worships the Herald melted down the chains and forged it anew.

enemies.name: Pterodactyl
enemies.desc: A massive, flying living fossil from the dawn of this world. Remarkably strong, yet astonishingly agile in the air.

enemies.name: Reinforced Door
enemies.desc: A large, imposing door. Attacks through a smaller Gaussian Coil fixed above, and the system that powers the room is reliant on its integrity.

enemies.name: Sand Demon
enemies.desc: The last resort of the Sha'huri defense system. When invaders threaten the safety of their God, the defense system draws upon all its energy to conjure these fearsome warriors, capable of defeating large armies by themselves. Due to the immense energy cost these assaults should be short timed, albeit overwhelming.

enemies.name: Sand Statue
enemies.desc: A sand warrior summoned by the legendary Sha'huri defense system, the last resort against external invaders to protect the core of their empire and their god. While not particularly strong by itself, they present a mortal threat by swarming the invaders in large numbers.

enemies.name: Sand Vulture
enemies.desc: Birds of prey that scavenge on carrion. Not very dangerous alone, but ranged units are required to take them down.

enemies.name: Heir of Sha'Kire
enemies.desc: Descendant of the legendary First Swordsman. The pyramid is empty, but the oath to guard it was passed down for forty generations.

enemies.name: The False Idol
enemies.desc: A god built by priests who could not accept that theirs was gone. It looks like the one that hid in the pyramid. It is not.

enemies.name: Sha'huri Archer
enemies.desc: Skilled archer of the Sha'huri tribe, he offers ranged support for ground troops. They wield special bows able to disrupt enemy actions.

enemies.name: Sha'huri Mage
enemies.desc: Gifted with a fragment of their god's magic, they can manipulate the desert sand to encapsulate and crush their enemies.

enemies.name: Sha'huri Warrior
enemies.desc: Fearsome warrior of the Sha'huri tribe, he executes the orders of the desert god.

enemies.name: Singularity
enemies.desc: The first physical, seemingly living being to appear in this world. Countless souls fused together as one, radiating an immense amount of energy.

enemies.name: Slime
enemies.desc: A green, semi-transparent creature rarely spotted in the depth of the forest. From the few witnesses lucky enough to witness a Slime, they used to display an elusive behaviour before the corruption.

enemies.name: Slime Queen
enemies.desc: A thousand years ago the King of the Slimes seeped into the ground. Something grew from what it left behind, and it rules the pond with a court of its own.

enemies.name: Smoldering Titan
enemies.desc: A colossal demigod as tall as a mountain, birthed from the fiery depths of an active volcano. It moves slowly, crushing and incinerating everything in its path.

enemies.name: Snow Wyvern
enemies.desc: A majestic flying creature rarely spotted around the frostbite peaks. Unlike other draconids, it spits an ice tempest capable of sweeping away an unprepared army.

enemies.name: Stone Shaman
enemies.desc: A mystic wielding a unique form of magic derived from stones unlike anything found on the surface. These stones allow them to command wild beasts with ease and grant them some healing powers.

enemies.name: Tekeli'li, First Apostle
enemies.desc: This vast, amorphous mass of organs and appendages dwells hundreds of meters beneath the Submerged Temple, orchestrating the Ritual. It is the most powerful of the Ancient's original, devoted apostles, it will stop at nothing to restore its master from its cosmic exile.

enemies.name: Terrorsaurus
enemies.desc: An immense, heavily armored dinosaur—slow-moving but with razor-sharp teeth. It can endure staggering amounts of damage before finally succumbing.

enemies.name: The Ancient
enemies.desc: To meet it's gaze is to peer into the unfathomable void of cosmic indifference. One glimpse at its figure unravels reason like a fragile thread. The terrified adventurers, however, feel like they already met this nightmare.

enemies.name: The Exiled
enemies.desc: An extremely strong man slightly taller than average, who looks extremely calm. He looks out of place among the other prisoners. What secret is he hiding?

enemies.name: The Machine
enemies.desc: An enormous mechanical construct, an ever-shifting maze of angles and cogs, defying geometry and logic with every change in its configuration.

enemies.name: Forgemaster Varn
enemies.desc: One of the three cultist rebels. An extremely powerful mage, still couldn't manage to make the Primordial corruption-proof.

enemies.name: Treant
enemies.desc: These living trees of medium dimensions used to be kind and caring towards wild creatures and travelers alike.

enemies.name: Troll
enemies.desc: The very existence of these creatures baffled lore experts from around the Realms for centuries. They live in small sized tribes and conduct a primitive lifestyle based mainly on hunting. Their natural strength is unparalleled, and killing even one of them is a difficult feat.

enemies.name: Troll Shaman
enemies.desc: These trolls manifest some kind of healing power, different from the traditional white magic used by clerics but very effective in keeping their peers alive. Along with the troll's natural regenerative capabilities, killing a troll while they are alive is a difficult task.

enemies.name: Troll Warrior
enemies.desc: In the hierarchy of trolls, these individuals are assigned to the protection of the troll's hunting grounds from external forces. They are usually the strongest trolls of the pack, wielding a huge hammer as a weapon and striking fear into the hearts of explorers unlucky enough to have a close encounter with them

enemies.name: Troll Whelp
enemies.desc: A young troll, not as dangerous as it's older peers, but already presents the defining features of their species, such as enhanced regeneration and a very hard skin.

enemies.name: Wolf
enemies.desc: A wild wolf living in the forest. They can hunt alone or in packs.

enemies.name: Ultraslime
enemies.desc: An endless figure that entirely occupies the immense chamber. Housing this monstrosity must alone be the reason of the sheer size of this tower.

enemies.name: Undead
enemies.desc: The corpse of a fallen infantry soldier, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Undead Archer
enemies.desc: The corpse of a fallen archer, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Undead General
enemies.desc: A reanimated high-rank General of the Imperial Army. During their life they were an exceptionally gifted soldier, deciding the outcome of key battles and leading hundreds of soldiers. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Undead Warlord
enemies.desc: This undead was likely a skilled commander, visibly stronger than the normal undead and clad in a spiked armor that hurts attackers. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Vampire Bat
enemies.desc: An extremely agile creature, it flies above its preys striking at the first opportunity, drawing their blood to restore its energy.

enemies.name: Void Slime
enemies.desc: A very unusual slime, with the texture of a starry night. It corrodes every surface in its trail, suggesting a conflict between its matter composition and the surrounding world's one.

enemies.name: Wicked Tribute
enemies.desc: A mysterious being from another world, brought into the fold as a result of Laroxians seeking unconventional alliances to bolster their ranks. The cost of its allegiance demands a sacrifice of untold proportions.

enemies.name: Will o' Wisp
enemies.desc: This incorporeal spirit is rarely spotted in large battlefields or cemeteries. There were never reports of them being aggressive towards the living. Completely ignores physical damage.

enemies.name: Wizard of Larox
enemies.desc: A gifted mage, made even more powerful through the endless knowledge of the Laroxians.

enemies.name: Wolf
enemies.desc: A wild wolf living in the forest. They can hunt alone or in packs.

enemies.name: Wurm
enemies.desc: Worm-like creatures with razor sharp teeth that dwell in the desert. They usually attack from below, and can draw energy from the flesh of their preys.

enemies.name: Ashfur Wolf
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this wolf. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A wild wolf living in the forest. They can hunt alone or in packs.

enemies.name: Fungal Boar
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this boar. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Wild boars are omnivorous animals commonly found in the forest. They can be hard to kill due to their thick skin.

enemies.name: Blighted Treant
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this treant. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. These living trees of medium dimensions used to be kind and caring towards wild creatures and travelers alike.

enemies.name: Hollow Centaur
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this centaur. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Half men and half horses, these magical creatures are skilled hunters that used to live in harmony within the forest.

enemies.name: Glass-Skinned Warrior
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sha'huri warrior. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Fearsome warrior of the Sha'huri tribe, he executes the orders of the desert god.

enemies.name: Mirage Archer
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sha'huri archer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Skilled archer of the Sha'huri tribe, he offers ranged support for ground troops. They wield special bows able to disrupt enemy actions.

enemies.name: Dune-Touched Mage
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sha'huri mage. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Gifted with a fragment of their god's magic, they can manipulate the desert sand to encapsulate and crush their enemies.

enemies.name: Silt Wurm
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this wurm. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Worm-like creatures with razor sharp teeth that dwell in the desert. They usually attack from below, and can draw energy from the flesh of their preys.

enemies.name: Carrion Vulture
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sand vulture. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Birds of prey that scavenge on carrion. Not very dangerous alone, but ranged units are required to take them down.

enemies.name: Mourning Undead
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this undead. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The corpse of a fallen infantry soldier, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Hollow Archer
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this undead archer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The corpse of a fallen archer, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Ashen Hound
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this death hound. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A war hound employed by the Imperial Army, reanimated by the corruption after falling in battle. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Gravebound Warlord
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this undead warlord. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. This undead was likely a skilled commander, visibly stronger than the normal undead and clad in a spiked armor that hurts attackers. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Gorged Ghoul
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this ghoul. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. For unknown reasons, sometimes undead are animated by a strong urge to feed on other dead bodies. These creatures often develop a more feral appearance, with longer teeth and sharper nails, and after some time they lose all of their similarity with human beings. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

enemies.name: Veiled Warden
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this city warden. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A law enforcement unit operating in the Capital. They are not part of the Imperial Army, and their responsibility is to maintain order and catch criminals.

enemies.name: Feverish Citizen
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this insane citizen. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A citizen of the Empire Capital, who lived among luxury and wealth, never knowing any real hardship. The eye's appearance stole their sanity, and now they wander the streets in a feral state.

enemies.name: Hollow Priest
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this insane priest. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A priest of one of the many places of worship in the city, used to offer guidance to the poor and the miserables. His strong faith granted him healing powers, that remained even after the loss of his sanity.

enemies.name: Plague Guard
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this imperial guard. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A member of a special division of the Imperial Army appointed to the defense of the Imperial Palace and the many decentralized Imperial institutions. They are experts at protecting vulnerable targets, and can be formidable opponents even in their unhinged state.

enemies.name: Smoke Assassin
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this arcane assassin. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The Arcane Assassins were a special operation group under direct command of the Seer, Kasimir, employed across the realms to take out targets that aimed to deteriorate the fragile peace among the various factions. They wield magical daggers gifted by the Seer, whose origin is a mystery.

enemies.name: Gilded Mage
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this imperial mage. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Strategically crucial in every Imperial Army division, these highly trained mages conjure thunders above the enemy ranks, dealing substantial damage and disrupting their strategy.

enemies.name: Drowned Pirate
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this pirate. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The most common member of a pirate ship crew, Skull Island pirates are feared all over the realms. Trained in the use of the Cutlass, a traditional piratesque sword, they also have access to an exclusive technology capable of shooting iron projectiles with incredible force.

enemies.name: Barnacled Deckhand
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this deckhand. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A capuchin colored monkey commonly found in the exotic Skull Island, home of the pirates. It has been trained to perform the lowliest duties of a pirate crew, like cleaning the decks and bringing the rum. It has also been trained in using the knife, and is a surprisingly strong adversary.

enemies.name: Brine Lieutenant
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this pirate lieutenant. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Higher in the Skull Island pirate's hierarchy than the regular pirate, this seasoned lieutenant commands small crews in their plunders.

enemies.name: Moss Troll
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The very existence of these creatures baffled lore experts from around the Realms for centuries. They live in small sized tribes and conduct a primitive lifestyle based mainly on hunting. Their natural strength is unparalleled, and killing even one of them is a difficult feat.

enemies.name: Rime Whelp
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll whelp. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A young troll, not as dangerous as it's older peers, but already presents the defining features of their species, such as enhanced regeneration and a very hard skin.

enemies.name: Ashen Troll Warrior
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll warrior. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. In the hierarchy of trolls, these individuals are assigned to the protection of the troll's hunting grounds from external forces. They are usually the strongest trolls of the pack, wielding a huge hammer as a weapon and striking fear into the hearts of explorers unlucky enough to have a close encounter with them

enemies.name: Blight Shaman
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll shaman. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. These trolls manifest some kind of healing power, different from the traditional white magic used by clerics but very effective in keeping their peers alive. Along with the troll's natural regenerative capabilities, killing a troll while they are alive is a difficult task.

enemies.name: Lantern Spider
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this giant spider. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. This kind of spider is usually found in much smaller sizes around the northern kingdoms. Left undisturbed for decades in the darkness of the Obsidian Mines, it reached the size of a grown man.

enemies.name: Pale Bat
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this vampire bat. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An extremely agile creature, it flies above its preys striking at the first opportunity, drawing their blood to restore its energy.

enemies.name: Cracked Golem
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this obsidian golem. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Animated by unknown forces, this massive obsidian creature is impervious to any magic damage thanks to this element's properties. While hard to take down without a strategy, the massive size hinders it's offensive capabilities.

enemies.name: Weeping Beholder
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this beholder. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Extremely smart but evil creatures only found in the depth of the earth, beholder will smite their opponents with their eldritch powers.

enemies.name: Rotwood Spitfang
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this green spitfang. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Large snake found in the southern regions that hunts by hurling saliva at its enemies at tremendous speed.

enemies.name: Ashwing Moth
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this giant moth. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Flies thanks to a magic powder that covers its wings. This powder is known to irritate the airways of many other creatures, including humans.

enemies.name: Mossback Tortoise
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this giant tortoise. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A huge tortoise weighting several tons, with a very hard shell covered in sharp spikes.

enemies.name: Thorned Dryad
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this dryad. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Elusive magical creature found in the southern woods. Its origin is unknown, but the travelers that spotted it before the corruption struck reported a timid but kind temperament.

enemies.name: Fallen Iconoclast
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this iconoclast. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Slaves to the Celestial Goddess, abducted from the worlds she destroyed. Their bodies are modified to allow them to live through raging flames, and their mission is to cleanse the lands designated for the Cleansing.

enemies.name: Blind Oculus
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this oculus. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Flying organic-machine hybrid used to map terrain, find enemy locations and generally gathering information on the battlefield. Equipped with a small but powerful magic cannon that allows, through unknown technology, to replicate a destructive spell usually casted by mages through their rituals.

enemies.name: Tarnished Lancer
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this celestial lancer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The backbone of the Celestial Army. These fearless soldiers push through foreign worlds animated by unwavering loyalty, counting on a supernatural agility despite their large size.

enemies.name: Keening Banshee
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this banshee. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A terrifying breed of armored beasts that roam the Barren Wastelands. Due to their presence, this area was uninhabited since the beginning of recorder history, but fortunately they keep to their hunting grounds.

enemies.name: Unbound Armor
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this magic armor. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Armor crafted from a unique metal and brought to life through a blend of technology and magic. The city is teeming with these constructs, ever vigilant and prepared to fend off any potential invasion.

enemies.name: Ink Imp
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this imp. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A small, winged servant of the Wizards of Larox, summoned through magic and lacking any will of its own. It is typically used for simple tasks but can also assist in defending the city when needed.

enemies.name: Hollow Wizard
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this wizard of larox. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A gifted mage, made even more powerful through the endless knowledge of the Laroxians.

enemies.name: Fevered Researcher
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this nexus researcher. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Lacking any magical power themselves, they work together to complete the Nexus of Larox and to discover new types of spells.

enemies.name: Magma Berserker
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this berserker. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An ancient warrior armed with twin mithril axes, his fury intensifies with every blow he endures, turning him into an unstoppable force as the battle rages on.

enemies.name: Cinder Pterodactyl
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this pterodactyl. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A massive, flying living fossil from the dawn of this world. Remarkably strong, yet astonishingly agile in the air.

enemies.name: Ashen Shaman
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this stone shaman. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A mystic wielding a unique form of magic derived from stones unlike anything found on the surface. These stones allow them to command wild beasts with ease and grant them some healing powers.

enemies.name: Scorched Terrorsaurus
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this terrorsaurus. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An immense, heavily armored dinosaur—slow-moving but with razor-sharp teeth. It can endure staggering amounts of damage before finally succumbing.

enemies.name: Spore Amanita
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this amanita obscura. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Purple fungus with white grains. Its flesh contains a paralyzing agent capable of halting respiratory functions in nearly every living creature. It moves slowly but with a rhythmic pattern, hinting at a form of sentience.

enemies.name: Wretched Disciple
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this bleak disciple. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. This humanoid of unknown origin, warped beyond recognition, has dwelled beneath these caverns for millennia. It toils ceaselessly to bring its long-forgotten god back into existence.

enemies.name: Pale Hound
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this eldritch hound. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. These twisted, wolf-like creatures relentlessly hunt any creature that dares to approach the underground temple.

enemies.name: Rusted Necrobot
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this necrobot. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A soldier resurrected not by magic but through unknown technology, bound to carry out the commands of its masters.

enemies.name: Blighted Enforcer
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this enforcer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A warrior grotesquely altered through agonizing experiments, gifted with immense strength and a towering size.

enemies.name: Faded Phantasm
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this phantasm. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Almost imperceptible to the naked eye, this extremely fast assassin will meet unprepared victims with a tremendous fate.

enemies.name: Swollen Cerebrum
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this cerebrum. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A sentient brain encased in nearly indestructible glass. It cannot move, but can manipulate the surrounding world in other ways.

enemies.name: Frayed Beast
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this dreamwrought beast. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An incorporeal creature resembling a horse, with a single horn on its forehead.

enemies.name: Dim Swarm
enemies.desc: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this dreamwrought swarm. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An endless multitude of spectral, ravenous insects that tear their prey apart in seconds.

enemies.name: Zealot Crusader
enemies.desc:
The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this crusader. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A member of one of the many crusades from the eastern cities to eradicate the evil that has been abducting their citizen. They wander the halls aimlessly, having lost their ego over time to the magical influences.
People from these lands seem to naturally display psyonic capabilities, and could present a formidable menace in large numbers.

enemies.name: The Breach Keeper
enemies.desc: What has held the Endless Portal open for a thousand years. It is not the portal, only its doorkeeper, and it has never once let anything pass in the other direction.

adventurers.name: Adept
adventurers.desc: A novice who just started to grasp the potential of his gift. His limited knowledge undermines the control over his magic.

adventurers.name: Alchemist
adventurers.desc: A gifted archer fascinated by the nature of her concoctions, who decided to focus on the study of Thaumaturgy: replicating magic through scientific means.

adventurers.name: Ancient Lich
adventurers.desc: Long forgotten by death itself, this Lich survived for eons in a remote corner of the realms, his powers over death growing to unfathomable strength.

adventurers.name: Angel
adventurers.desc: Heralds of the Gods of Light, only the most exceptional and selfless healers can ascend through the divine ranks. They are said to operate in mysterious ways, and even to be able to bring back fallen soldiers from certain death.

adventurers.name: Angel of War
adventurers.desc: The feared and revered leader of the Holy Temple, he shapes its doctrine and commands its followers. He must possess the strength to resist all forms of magical and political influence as he wages war against the very source of evil, defeating eldritch gods before they can tighten their hold on the human realms.

adventurers.name: Apprentice
adventurers.desc: Untrained in the art of combat, he possesses the spark of something he can't explain yet. Ever since he saw it, he searched for ways to improve his understanding.

adventurers.name: Archangel
adventurers.desc: Archangel are divine beings of pure light, embodying hope in the darkest corners of the Realms. Ancient chronicles tell of these powerful beings descending from the sky, restoring entire armies and turning the tide of decisive battles.

adventurers.name: Archer
adventurers.desc: Armed with a bow and arrows, she provides reliable long-range support, delivering shots to hurt enemies from a distance.

adventurers.name: Assassin
adventurers.desc: Masters of deception, these individuals are often employed by noble families to discreetly remove troublesome opponents.

adventurers.name: Balrog
adventurers.desc: The unrestrained embodiment of Chaos, feared even by powerful Gods. This natural force wreaks havoc in the mortal lands as in the depths of hell, often having entire armies failing to stop its march.

adventurers.name: Bard
adventurers.desc: A master entertainer who can play music to heal, harm, or drive soldiers into a holy fury. Used to resort to any means to survive, this traveling storyteller offensive capabilities should not be underestimated, either.

adventurers.name: Black Idol
adventurers.desc: A Lich ascended to his ultimate form. Though his body remains a mere withered shell, the spirit of this dark mage has grown immensely powerful. He can wield magic to shape the world around him and summon horrors beyond imagination.

adventurers.name: Black Regent
adventurers.desc: Fueled solely by his lust for power, this brilliant strategist has transformed his kingdom into a war machine, poised to subjugate neighboring states—whether opposing or neutral—to seize the resources needed for his expansion. With no regard for life and an insatiable hunger for dominance, he poses a grave threat to the peace and stability of the Realms if left unchecked.

adventurers.name: Blight
adventurers.desc: Feared even by the most prepared armies, she can render a whole fortress defenseless with a few, accurate shots at its defending troops.

adventurers.name: Bone Horror
adventurers.desc: A reanimated bone horror. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

adventurers.name: Bone Hydra
adventurers.desc: A reanimated bone hydra. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

adventurers.name: Bone Nightmare
adventurers.desc: A reanimated bone nightmare. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

adventurers.name: Celestial Rain
adventurers.desc: A legendary archer that defies the most basic laws of nature. Every arrow crackles with raw energy as it hits the target with extreme force, and her sole presence on the battlefield denies to entire armies the possibility of an open field attack.

adventurers.name: Cleric
adventurers.desc: After years of magic studies, the Cleric has a solid grasp of healing magic. He is a solid staple of any exploration team of adventurers.

adventurers.name: Corrosive Wraith
adventurers.desc: The poison coursing through her veins has somehow mutated into an even more potent form without harming its host. This unique toxin is stronger, unlike any other, and can only exist through this rare symbiosis. When these creatures defy the law of the land, they are hunted relentlessly—and often, unsuccessfully.

adventurers.name: Cutthroat
adventurers.desc: Strong and nimble, he stealthily closes in on unsuspecting targets to strike them with considerable force.

adventurers.name: Dark Knight
adventurers.desc: A knight who has forsaken the path of law, now only loyal to his own principles.

adventurers.name: Dark Sorcerer
adventurers.desc: Having abandoned the path of knowledge for that of corruption, this mage seeks power not through endless studies and practice, but through communion with evil beings trying to influence the world for their nefarious purposes.

adventurers.name: Death Knight
adventurers.desc: Inspiring fear as he roams the lands, the Death Knight relentlessly obliterates any obstacle that lies in the path of his objectives.

adventurers.name: Demilich
adventurers.desc: In the self-destructive path to become a master of the undead, the necromancer has to face power beyond the mortal's imagination, and resist their corruption. Flesh begins to decompose, as he realizes that the price to pay for the control over Death is eternal suffering.

adventurers.name: Demon
adventurers.desc: Awakening from the initial torpor, the inhabitant of this body grasps the rules of this reality and breaks free from its cradle. It obeys no master, and its disgust for earthly creatures weakness only grows with time.

adventurers.name: Divine Champion
adventurers.desc: Untouchable by most conventional and magical weapons, this divine warrior wields a sword with lightning speed, deflecting both arrows and spells alike. He is the champion of choice to face any adversary, even those of divine power.

adventurers.name: Divine Duelist
adventurers.desc: A duelist of unmatched skill in single combat, this warrior—born perhaps once in a generation—wields a sword so swift that his strikes are over before they’re even seen, cutting down opponents with imperceptible speed.

adventurers.name: Drake Rider
adventurers.desc: Only legendary riders could hope to ever tame a drake and learn how to ride it. This deadly duo will ignite the battlefield while hunting down the few survivors with deadly arrows.

adventurers.name: Eidolon
adventurers.desc: An ethereal embodiment of divine melody, wielding godlike power to protect his allies, able to rally armies to reshape whole kingdoms.

adventurers.name: Eldritch Alchemist
adventurers.desc: Transcending the border between mortal and divine, her potions incorporate an eldritch god's blessing, obtained through arcane means and without its knowledge.

adventurers.name: Elemental Alchemist
adventurers.desc: A brilliant mind who devoted her life to the study of Thaumaturgy, she has successfully replicated elemental magic in her potions using only natural ingredients and chemical processes.

adventurers.name: Esoteric Alchemist
adventurers.desc: This masterful alchemist not only succeeded in harnessing the power of the elements in her creations but also infused them with blessings typically linked to benevolent deities.

adventurers.name: Eternal Fortress
adventurers.desc: A legendary warrior whose armor is unbreakable by conventional means. Able to duel with mortals and deities, able to withstand an unreal amount of damage before even flinching.

adventurers.name: Fire Wizard
adventurers.desc: Amids the journey of discovery, the Fire Wizard learned to channel magic to emulate natural forces. Being the most dangerous of them all, he choose fire as the object of his studies.

adventurers.name: Footman
adventurers.desc: A novice infantry unit. Lacks experience, but has received a brief training in the Royal Army.

adventurers.name: Fury
adventurers.desc: With a rare mastery of the bow, she makes death rain on the battlefield in the form of the deadliest of arrows.

adventurers.name: Golden Rider
adventurers.desc: This fearsome archer rides one of the last remaining Golden Drakes, a nearly extinct subspecies of the more common drake. Distinguished by its brilliant golden scales, the Golden Drake boasts greater strength and a fiercer, hotter flame than its kin.

adventurers.name: Guard
adventurers.desc: Specialized in the surveillance of civilians or places of interest, guards are widely employed for the protection of sensitive objectives.

adventurers.name: Hailstorm
adventurers.desc: Having developed an almost superhuman ability with her weapon, she hails arrows on enemy armies with such a speed that surviving is almost impossible

adventurers.name: Heavenly Cantor
adventurers.desc: A divine musician able to change the fate of a war through his instrument. Not only he will empower his allies, but through a uniquely crafted music, he will make them immune to pain.

adventurers.name: Hellish Sculptor
adventurers.desc: Half way between assassin and artist, he draws his target ever closer to death with each strike—leaving behind hauntingly beautiful tributes to Death itself in his wake.

adventurers.name: Holy Knight
adventurers.desc: A knight devoted to the service of the Holy Temple, he is a protector of the righteous and a vanguard of justice, sworn to eradicate evil from every corner of the land.

adventurers.name: Horse Rider
adventurers.desc: An archer who shifted the focus of her training to horse riding. Blends the danger of long-range attacks with the ability to deal melee damage with her ride.

adventurers.name: Huntress
adventurers.desc: Refining her skills with her hunting experience in the wilderness, she can hit enemies with reliable shots.

adventurers.name: Hurricane
adventurers.desc: This archer of unnatural precision is a coveted asset for any army. She can fend off a full-scale assault for hours, and can be reached only by sacrificing an enormous number of soldiers.

adventurers.name: Infernal Lord
adventurers.desc: Ascending through infernal ranks through its ruthlessness and cruelty, an Infernal Lord walking the realms is a threat that brings enemy kingdoms together in a desperate effort to prevent the entire world's descent into chaos.

adventurers.name: Infernal Prince
adventurers.desc: Rising from the ashes of conquest and tempered by the fires of countless battles, the Infernal Prince commands legions with a fearsome authority unmatched in the infernal realms. Now no longer a commander but a true sovereign of terror, the Infernal Prince stands as an unstoppable force, against whom resistance is little more than a fleeting hope.

adventurers.name: Inferno
adventurers.desc: An incredibly powerful, mystical able to invoke firestorms out of thin air, burning entire armies to ashes while meteor falls upon them. An army that can reliably protect him is an army that can win any battle.

adventurers.name: Inquisitor
adventurers.desc: As feared as he is respected, the Inquisitor's might is rarely matched. He stands as the supreme lawgiver, overseeing the realms conquered by the Holy Temple.

adventurers.name: Iron Defender
adventurers.desc: An enormous warden capable of withstanding a substantial amount of damage before succumbing.

adventurers.name: Iron Warden
adventurers.desc: A seasoned guard rich in experience, clad in a heavy armor.

adventurers.name: Juggernaut
adventurers.desc: A rare sight in the battlefield, these armored giants can easily shrug off strikes from siege weapons with ease.

adventurers.name: Justiciar
adventurers.desc: The Justiciar serves as the Holy Temple’s arbiter, enforcing laws that everyone—from peasants to kings—must obey to avoid incurring the Temple's wrath. A formidable warrior, he leads crusades against evil tyrants and unholy creatures that threaten the Realms.

adventurers.name: King's Hand
adventurers.desc: The king's personal guard. Wreaks havoc during unrests, and singlehandedly guarantees His Majesty safety against any threat.

adventurers.name: Knight
adventurers.desc: Renowned for their steadfast loyalty and honor, they provide a first line for their allies while overpowering their foes.

adventurers.name: Lich
adventurers.desc: Through extraordinary willpower, the Lich endured his transformation for decades, without surrendering to the pain until only bare bones remained. Since muscles and tendons are long gone, this shell of a human is animated entirely by magic.

adventurers.name: Light Disciple
adventurers.desc: An inexperienced mage who tries to expand his knowledge towards a branch of magic that does not hurt foes, but help allies.

adventurers.name: Lorekeeper
adventurers.desc: The stories known by this keeper of ancient wisdom are almost endless. Drawing upon myths and legends, he channels forgotten magic through his instrument notes.

adventurers.name: Lord of Decay
adventurers.desc: A demigod who mastered the control over death, capable of summoning terrifying monsters never seen before.

adventurers.name: Marksman
adventurers.desc: Rigorous training coupled with a keen vision blessed the Marksman with a perfect aim, even in the most hostile conditions.

adventurers.name: Meat Carver
adventurers.desc: Working like a seasoned sculptor he meticolously shapes his creation, one precise strike after another. The final outcome is a grim tribute to death itself.

adventurers.name: Melting Elder
adventurers.desc: His blood and flesh turned into elemental fire. This incredibly powerful caster incinerates his enemies with a single gesture.

adventurers.name: Minstrel
adventurers.desc: A gifted performer whose melodies inspire allies and mislead foes, turning the tides of a battle with a song or a whispered word.

adventurers.name: Necromancer
adventurers.desc: Gifted with the magic of decay, antithesis of all that is holy. The Necromancer spells corrupt the flesh of his enemies and condemns them to an afterlife of servitude.

adventurers.name: Night Blade
adventurers.desc: He adapted to darkness like a nocturnal animal. Campfire stories about them can make the night uneasy for any exploration team in foreign lands.

adventurers.name: Night Lament
adventurers.desc: Halfway between mortal and divine, entire cults were born to worship this force of death. Its presence in the darkness is revealed only by the laments of its victims.

adventurers.name: Night Specter
adventurers.desc: Blending seamlessly with the night's terrain, in the cover of darkness, no human stands a chance against his ambush.

adventurers.name: Night Terror
adventurers.desc: Ancient myths speak of Night Terrors, and how entire villages could vanish overnight because the wrong person was crossed.

adventurers.name: Night Veil
adventurers.desc: Indistinguishable from the shadows that envelop its prey, every enemy—no matter how powerful—falls before they even sense its approach.

adventurers.name: Overlord
adventurers.desc: A ruthless ruler who respects no laws but his own. He will stop at nothing to eliminate his enemies and conquer rival kingdoms.

adventurers.name: Paladin
adventurers.desc: An elite warrior of the Holy Temple, a beacon of light to the oppressed, upholds and enforces the laws of the kingdom.

adventurers.name: Plague Spreader
adventurers.desc: Equipped with one of the strongest venom known to humanity, she can propagate deadly illnesses among the enemy ranks.

adventurers.name: Poison Bow
adventurers.desc: An expert archer who studied the art of poison mixing, she imbues her arrows with an unknown substance capable of weakening enemies.

adventurers.name: Radiant Elder
adventurers.desc: Blessed with ancient knowledge and divine powers, few recorded instances of Radiant Elders are present in history books. They are exceptional healers, said to be able to bring anyone back from the brink of death.

adventurers.name: Red Archmage
adventurers.desc: Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. Decades of training made this mage able to effortlessly wield fire magic to set his enemies ablaze.

adventurers.name: Red Elder
adventurers.desc: Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. The Red Elder conjure meteors above the enemy ranks, dealing tremendous damage in a large area.

adventurers.name: Red Mage
adventurers.desc: An experienced mage who can harness his powers to hurl fireballs into the enemy ranks. Can be often found in the ranks of defending armies, being a deterrent for any aggressor choosing to invade through an open field.

adventurers.name: Red Stalker
adventurers.desc: A master of lethality, he waits for the best moment to strike with incredible precision inflicting a grievous wound that hardly heals.

adventurers.name: Rogue
adventurers.desc: An outcast who resorts to petty crimes to survive. Lacking in strength and cunning, he compensates with his streetwise knowledge and resourcefulness.

adventurers.name: Royal Captain
adventurers.desc: The most skilled swordsman serving the royal family ascends to the role of Captain, overseeing palace security and determining the strategic tactics to be employed.

adventurers.name: Royal Guard
adventurers.desc: Commonly found in noble houses and palaces, these guards offer a balanced blend of offensive and defensive capabilities.

adventurers.name: Royal Swordsman
adventurers.desc: Highly trained in the art of swordsmanship, these guards are usually assigned to the protection of royal families and their palace.

adventurers.name: Scorching Elder
adventurers.desc: A mythological entity who became one with the flame. The Scorched Elder conjures searing flames so powerful they can melt rocks, and crushes his enemies with the strength of a small star.

adventurers.name: Scourge
adventurers.desc: A force of nature capable of reshaping the borders of kingdoms. It's said his devastating strikes can annihilate entire legions.

adventurers.name: Shadow Crawler
adventurers.desc: Specialized in concealment within the shadows, the Shadow Crawler can be very hard to hit in dark areas

adventurers.name: Shadow Dancer
adventurers.desc: Uses darkness as his hideout, and strike enemies when they least expect it.

adventurers.name: Silver Tongue
adventurers.desc: A persuasive manipulator who bends hearts and minds, able to inspire his allies and push them over their limits.

adventurers.name: Skeleton
adventurers.desc: A reanimated skeleton. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

adventurers.name: Spire Acolyte
adventurers.desc: Acolytes, as full-fledged members of the Spire, have mastered the organization's secret technique. They are pivotal agents dispatched across the Realms, ensuring no target is beyond the reach of the Spire.

adventurers.name: Spire Initiate
adventurers.desc: The Spire, an age-old clandestine organization, recruits only the realm's most skilled assassins. Its select few members wield profound influence over the political landscape of kingdoms, capable of eliminating virtually any target with a secretive technique known solely to them.

adventurers.name: Spire Leader
adventurers.desc: Upon the passing of the former Spire leader, often under circumstances far from the natural, the most experienced Acolyte is entrusted with assuming their role, and the organization's deepest secrets are revealed to them. Deployed only for exceptionally difficult tasks, and throughout history, they have been credited with toppling rulers and deities alike.

adventurers.name: Spire Sage
adventurers.desc: Spire Sages are those who advance the lethal techniques of the spire assassins. New Sages may not emerge for centuries, as the cynical resolve needed to pursue such knowledge is extremely uncommon.

adventurers.name: Spirit Engraver
adventurers.desc: This one-of-a-kind assassin, gifted with unparalleled skill, can strike at the very essence of a being's consciousness, reaching beyond mere flesh. No living creature, mortal or divine, is safe from his dark art.

adventurers.name: Spitfang Rider
adventurers.desc: Displaying an incredible riding ability, Spitfang Riders managed to tame the fearsome Spitfang Snakes, a fearsome beast that can attack from a distance.

adventurers.name: Sureshot
adventurers.desc: A master of archery, a Sureshot with a good positioning can take out even small groups of enemies all by herself.

adventurers.name: Tempest
adventurers.desc: Bane of invading armies, the Tempest will haul barrages of arrows shot with devastating strength and precision, singlehandedly defending strategic hideouts from entire regiments.

adventurers.name: Templar
adventurers.desc: Among the strongest crusaders of the Holy Temple, the Templar serves as a commander of the vanguard that enforces the law in undiscovered lands.

adventurers.name: Thief
adventurers.desc: A nimble outlaw whose skills are invaluable for detecting dangers well in advance.

adventurers.name: Titan
adventurers.desc: An unbreakable warrior, renowned for traversing the chaos of battle unscathed. Whole armies have attempted, yet failed, to inflict even the slightest injury upon him.

adventurers.name: Toxic Stalker
adventurers.desc: The Toxic Stalker has perfected her art of creating deadly toxins, and can severely disrupt the activity of unaware hostile entities.

adventurers.name: Trickster
adventurers.desc: A cunning rogue who thrives on deception, adept at distracting foes and seizing unexpected opportunities in the chaos of battle.

adventurers.name: Tyrant
adventurers.desc: A leader capable of unspeakable evil, he stands as the unrivaled champion in realms where only the mightiest prevail.

adventurers.name: Unchained
adventurers.desc: Most of those who aspire to become a Lich through the forgotten rituals realize too late they cannot pay the price required. The necromancer who begs for the release of death is confronted with a grim offer: his mortal body as an instrument for the entities he communed with.

adventurers.name: Undying Bastion
adventurers.desc: A walking, impenetrable fortress clad in unbreakable battle gear. Deployed in epic battles to stabilize the frontline on newly conquered lands, he is able to withstand a full charge from opposing armies alone.

adventurers.name: Warrior
adventurers.desc: An infantry unit with some experience in the battlefield. Warriors constitutes the bulk of regular armies.

adventurers.name: Whisper
adventurers.desc: Mythological beings from whom the Spire assassins appear to draw their powers, they exist on the boundary between realms, slaying their prey through mysterious means.

adventurers.name: White Archmage
adventurers.desc: Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. With their exceptional mastery of white magic, White Archmages are strategic units that can turn the tides of a battle.

adventurers.name: White Elder
adventurers.desc: Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. White elders unleash an unending stream of healing, making any frontline extremely resilient.

adventurers.name: White mage
adventurers.desc: Widely used in the ranks of any army, white mages divisions provide reliable healing from the backlines to the most exposed soldiers.

adventurers.name: Wolf Rider
adventurers.desc: Not indicated for beginner riders, wolves provide a formidable companion that can viciously bite enemies already overwhelmed by arrows.

adventurers.name: Worg Rider
adventurers.desc: An extremely vicious beast, the worg will tear apart the flesh of its enemies while his rider shoots with deadly aim.

adventurers.name: Wounds Weaver
adventurers.desc: Unparalleled in the knowledge of anatomy, his enemies are a living canvas to him. While victim's realization rises with each stroke, his art comes to life while life comes to an end.

adventurers.name: Wraith
adventurers.desc: Gradually altered by constant exposure to various toxins, she has developed complete immunity to poison. This venomous demon slips through enemy towns under cover of night, hidden in shadows, leaving soldiers helpless before the coming invasion.

adventurers.name: Wyrm Rider
adventurers.desc: Wyrms are colossal, legendary creatures famed for the chaos they unleash in myths and folklore. These magical beasts possess elemental breath powerful enough to level entire towns, which led to them being relentlessly hunted in centuries past. No human has ever been known to ride a wyrm—except, perhaps, in the tales told by bards.

adventurers.name: Zombie
adventurers.desc: A reanimated zombie. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

adventurers.name: Elementalist
adventurers.desc: A student of the Laroxian schools who bends fire, frost and lightning alike, mastering none of them yet.

adventurers.name: Elemental Adept
adventurers.desc: Trained by the Wizards of Larox, this caster weaves the elements into a single, unstable bolt.

adventurers.name: Elemental Magus
adventurers.desc: A master of the raw elements, ready to devote the rest of a lifetime to one of them.

adventurers.name: Cryomancer
adventurers.desc: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.

adventurers.name: Frost Elder
adventurers.desc: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.

adventurers.name: Glacial Elder
adventurers.desc: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.

adventurers.name: Frost Sovereign
adventurers.desc: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.

adventurers.name: Stormcaller
adventurers.desc: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.

adventurers.name: Thunder Elder
adventurers.desc: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.

adventurers.name: Tempest Elder
adventurers.desc: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.

adventurers.name: Storm Sovereign
adventurers.desc: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.

adventurers.name: Geomancer
adventurers.desc: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.

adventurers.name: Stone Elder
adventurers.desc: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.

adventurers.name: Mountain Elder
adventurers.desc: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.

adventurers.name: Earth Sovereign
adventurers.desc: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.

adventurers.name: Zephyr Bard
adventurers.desc: A wandering archer who sings the wind into every volley. Each song shields the two most exposed allies and exalts them, trading a little accuracy for a hymn that keeps the line standing.

items.name: Aberrant Fabric
items.desc: A piece of fabric of unknown origin, worn by the members of a cult that wishes for the return of the Ancient.

items.name: Abiotic Core
items.desc: An artificial mechanism that can control an organic brain, amplifying its capabilities enough to manipulate the physical world that surrounds it.

items.name: Absolute Zero
items.desc:
The coldest material ever forged makes up an armor that not only is incredibly resilient, but will FREEZE enemies on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

items.name: Abyssal Compendium
items.desc: A book listing forgotten techniques of spellweaving, learned from eldritch entities at a great price.

items.name: Abyssal Cutlass
items.desc: A variation of the typical Cutlass, forged using an enhanced metal to make it lighter.

items.name: Abyssal Goo
items.desc: Viscous potion that can enhance some base materials with additional, terrifying properties.

items.name: Abyssal Ingot
items.desc: A black Iron ingot blessed with eldritch properties from the depth of the abyss.

items.name: Abyssal Seashell
items.desc: Large seashell found in the north-western seas. Mostly used as decoration, possesses some interesting properties.

items.name: Aegis
items.desc:
