items.desc: An inefficient bow used mainly for training

items.name: Troll Hide
items.desc: Hard as a stone but light as regular leather. Used to craft superior quality equipment.

items.name: Trollskin Jacket
items.desc: Hard as stone while allowing for a wide range of movements, secretes an oil that hastens the healing of wounds.

items.name: Tuna Nigiri
items.desc: Deep red tuna on rice, firm yet tender, wrapped in seaweed. A delicacy sometimes found in the diet of pirates and wealthy sea merchants.

items.name: Tuna Roll
items.desc: A sushi roll made with red tuna, avocado and rice. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities.

items.name: Tunica Ignis
items.desc: Slime robe infused with a fiery artifact. Maintains its original properties while granting better control over fire magic.

items.name: Tunica Infernalis
items.desc: Adding a fireproof coating to this unique robe allows to apply different enchantments during its crafting, since protection from it's own fiery power is no longer needed.

items.name: Tusk Necklace
items.desc: Simple ornament made with boar tusks.

items.name: Undead Cuirass
items.desc: Heavy chest armor made from undead remains.

items.name: Undead Gloves
items.desc: Gloves made with undead remains. A little too sticky, but allows for a good range of movements.

items.name: Undead Greaves
items.desc: Sturdy footwear made from undead remains.

items.name: Undead Helm
items.desc: Helm made with undead remains. Offers more protection than more traditional ones.

items.name: Undead Jacket
items.desc: Grim piece of equipment made with undead remains. Offers good protection against external attacks maintaining some mobility.

items.name: Undead Knife
items.desc: A dagger made with a long, sharpened undead rib.

items.name: Undead Shield
items.desc: Large shield made with undead remains.

items.name: Undead Staff
items.desc: Made with undead remains, allows for some control over the flow of magic forces.

items.name: Undead Sword
items.desc: A grim sword made with undead remains.

items.name: Unholy Cuirass
items.desc: The malignant aura surrounding this armor will harm any enemies daring to enter its range.

items.name: Unholy Potion
items.desc: All living beings are naturally repelled by its smell. The antithesis of all that is good, conveniently condensed in liquid form.

items.name: Unholy Spellcage
items.desc: Bound within this ungodly cuirass by a potent spell, the seal of the Ten Hells burns fiercely, swiftly dissolving any foe bold enough to draw near.

items.name: Unholy Sword
items.desc: Antithesis to all that is holy, will inflict damage to any enemy entering it's malevolent aura.

items.name: Unstable Gem
items.desc: A gem that vibrates in its own magical frequency. These are the building blocks of the immense Laroxian Nexus, and will one day be correctly attuned and integrated into its design to amplify its power.

items.name: Unstable Staff
items.desc: Magic staff that draws its power from an arcane gem of unpredictable behaviour. The energy released will vary greatly without a known pattern.

items.name: Upgrade: Market Queue
items.desc:
Permanently increases Market's queue size by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Market Time
items.desc:
Permanently reduces Market's sale times by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Quarters
items.desc:
Permanently increases Quarters capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Shelter
items.desc:
Permanently increases Shelter's capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Storage
items.desc:
Permanently increases Storage spaces by 1.
Limited to ten purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Tavern Capacity
items.desc:
Permanently increases Tavern's capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Tavern Time
items.desc:
Permanently reduces Tavern's wait time by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Workshop Queue
items.desc:
Permanently increases Workshop's queue size by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Upgrade: Workshop Time
items.desc:
Permanently reduces Workshop's craft times by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it.

items.name: Vampire Bow
items.desc: Alchemic result of a long research, its arrows can draw energy from the wounds inflicted and heal the owner for a part of it.

items.name: Vampire Dagger
items.desc: With an extremely sharp blade, has been enhanced to draw energy from wounded enemies.

items.name: Vampire Scepter
items.desc: Enhanced with a peculiar brew, empowers the holder's magic with the ability to return from the target as a healing force.

items.name: Vampire Sword
items.desc: An Obsidian Sword that gained the ability to draw energy from enemies, restoring the holder HP.

items.name: Veil Breaker
items.desc: A staple tool in the bag of the arcane engineer. Allows workers without the gift of magic to manually operate across the veil that separates the physical world from the Arcane Flow.

items.name: Veil Shatterer
items.desc: An extraordinarily powerful magical artifact, capable of overcoming any opposing magical force. It is the only known way to directly interact with the Nexus Core.

items.name: Verdant Blade
items.desc: An unusual dagger with a Spitfang tooth instead of a blade.

items.name: Verdant Boots
items.desc: Boots made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

items.name: Verdant Bow
items.desc: Made of the finest wood in the Realms, this bow can withstand an extreme tension without ever breaking.

items.name: Verdant Gloves
items.desc: Gloves made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

items.name: Verdant Helm
items.desc: Helm made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

items.name: Vinegar
items.desc: Slightly colored liquid with a sharp, pungent aroma. It delivers a sour, tangy taste that is perfectly suited for some of the more elaborate dishes.

items.name: Void Armor
items.desc: Not fully understood in its properties, adding a void drop to an already stable mixture of elements seems to further enhance their properties, giving life to the hardest material known to exist.

items.name: Void Core
items.desc: Unstable core surrounded by a void area where no regular matter can exist.

items.name: Void Crusher
items.desc: An enormous sword, so heavy that it can't be lifted by any human. Imbued with the power of darkness, it deals enormous damage.

items.name: Void Pendant
items.desc: Enhanced with matter of complementary type, the neutral essence constrained in this amulet was enhanced beyond its natural limits. Provides an extremely large boost to experience gain.

items.name: Voltaic Shock
items.desc:
The power of this hook was increased by a core that can amplify and focus the electrical magic simulated within. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

items.name: Voodoo Doll
items.desc: Permeated with an ancient, despicable magic, in the right hands this simple cloth doll could inflict unimaginable suffering to an unaware victim.

items.name: Warden Belt
items.desc: Hard leather belt characterizing the outfit of the wardens of the Golden City.

items.name: Warlord Skull
items.desc: An intact skull of a renowned soldier, once leading it's ranks against the enemy.

items.name: Werewolf Fang
items.desc: Something is really wrong with this tooth…

items.name: White Hair
items.desc: A single, immaculate white hair.

items.name: White Slime
items.desc: A white blob taken from the body of a one of a kind slime deity.

items.name: Wicked Scepter
items.desc: A horrible weapon instinctively repelling all living beings, though no one can explain the cause of this feeling. When the wielder summons a minion, this staff will summon a powerful accessory bound to it.

items.name: Wicked Seal
items.desc: እንደ ላይ እንደ ታች። አሥርቱ ገሃነሞች እንደገና ተከፍተው ይሆናል፣ በመሠዊያችንም እንደ ሁሉም ይበላሉ።

items.name: Wild Egg
items.desc: Egg that will hatch a Wild pet. Wild pets usually provide strategic support to the team, enhancing health management and offensive capabilities.

items.name: Wing Fabric
items.desc: Very light and elastic textile made from the wings of moths.

items.name: Winter Boots
items.desc: Extremely durable boots made with materials found in high altitudes. Confer extra regeneration to the wearer due to the Troll skin present in their weave.

items.name: Winter Cape
items.desc: The peculiar properties of the troll's Wintercloth allows to craft this very light albeit resilient light clothing

items.name: Winter Gloves
items.desc: Gloves that can boost the regeneration of wounds thanks to the oils impregnating their inner side.

items.name: Winter Helm
items.desc: Very hard helm made with uncommon materials, can withstand blows otherwise fatal.

items.name: Winter Shield
items.desc: Very hard but light shield made with metal and wood only found at very high altitudes.

items.name: Wintercloth
items.desc: Despite being a very thin cloth, it isolates almost perfectly from the external cold.

items.name: Winterwood
items.desc: Very sturdy wood from the only tree that can grow in sub-zero temperatures, the Winter Tree.

items.name: Winterwood Bow
items.desc: Superior bow made with the elusive winterwood, shoots arrows with very high strength and precision.

items.name: Winterwood Staff
items.desc: The peculiar properties of the material allows for good magic attunement, making it a prized possession among spellcasters.

items.name: Wood
items.desc: Just a simple piece of wood.

items.name: Wooden Bow
items.desc: A simple bow made of flexible wood

items.name: Wooden Buckler
items.desc: Round, lightweight shield made of wood

items.name: Wooden Egg
items.desc: Egg that will hatch a Wooden pet. Wooden pets like to help the team stay alive, and are rarely keen for harming enemies.

items.name: Wurm Blood
items.desc: Blood drawn from a Wurm. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.

items.name: Wurm Scale
items.desc: Very hard keratin scales covering the body of the desert Wurms. Can be used as plates to reinforce equipment.

items.name: Wurmscales Boots
items.desc: Sturdy boots made with wurm scales.

items.name: Wurmscales Gloves
items.desc: Sturdy gloves made with wurm scales.

items.name: Wurmscales Jacket
items.desc: Made with wurm scales for increased integrity, padded with feathers.

items.name: Wurmscales Shield
items.desc: Round, light shield made from wurm scales.

items.name: Wyvern Cape
items.desc: Enhanced with real Snow Wyvern scales, this robe allows for an enhanced channeling of white magic.

items.name: Wyvern Chop
items.desc: Few people manage to take down a Wyvern, and even fewer manage to bite through its extremely hard meat. The taste is described as very intense, and the meat as extremely nutritious, with a single bite able to sustain a soldier for a day.

items.name: Yoghurt
items.desc: Creamy and smooth milk derivative. White in color, it’s tangy and slightly sour, with a rich, thick consistency that varies from silky to dense.

items.name: Scarlet Bulwark
items.desc: Plates woven from the same divine strands as the Scarlet Veil, hardened into an armor for those who stand in front of the line.

items.name: Scarlet Vestment
items.desc: A robe spun from the divine strands of the Scarlet Veil. The threads hum with power and answer the will of spellcasters and healers.

items.name: Scarlet Citadel
items.desc: The Scarlet Bulwark, mechanically enhanced using the parts of the mysterious Machine. Its plates shift on their own to meet every blow.

items.name: Scarlet Regalia
items.desc: The Scarlet Vestment, mechanically enhanced using the parts of the mysterious Machine. Its threads weave spells and mending on their own.

items.name: Evo01 Vial
items.desc: A refined Celestial serum. This item can change an adventurer main trait (Bookworm, Brute or Feral).

items.name: Evo12 Vial
items.desc: A potent Celestial serum. This item upgrades an adventurer main trait to its "+" version (Bookworm+, Brute+ or Feral+: +15% of the stat, no penalty).

items.name: Evo34 Vial
items.desc: The rarest Celestial serum. This item upgrades an adventurer rare trait to its "+" version: its effect is 10% stronger.

items.name: Paragon Writ
items.desc: A sealed writ of the Celestial court. An ascended adventurer gains the next Paragon rank without resetting their level.

items.name: Azure Strand
items.desc: A heavy thread of the same divine force as the Scarlet Strand, dyed deep blue. It can be spun in the workshop from materials gathered around the Drowned Port and the Shattered Peaks.

items.name: Verdant Strand
items.desc: A light, living thread of the same divine force as the Scarlet Strand, tinted green. It can be spun in the workshop from materials gathered around the Drowned Port and the Shattered Peaks.

items.name: Sha'huri Spear
items.desc: A long desert spear with a leaf-shaped blade. Sha'huri riders use its reach to strike the vultures circling the dunes.

items.name: Boomerang
items.desc: A curved throwing stick of polished wood. It hits what flies and comes back to the hand that threw it.

items.name: War Javelin
items.desc: A long javelin carved from Elysian Wood and tipped with a serpent fang, heavy enough to pierce a Giant Moth in flight.

items.name: Infernal Glaive
items.desc: A crescent blade of Infernite mounted on a throwing haft. Returns to its wielder trailing embers.

items.name: Scarlet Veil Core
items.desc: A knot of Lost Lands hide and Larox thread. Binds four Strands into a Veil.

items.name: Azure Veil Core
items.desc: A knot of Lost Lands hide and Larox thread. Binds four Strands into a Veil.

items.name: Verdant Veil Core
items.desc: A knot of Lost Lands hide and Larox thread. Binds four Strands into a Veil.

strings.accessory_abyssal_compendium_description: A book listing forgotten techniques of spellweaving, learned from eldritch entities at a great price.
strings.accessory_amulet_of_resurrection_descrip: Made from the feathers of a legendary bird, in case of death this amulet will resurrect its owner with full HP and no negative effect, possibly forever.
strings.accessory_amulet_of_the_swordsman_descri: An amulet that allows the wearer to see through it as if it was an additional eye. Gives a new perspective on the fight, allowing for superior decision making.
strings.accessory_ancient_boots_description: Boots sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.
strings.accessory_ancient_eye_description: A gift from a nameless horror.
strings.accessory_ancient_gloves_description: Gloves sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.
strings.accessory_animated_bucker_description: Round shield made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
strings.accessory_animated_helm_description: Helm made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
strings.accessory_archaic_amulet_description: A fiery gem embedded in this pendant attracts wildlife, enhancing the holder's empathy and connection with animals they're close with. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point.
strings.accessory_archmage_hat_description: Extremely powerful, magic-enhancing artifact worn only by Laroxian's Council members.
strings.accessory_banshee_gloves_description: Made from Banshee scales grafted together. Allows for superior protection while granting a great range of movements.
strings.accessory_black_iron_gauntlets_descripti: Gauntlets made of disjointed plates of Black Iron.
strings.accessory_black_iron_helm_description: Resistant helm made with Black Iron.
strings.accessory_bleak_boots_description: Boots made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.
strings.accessory_bleak_gloves_description: Gloves made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.
strings.accessory_burning_censer_description: An otherworldly candle encased in a metal support, anointed with oils that display healing properties.
strings.accessory_burning_effigy_description: A powerful symbol of hope for those it protects, and a relentless torment for its bearer. It compels enemies to focus their attention on the holder, who endures the crushing burden of infinite, searing agony.
strings.accessory_celestial_helmet_description: Helmet crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.
strings.accessory_celestial_shield_description: Shield crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.
strings.accessory_copper_helmet_description: Regular helmet made with copper for some extra protection.
strings.accessory_corrupted_shield_description: The integrity of this shield has been severely impaired by the curse of the Serpent.
strings.accessory_cosmic_violin_description: A violin as old as time itself, played by ancient horrors during their abject rituals.
strings.accessory_cursed_claws_description:
Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, will open a grievous wound on an enemy with the slightest touch. The attack has to be melee for this to happen.
The bleed also applies when the wearer counterattacks in melee.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
strings.accessory_cursed_helm_description: Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, its sharp edges deter any melee attacker, promising devastating wounds to those who dare approach.
strings.accessory_diamond_amulet_description: An elegant amulet adorned with a polished diamond, radiating timeless beauty.
strings.accessory_divine_embryo_description: Painstakingly fed with a concentrated flow of consciousness, slowly the Ancient God is starting to evolve into another form. It is able to manifest additional powers, granting its keeper a wide range of bonuses.
strings.accessory_divine_larvae_description: Fed with the flesh of a nightmare beyond comprehension, the new shell of the Hidden God transformed once more, inching closer to its final form.
strings.accessory_divine_zygote_description: The remains of a being of endless power, who used their last drop of energy to restore its own mortal body into an earlier form. Unable to survive alone, it emanates an energy barrier of unfathomable strength, protecting itself and its keeper from the outside elements.
strings.accessory_djinn_tonic_description: A vial filled with the spirit of a slain Djinn. You do sometimes wonder whether it enjoys being a tasty drink, but the remarkable benefits of a sip now and then easily overshadow any ethical concerns.
strings.accessory_dreamcatcher_description: An ancient accessory enhanced with a ritual by a long lost civilization. It's said to protect from evil spirits, and it provides a great experience gain boost to the wearer.
strings.accessory_dreamwrought_boots_description: Made from a material dreamt and materialized by an otherworldly entity, these boots display surprising properties that can't be replicated with ordinary matter.
strings.accessory_dreamwrought_gloves_descriptio: Made from a material dreamt and materialized by an otherworldly entity, these gloves display surprising properties that can't be replicated with ordinary matter.
strings.accessory_elastic_boots_description: Sewn together using a mysterious membrane, almost unbreakable but able to be stretched beyond ordinary limits.
strings.accessory_eldritch_mitre_description: This unholy relic amplifies one’s understanding of the universe to extraordinary levels, channeling ancient and forbidden powers.
strings.accessory_emerald_ring_description: A silver ring with an inset emerald, a precious stone carrying some magical properties of protective nature.
strings.accessory_enlighted_servant_description: A spark of light and a drop of darkness were infused in this empty shell, gifting it its very own soul. Having now achieved independent thinking, it is not faster, smarter, and capable of improvising in difficult situations.
strings.accessory_eternal_hunger_description: A powerful, ancient artifact. The wearer will never be sated in their hunger, but will gain the innate ability to consume the physical suffering of their enemies.
strings.accessory_exotic_boots_description: Durable but comfortable boots made with soft velvet.
strings.accessory_eye_of_ur_description: A gift from a distant world.
strings.accessory_fleetfoot_boots_description: Boots made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
strings.accessory_fleetfoot_gloves_description: Gloves made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
strings.accessory_flute_description: A finely crafted flute, the work of master artisans from the Golden City.
strings.accessory_frozen_egg_pendant_description: Encapsulates an authentic Frozen Wivern egg. Every ice damage inflicted by the owner will be amplified by the unborn creature still living inside.
strings.accessory_gem_of_protection_description: Stabilized gem that projects a force field, adding a layer of protection on the owner.
strings.accessory_ghastly_shield_description: Shield made on skulls and bones infused with a spectral essence of uncertain origin. Its own will is able to harm melee attackers in ways they can't conceive.
strings.accessory_ghostwood_shield_description: Shield made of ancient, refined ghostwood planks.
strings.accessory_golden_boots_description: Boots made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantry and archers.
strings.accessory_golden_gauntlets_description: Gauntlets made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantry and archers.
strings.accessory_golden_helm_description: Helm made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantrymen.
strings.accessory_golden_shield_description: Shield made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantrymen.
strings.accessory_ignition_orb_description: A river of Aether dances and twists in beautiful patterns inside the orb, contained by a powerful magic. Any caster with a good experience in the field of fire magic can tap into the Aether contained within to increase the temperature of their flames.
strings.accessory_imperial_shield_description: Decorated kite shield employed by the higher generals of the Empire Army. Engineered by the best blacksmiths to provide the highest standards of protection.
strings.accessory_infinity_hat_description: This mysterious headgear came out of a crack in the fabric of space and time. It's both stylish and powerful.
strings.accessory_infused_necklace_description: Necklace infused with a glowing liquid to confer it additional properties. Provides a small experience gain boost to the wearer.
strings.accessory_invisible_servant_description: An invisible sphere summoned upon a small altar, once bound to cosmic powers but now loyal to its owner's will. It can carry out simple tasks, protect its master and unleash powerful attacks. Attacks from this source are always ranged, and magic.
strings.accessory_iron_helm_description: The most common helm worn by regular soldiers.
strings.accessory_jeweled_crown_description: Precious crown made with gold with inset emeralds and rubies. Amplifies the magical shielding properties of these stones to provide protection to vulnerable targets, while signalling the high status of the wearer.
strings.accessory_kabelian_claws_description:
Gloves forged with ancient iron, padded with a metal that shows psyonic capabilities. Vibrates in a way that allows to cut through flesh with extreme ease. The attack has to be melee for the effect to take place.
The bleed also applies when the wearer counterattacks in melee.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
strings.accessory_laroxian_boots_description: Light and resistant boots woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox, and padded with a magical cloth.
strings.accessory_laroxian_gloves_description: Light and resistant gloves woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox, and padded with a magical cloth.
strings.accessory_metamorphic_shield_description: Spikes will come out from this shield when needed, to hurt foes that get too close.
strings.accessory_mithril_helm_description: An incredibly light and resistant helm crafted from the legendary Mithril.
strings.accessory_mithril_shield_description: An incredibly light and resistant shield crafted from the legendary Mithril.
strings.accessory_mitre_hat_description: A head covering traditionally worn by the Golden City priests. This hat, blessed with an ancient ritual exclusive to their creed, amplifies all healing spells cast by the wearer.
strings.accessory_nil_pendant_description: Perfected with the goo taken from a god of the slimes, this amulet will grant an unmatched learning boost to the wearer.
strings.accessory_obsidian_helm_description: A thick helm made of obsidian, extremely hard to break with conventional weapons.
strings.accessory_obsidian_shield_description: Big, heavy shield made in obsidian. Offers a degree of protection vastly superior than the more common ones.
strings.accessory_orichalcum_helm_description: Made from a metal seemingly impossible to destroy, This helm offers unmatched protection to the wearer.
strings.accessory_orichalcum_shield_description: Made from a metal seemingly impossible to destroy, this shield offers unmatched protection to the wearer.
strings.accessory_phylactery_description: An artifact of enormous power, capable of replacing a bound entity in its demise. When held by an unbound entity, however, it greatly boost their ability to regenerate the health of their allies.
strings.accessory_pirate_king_tricorn_descriptio: Hat historically worn by the highest rank pirate captains, whose thirst for blood is legendary. Made with both regular and enchanted velvet, to provide additional offensive bonuses.
strings.accessory_primeval_helm_description: Helm made from the scale of an enormous creature, capable of withstanding the hardest blows without breaking.
strings.accessory_primeval_shield_description: Shield made from the scale of an enormous creature, capable of withstanding the hardest blows without breaking.
strings.accessory_prismatic_pendant_description: Powerful trinket containing the essence of all elements. While not very useful in battle, it provides a very large boost to experience gains.
strings.accessory_ruby_ring_description: A silver ring with an inset ruby, a precious stone carrying some magical properties of protective nature.
strings.accessory_seeking_glass_description: A jewel once worn by the Slime King, ensures perfect accuracy under all conditions.
strings.accessory_sha_description: Finally awakened with enough time and a strict diet, the Hidden God will serve its owner with utmost loyalty.
strings.accessory_shadow_ring_description: A silver ring with an inset Shadow Gem. Grants superior reflexes.
strings.accessory_shield_of_the_martyr_descripti: Awakened by the exalted powder gathered from the Primordial, all this shield knows and craves is pain. It will force enemies to attack its bearer at a much higher frequency.
strings.accessory_shield_of_the_titan_descriptio: An unbreakable shield of unknown making. Forces the holder to feel the sorrow the failed titans in the halls felt, attracting the attention of the surrounding enemies.
strings.accessory_shielding_helm_description: Helm enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.
strings.accessory_short_circuit_description:
Able to reproduce electric magic without tapping into any magic source. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.accessory_silver_ring_description: A simple ring made of silver.
strings.accessory_skeleton_key_description: A strange key adorned with a skull handle. It's very cold to the touch. Looks infused with a powerful curse that amplifies one's power over death.
strings.accessory_skin_blender_description: Glove that replicates the dreaded Banshee strike. Will cut through your foes like a knife through water, inflicting tremendous damage with each strike
strings.accessory_skull_candle_description: An unextinguishable, grim lantern fused to the skull of a great warrior, still alive but harmless in this condition.
strings.accessory_slime_kings_crown_description: The crown of the legendary Slime King. Provides a large amount of extra experience to the wearer.
strings.accessory_spell_compendium_description: A rare book given only to the most powerful Laroxian mages, contains all kinds of spells discovered by their people.
strings.accessory_spider_boots_description: Thanks to the peculiar fabric from which they have been woven, those who wear them can move with extraordinary agility.
strings.accessory_spider_description: A mechanical set of legs operating on alien technology. Can move the user extremely quick, provide an extra layer of protection for the lower part of the body and will even kick nearby enemies.
strings.accessory_spider_gloves_description: Made from the coveted Giant Spider silk, these gloves allow for superior mobility without sacrificing the safety of the wearer.
strings.accessory_spiked_primeval_shield_descrip: An incredibly bulky shield made with the scales of a giant behemoth, can cause considerable damage to any attacker through the sharp tortoise spikes attached.
strings.accessory_spiked_tortoise_shield_descrip: A shield made with a Giant Tortoise shell with spikes attached, offers great defensive capabilities while hurting melee attackers with its razor sharp spikes.
strings.accessory_spirit_tome_description: Otherworldly book found in possession of an ethereal being. Tells of tales from another plane, giving insight into different forms of magic.
strings.accessory_starvation_description: Enhanced with a drop of blood from a legendary individual that sealed the fate of thousand worlds. Inflicts an inconceivable hunger on the wearer, but will allows them to prey even more efficiently on their enemies suffering.
strings.accessory_sylvan_flute_description: An intricate flute, fashioned with a mysterious technique by the reclusive dryads of the Southern Grove.
strings.accessory_tactical_helmet_description: An alien helmet that integrates unknown technology to provide the wearer with far more information that the naked eye can perceive.
strings.accessory_tortoise_shield_description: Heavy, resistant shield made from giant tortoise shells.
strings.accessory_toxin_pouch_description: A small bag holding an extract from the flesh of a poisonous mushroom. While too weak to act on its own, it enhances existing poisons by introducing an additional mechanism of action.
strings.accessory_tusk_necklace_description: Simple ornament made with boar tusks.
strings.accessory_undead_gloves_description: Gloves made with undead remains. A little too sticky, but allows for a good range of movements.
strings.accessory_undead_greaves_description: Sturdy footwear made from undead remains.
strings.accessory_undead_helm_description: Helm made with undead remains. Offers more protection than more traditional ones.
strings.accessory_undead_shield_description: Large shield made with undead remains.
strings.accessory_verdant_boots_description: Boots made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.
strings.accessory_verdant_gloves_description: Gloves made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.
strings.accessory_verdant_helm_description: Helm made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.
strings.accessory_void_pendant_description: Enhanced with matter of complementary type, the neutral essence constrained in this amulet was enhanced beyond its natural limits. Provides an extremely large boost to experience gain.
strings.accessory_voltaic_shock_description:
The power of this hook was increased by a core that can amplify and focus the electrical magic simulated within. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.accessory_winter_boots_description: Extremely durable boots made with materials found in high altitudes. Confer extra regeneration to the wearer due to the Troll skin present in their weave.
strings.accessory_winter_gloves_description: Gloves that can boost the regeneration of wounds thanks to the oils impregnating their inner side.
strings.accessory_winter_helm_description: Very hard helm made with uncommon materials, can withstand blows otherwise fatal.
strings.accessory_winter_shield_description: Very hard but light shield made with metal and wood only found at very high altitudes.
strings.accessory_wooden_buckler_description: Round, lightweight shield made of wood
strings.accessory_wurmscales_boots_description: Sturdy boots made with wurm scales.
strings.accessory_wurmscales_gloves_description: Sturdy gloves made with wurm scales.
strings.accessory_wurmscales_shield_description: Round, light shield made from wurm scales.
strings.active_annihilate_description: Strikes all units for 1000% damage. Range is always melee.
strings.active_arcane_barrage_description: Shoots 12 magic missiles at random enemies, each dealing 100% damage
strings.active_arcane_diffusion_description: Deals 40% magic damage to all enemies. Applies on hit status effects.
strings.active_arcane_strike_description: Deals 400% damage to a random enemy.
strings.active_at_the_stake_description:
Deals 20% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for 4 turns.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_backstab_i_description:
Stabs an enemy.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5
strings.active_backstab_ii_description:
Stabs an enemy.
Critical hit bonus damage × 2
strings.active_backstab_iii_description:
Stabs an enemy.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3
strings.active_barrage_i_description: Fires an arrow at 2 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_ii_description: Fires an arrow at 3 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_iii_description: Fires an arrow at 4 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_iv_description: Fires an arrow at 5 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_v_description: Fires an arrow at 6 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_vi_description: Fires an arrow at 7 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_vii_description: Fires an arrow at 9 random enemies
strings.active_barrage_viii_description: Fires an arrow at 11 random enemies
strings.active_bounce_description:
Bounces 10 times, dealing 50% damage to a random enemy each time and STUNNING them for 4 turns.

STUN: the unit skips its turn A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_choking_powder_description:
SILENCES every enemy for 3 turns, then deal 40% damage.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.active_condemn_all_i_description:
SILENCE all enemies for 1 turn, then strikes them for 250% damage.

SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.active_condemn_all_ii_description:
SILENCE all enemies for 2 turn, then strikes them for 250% damage.

SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.active_condemn_description:
SILENCE an enemy for 1 turn, then strikes it for 250% damage.

SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.active_curse_i_description: Bursts an enemy for 300% damage and inflicts LESSER CURSE on them. LESSER CURSE: When the unit dies, a Zombie spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 25% max HP decay per turn. Each summoner keeps one minion; a party holds at most 2 minions in a dungeon and 3 in a raid.
strings.active_curse_ii_description:
Bursts an enemy for 325% damage and inflicts CURSE on them.

CURSE: When the unit dies, a Skeleton spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 25% max HP decay per turn and is twice as likely to be chosen as target. Each summoner keeps one minion; a party holds at most 2 minions in a dungeon and 3 in a raid.
strings.active_curse_iii_description:
Bursts an enemy for 350% damage and inflicts GREATER CURSE on them.

GREATER CURSE: When the unit dies, a Bone Horror spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 25% max HP decay per turn and is three times as likely to be chosen as target. Each summoner keeps one minion; a party holds at most 2 minions in a dungeon and 3 in a raid.
strings.active_curse_iv_description:
Bursts an enemy for 375% damage and inflicts OMINOUS CURSE on them.

OMINOUS CURSE: When the unit dies, a Bone Nightmare spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 25% max HP decay per turn, is three times as likely to be chosen as target and has a 35% counterattack chance. Each summoner keeps one minion; a party holds at most 2 minions in a dungeon and 3 in a raid.
strings.active_curse_v_description:
Bursts 2 enemies for 400% damage and inflicts ABHORRENT CURSE on them.

ABHORRENT CURSE: When the unit dies, a Bone Hydra spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 25% max HP decay per turn, is three times as likely to be chosen as target, has a 35% counterattack chance and deals 50 physical retaliation damages to melee attackers. Each summoner keeps one minion; a party holds at most 2 minions in a dungeon and 3 in a raid.
strings.active_daze_description:
Deals 10% magic damage to all enemies and STUNS them for 2 turns.
STUN: the unit skips its turn A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_decimate_i_description:
Strikes all enemies for 300% damage. Then, each has 70% chance of being STUNNED.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_decimate_ii_description:
Strikes all enemies for 300% damage, then STUNS them.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_decimate_iii_description:
Strikes all enemies for 400% damage, then STUNS them.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_desert_judgement_description: Attacks 4 random enemies, with each attack doing 150% damage
strings.active_devour_spirit_description:
Deals 20% damage to all enemies, then TERRIFIES them for 1 turn.

TERRIFY: The unit skips its turn and takes 20% max hp as magic damage.
strings.active_disassemble_description:
TAUNTS all enemies for 5 turns. Then, they are dealt 10% damage

TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.active_disembody_description: Deals 7777 magic damage to all enemies. Cannot be dodged.
strings.active_dream_forge_description: Heals itself for 10000 HP. Then, forges 10 cosmic blades that descend on random enemies, dealing 200% damage.
strings.active_eclipse_i_description:
Stabs the lowest health enemy. Instantly recasts on enemy kill.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3
strings.active_eclipse_ii_description:
Stabs the lowest health enemy, executing them if health is reduced to 10% or less. Instantly recasts on enemy kill.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3
strings.active_eclipse_iii_description:
Stabs the lowest health enemy, executing them if health is reduced to 20% or less. Instantly recasts on enemy kill.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3
strings.active_eclipse_iv_description:
Stabs the lowest health enemy, executing them if health is reduced to 25% or less. Instantly recasts on enemy kill.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3
strings.active_en_garde_description:
Gains DEFENSIVE STANCE, then strikes an enemy for 200% damage.

DEFENSIVE STANCE: the next time the unit would receive damage, it takes none and this effect is removed
strings.active_extirpate_description: Strikes all units for 3000% damage. Range is always melee.
strings.active_feint_description:
Feigns a movement and strikes unexpectedly, dealing 100% damage and STUNNING an enemy for 1 turn.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_fire_burst_description:
Bursts an enemy for 200% damage and sets it ABLAZE for one turn.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_fire_dance_description:
Sets himself ABLAZE for 3 turns. Advances the Fire Ritual progress by 1.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn.
strings.active_fireball_description:
Deals 200% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for one turn.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_flay_description: Strikes a unit for 1000% damage. Range is always melee.
strings.active_fleece_description:
Deals 35% physical damage to all enemies. Applies BLEED 40 on hit.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
strings.active_flintlock_shot_description:
Deals 200% damage to a random enemy and set them ABLAZE.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_focused_barrage_description: Fires two arrows at each enemy, with 50% reduced damage (25% for Corrosive Wraith).
strings.active_fragmentation_description: Loses 5000 HP. Then, shoots 5 marble splinters at random enemies, each dealing 100% damage. Heal for 1000 HP for every fragment that hits the target. Caster's HP can't be reduced below 1 with this ability.
strings.active_frozen_breath_description:
Deals 100% damage to all enemies. Then, FREEZES them for 2 turns.

FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_gravity_shift_description: Quickly changes its mass distribution to generate a wave that deals 50% damage to all enemies.
strings.active_heal_description: Heals the ally with the lowest health for 100% damage
strings.active_ice_tomb_description:
Deals 1000% damage to a random enemy. Then, FREEZES it for 10 turns.

FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_incinerate_description:
Sets all enemies ABLAZE for 1 turn and deals 200% damage to them.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_incinerate_ii_description:
Sets all enemies ABLAZE for 1 turn and deals 300% damage to them.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_instill_terror_description:
Bends the minds of all enemies, having a chance to STUN them equal to the amount of darkness. Then, deals 15% magic damage to them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_lights_out_description: Deals 10x damage to the lowest health enemy.
strings.active_live_test_description:
POISONS every enemy for 3 turns, then deals 5% damage to them.

POISON: damage reduced by 20%
strings.active_mass_heal_ii_description:
Heals every ally for 100% damage, then grants them REGENERATION for 2 turns

REGENERATION: when its turn starts, the unit heals for 6% of its max HP
strings.active_mass_heal_iii_description:
Heals every ally for 115% damage, then grants them REGENERATION for 3 turns

REGENERATION: when its turn starts, the unit heals for 6% of its max HP
strings.active_meteor_i_description: Deals 230% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for one turn. ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_meteor_ii_description:
Deals 230% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for 2 turns.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_obliterate_description: Strikes all units for 2000% damage. Range is always melee.
strings.active_overdrive_description:
If a Magic Armor is present, deals 300 damage to it and launches its components towards the enemies, stunning them for 1 turn and dealing 70% magic damage. The Magic Armor HP cannot be reduced below 1.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_overwhelm_description:
Strikes an enemy for 300% damage. Then, it has 70% chance of being STUNNED.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_pandemonium_description: Deals 75% physical damage to all enemies.
strings.active_petrifying_melody_description:
Plays a string of notes with his lute, dealing 100% damage and PETRIFYING an enemy for 1 turn.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5.
This ability is always ranged.

PETRIFY: This unit can't dodge, takes 15% increased damage and skips its turn.
strings.active_protect_the_weak_description:
TAUNTS all enemies for 2 turns. Then, they are dealt 10% damage

TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.active_quicksand_grasp_description:
Deal double damage. The target is then silenced for 4 turns

SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana.
strings.active_restoration_i_description:
Heals every ally for 115% damage with a 4% chance to resurrect them, then grants them REGENERATION for 3 turns

REGENERATION: when its turn starts, the unit heals for 6% of its max HP
strings.active_restoration_ii_description:
Heals every ally for 130% damage with a 6% chance to resurrect them, then grants them REGENERATION for 3 turns

REGENERATION: when its turn starts, the unit heals for 6% of its max HP
strings.active_sacrifice_description: Makes an offering to the Great Serpent.
strings.active_sandstorm_description:
Enemies have 80% chance of being SILENCED for 5 turns. Then, they are dealt 50% damage

SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.active_smash_description: Smashes the ground, dealing 50% damage to all enemies.
strings.active_soothing_winds_description:
Enemies have a 60% probability of being stunned for 3 turns. Then, they are dealt 100% damage

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_static_surge_description:
Deals 250% damage to all enemies. Then, they have 50% chance of being stunned for one turn

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_stomp_description:
Stomps the ground, dealing damage to all enemies and stunning them for 1 turn

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_sublimate_description:
Sets all enemies ABLAZE for 1 turn and deals 170% damage to them. Then, FREEZE all enemies for 2 turns and deals 170% damage to them.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_tabula_rasa_description:
Deals 50% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for 2 turns.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_taunt_i_description:
TAUNTS an enemy for 2 turns, then strikes it for 200% damage.

TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.active_taunt_ii_description:
TAUNTS an enemy for 4 turns, then strikes it for 200% damage.

TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.active_taunt_iii_description:
TAUNTS an enemy for 8 turns, then strikes it for 200% damage.

TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.active_taunt_iv_description:
TAUNTS an enemy for 8 turns, then strikes it for 600% damage.

TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.active_the_ten_hells_description: Casts all enemies into a forgotten realm, killing them instantly.
strings.active_thousand_cuts_description:
Stabs an enemy and applies a charges of BLEED for every 3 damage dealt.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3.

BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
strings.active_thousand_cuts_ii_description:
Stabs an enemy and applies a charges of BLEED for every 2 damage dealt.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3.

BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
strings.active_umbral_strike_i_description:
Stabs an enemy for [200% × (1 + Darkness/100)] damage.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5
strings.active_umbral_strike_ii_description:
Stabs an enemy for [500% × (1 + Darkness/100)] damage.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5
strings.active_umbral_strike_iii_description:
Stabs an enemy for [600% × (1 + Darkness/100)] damage.
Critical hit bonus damage × 2
strings.active_whip_and_tear_description: Strikes all units for 3000% damage. Range is always melee. Then, whips a surviving enemy for 3000% damage.
strings.ad_dialog_body:
Do you want to watch an ad for 5 Gems?

Ads watched today: %d/5
strings.ad_free_dialog_body: Thank you for unlocking the ad free version!
strings.adventurer_adept_description: A novice who just started to grasp the potential of his gift. His limited knowledge undermines the control over his magic.
strings.adventurer_alchemist_description: A gifted archer fascinated by the nature of her concoctions, who decided to focus on the study of Thaumaturgy: replicating magic through scientific means.
strings.adventurer_ancient_lich_description: Long forgotten by death itself, this Lich survived for eons in a remote corner of the realms, his powers over death growing to unfathomable strength.
strings.adventurer_angel_description: Heralds of the Gods of Light, only the most exceptional and selfless healers can ascend through the divine ranks. They are said to operate in mysterious ways, and even to be able to bring back fallen soldiers from certain death.
strings.adventurer_angel_of_war_description: The feared and revered leader of the Holy Temple, he shapes its doctrine and commands its followers. He must possess the strength to resist all forms of magical and political influence as he wages war against the very source of evil, defeating eldritch gods before they can tighten their hold on the human realms.
strings.adventurer_apprentice_description: Untrained in the art of combat, he possesses the spark of something he can't explain yet. Ever since he saw it, he searched for ways to improve his understanding.
strings.adventurer_archangel_description: Archangel are divine beings of pure light, embodying hope in the darkest corners of the Realms. Ancient chronicles tell of these powerful beings descending from the sky, restoring entire armies and turning the tide of decisive battles.
strings.adventurer_archer_description: Armed with a bow and arrows, she provides reliable long-range support, delivering shots to hurt enemies from a distance.
strings.adventurer_assassin_description: Masters of deception, these individuals are often employed by noble families to discreetly remove troublesome opponents.
strings.adventurer_balrog_description: The unrestrained embodiment of Chaos, feared even by powerful Gods. This natural force wreaks havoc in the mortal lands as in the depths of hell, often having entire armies failing to stop its march.
strings.adventurer_bard_description: A master entertainer who can play music to heal, harm, or drive soldiers into a holy fury. Used to resort to any means to survive, this traveling storyteller offensive capabilities should not be underestimated, either.
strings.adventurer_black_idol_description: A Lich ascended to his ultimate form. Though his body remains a mere withered shell, the spirit of this dark mage has grown immensely powerful. He can wield magic to shape the world around him and summon horrors beyond imagination.
strings.adventurer_black_regent_description: Fueled solely by his lust for power, this brilliant strategist has transformed his kingdom into a war machine, poised to subjugate neighboring states—whether opposing or neutral—to seize the resources needed for his expansion. With no regard for life and an insatiable hunger for dominance, he poses a grave threat to the peace and stability of the Realms if left unchecked.
strings.adventurer_blight_description: Feared even by the most prepared armies, she can render a whole fortress defenseless with a few, accurate shots at its defending troops.
strings.adventurer_celestial_rain_description: A legendary archer that defies the most basic laws of nature. Every arrow crackles with raw energy as it hits the target with extreme force, and her sole presence on the battlefield denies to entire armies the possibility of an open field attack.
strings.adventurer_cleric_description: After years of magic studies, the Cleric has a solid grasp of healing magic. He is a solid staple of any exploration team of adventurers.
strings.adventurer_corrosive_wraith_description: The poison coursing through her veins has somehow mutated into an even more potent form without harming its host. This unique toxin is stronger, unlike any other, and can only exist through this rare symbiosis. When these creatures defy the law of the land, they are hunted relentlessly—and often, unsuccessfully.
strings.adventurer_cutthroat_description: Strong and nimble, he stealthily closes in on unsuspecting targets to strike them with considerable force.
strings.adventurer_dark_knight_description: A knight who has forsaken the path of law, now only loyal to his own principles.
strings.adventurer_dark_sorcerer_description: Having abandoned the path of knowledge for that of corruption, this mage seeks power not through endless studies and practice, but through communion with evil beings trying to influence the world for their nefarious purposes.
strings.adventurer_death_knight_description: Inspiring fear as he roams the lands, the Death Knight relentlessly obliterates any obstacle that lies in the path of his objectives.
strings.adventurer_demilich_description: In the self-destructive path to become a master of the undead, the necromancer has to face power beyond the mortal's imagination, and resist their corruption. Flesh begins to decompose, as he realizes that the price to pay for the control over Death is eternal suffering.
strings.adventurer_demon_description: Awakening from the initial torpor, the inhabitant of this body grasps the rules of this reality and breaks free from its cradle. It obeys no master, and its disgust for earthly creatures weakness only grows with time.
strings.adventurer_divine_champion_description: Untouchable by most conventional and magical weapons, this divine warrior wields a sword with lightning speed, deflecting both arrows and spells alike. He is the champion of choice to face any adversary, even those of divine power.
strings.adventurer_divine_duelist_description: A duelist of unmatched skill in single combat, this warrior—born perhaps once in a generation—wields a sword so swift that his strikes are over before they’re even seen, cutting down opponents with imperceptible speed.
strings.adventurer_drake_rider_description: Only legendary riders could hope to ever tame a drake and learn how to ride it. This deadly duo will ignite the battlefield while hunting down the few survivors with deadly arrows.
strings.adventurer_eidolon_description: An ethereal embodiment of divine melody, wielding godlike power to protect his allies, able to rally armies to reshape whole kingdoms.
strings.adventurer_eldritch_alchemist_descriptio: Transcending the border between mortal and divine, her potions incorporate an eldritch god's blessing, obtained through arcane means and without its knowledge.
strings.adventurer_elemental_alchemist_descripti: A brilliant mind who devoted her life to the study of Thaumaturgy, she has successfully replicated elemental magic in her potions using only natural ingredients and chemical processes.
strings.adventurer_esoteric_alchemist_descriptio: This masterful alchemist not only succeeded in harnessing the power of the elements in her creations but also infused them with blessings typically linked to benevolent deities.
strings.adventurer_eternal_fortress_description: A legendary warrior whose armor is unbreakable by conventional means. Able to duel with mortals and deities, able to withstand an unreal amount of damage before even flinching.
strings.adventurer_fire_wizard_description: Amids the journey of discovery, the Fire Wizard learned to channel magic to emulate natural forces. Being the most dangerous of them all, he choose fire as the object of his studies.
strings.adventurer_footman_description: A novice infantry unit. Lacks experience, but has received a brief training in the Royal Army.
strings.adventurer_fury_description: With a rare mastery of the bow, she makes death rain on the battlefield in the form of the deadliest of arrows.
strings.adventurer_golden_rider_description: This fearsome archer rides one of the last remaining Golden Drakes, a nearly extinct subspecies of the more common drake. Distinguished by its brilliant golden scales, the Golden Drake boasts greater strength and a fiercer, hotter flame than its kin.
strings.adventurer_guard_description: Specialized in the surveillance of civilians or places of interest, guards are widely employed for the protection of sensitive objectives.
strings.adventurer_hailstorm_description: Having developed an almost superhuman ability with her weapon, she hails arrows on enemy armies with such a speed that surviving is almost impossible
strings.adventurer_heavenly_cantor_description: A divine musician able to change the fate of a war through his instrument. Not only he will empower his allies, but through a uniquely crafted music, he will make them immune to pain.
strings.adventurer_hellish_sculptor_description: Half way between assassin and artist, he draws his target ever closer to death with each strike—leaving behind hauntingly beautiful tributes to Death itself in his wake.
strings.adventurer_holy_knight_description: A knight devoted to the service of the Holy Temple, he is a protector of the righteous and a vanguard of justice, sworn to eradicate evil from every corner of the land.
strings.adventurer_horse_rider_description: An archer who shifted the focus of her training to horse riding. Blends the danger of long-range attacks with the ability to deal melee damage with her ride.
strings.adventurer_huntress_description: Refining her skills with her hunting experience in the wilderness, she can hit enemies with reliable shots.
strings.adventurer_hurricane_description: This archer of unnatural precision is a coveted asset for any army. She can fend off a full-scale assault for hours, and can be reached only by sacrificing an enormous number of soldiers.
strings.adventurer_infernal_lord_description: Ascending through infernal ranks through its ruthlessness and cruelty, an Infernal Lord walking the realms is a threat that brings enemy kingdoms together in a desperate effort to prevent the entire world's descent into chaos.
strings.adventurer_infernal_prince_description: Rising from the ashes of conquest and tempered by the fires of countless battles, the Infernal Prince commands legions with a fearsome authority unmatched in the infernal realms. Now no longer a commander but a true sovereign of terror, the Infernal Prince stands as an unstoppable force, against whom resistance is little more than a fleeting hope.
strings.adventurer_inferno_description: An incredibly powerful, mystical able to invoke firestorms out of thin air, burning entire armies to ashes while meteor falls upon them. An army that can reliably protect him is an army that can win any battle.
strings.adventurer_inquisitor_description: As feared as he is respected, the Inquisitor's might is rarely matched. He stands as the supreme lawgiver, overseeing the realms conquered by the Holy Temple.
strings.adventurer_iron_defender_description: An enormous warden capable of withstanding a substantial amount of damage before succumbing.
strings.adventurer_iron_warden_description: A seasoned guard rich in experience, clad in a heavy armor.
strings.adventurer_juggernaut_description: A rare sight in the battlefield, these armored giants can easily shrug off strikes from siege weapons with ease.
strings.adventurer_justiciar_description: The Justiciar serves as the Holy Temple’s arbiter, enforcing laws that everyone—from peasants to kings—must obey to avoid incurring the Temple's wrath. A formidable warrior, he leads crusades against evil tyrants and unholy creatures that threaten the Realms.
strings.adventurer_kings_hand_description: The king's personal guard. Wreaks havoc during unrests, and singlehandedly guarantees His Majesty safety against any threat.
strings.adventurer_knight_description: Renowned for their steadfast loyalty and honor, they provide a first line for their allies while overpowering their foes.
strings.adventurer_lich_description: Through extraordinary willpower, the Lich endured his transformation for decades, without surrendering to the pain until only bare bones remained. Since muscles and tendons are long gone, this shell of a human is animated entirely by magic.
strings.adventurer_light_disciple_description: An inexperienced mage who tries to expand his knowledge towards a branch of magic that does not hurt foes, but help allies.
strings.adventurer_lord_of_decay_description: A demigod who mastered the control over death, capable of summoning terrifying monsters never seen before.
strings.adventurer_lorekeeper_description: The stories known by this keeper of ancient wisdom are almost endless. Drawing upon myths and legends, he channels forgotten magic through his instrument notes.
strings.adventurer_marksman_description: Rigorous training coupled with a keen vision blessed the Marksman with a perfect aim, even in the most hostile conditions.
strings.adventurer_meat_carver_description: Working like a seasoned sculptor he meticolously shapes his creation, one precise strike after another. The final outcome is a grim tribute to death itself.
strings.adventurer_melting_elder_description: His blood and flesh turned into elemental fire. This incredibly powerful caster incinerates his enemies with a single gesture.
strings.adventurer_minstrel_description: A gifted performer whose melodies inspire allies and mislead foes, turning the tides of a battle with a song or a whispered word.
strings.adventurer_necromancer_description: Gifted with the magic of decay, antithesis of all that is holy. The Necromancer spells corrupt the flesh of his enemies and condemns them to an afterlife of servitude.
strings.adventurer_night_blade_description: He adapted to darkness like a nocturnal animal. Campfire stories about them can make the night uneasy for any exploration team in foreign lands.
strings.adventurer_night_lament_description: Halfway between mortal and divine, entire cults were born to worship this force of death. Its presence in the darkness is revealed only by the laments of its victims.
strings.adventurer_night_specter_description: Blending seamlessly with the night's terrain, in the cover of darkness, no human stands a chance against his ambush.
strings.adventurer_night_terror_description: Ancient myths speak of Night Terrors, and how entire villages could vanish overnight because the wrong person was crossed.
strings.adventurer_night_veil_description: Indistinguishable from the shadows that envelop its prey, every enemy—no matter how powerful—falls before they even sense its approach.
strings.adventurer_overlord_description: A ruthless ruler who respects no laws but his own. He will stop at nothing to eliminate his enemies and conquer rival kingdoms.
strings.adventurer_paladin_description: An elite warrior of the Holy Temple, a beacon of light to the oppressed, upholds and enforces the laws of the kingdom.
strings.adventurer_plague_spreader_description: Equipped with one of the strongest venom known to humanity, she can propagate deadly illnesses among the enemy ranks.
strings.adventurer_poison_bow_description: An expert archer who studied the art of poison mixing, she imbues her arrows with an unknown substance capable of weakening enemies.
strings.adventurer_radiant_elder_description: Blessed with ancient knowledge and divine powers, few recorded instances of Radiant Elders are present in history books. They are exceptional healers, said to be able to bring anyone back from the brink of death.
strings.adventurer_red_archmage_description: Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. Decades of training made this mage able to effortlessly wield fire magic to set his enemies ablaze.
strings.adventurer_red_elder_description: Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. The Red Elder conjure meteors above the enemy ranks, dealing tremendous damage in a large area.
strings.adventurer_red_mage_description: An experienced mage who can harness his powers to hurl fireballs into the enemy ranks. Can be often found in the ranks of defending armies, being a deterrent for any aggressor choosing to invade through an open field.
strings.adventurer_red_stalker_description: A master of lethality, he waits for the best moment to strike with incredible precision inflicting a grievous wound that hardly heals.
strings.adventurer_rogue_description: An outcast who resorts to petty crimes to survive. Lacking in strength and cunning, he compensates with his streetwise knowledge and resourcefulness.
strings.adventurer_royal_captain_description: The most skilled swordsman serving the royal family ascends to the role of Captain, overseeing palace security and determining the strategic tactics to be employed.
strings.adventurer_royal_guard_description: Commonly found in noble houses and palaces, these guards offer a balanced blend of offensive and defensive capabilities.
strings.adventurer_royal_swordsman_description: Highly trained in the art of swordsmanship, these guards are usually assigned to the protection of royal families and their palace.
strings.adventurer_scorching_elder_description: A mythological entity who became one with the flame. The Scorched Elder conjures searing flames so powerful they can melt rocks, and crushes his enemies with the strength of a small star.
strings.adventurer_scourge_description: A force of nature capable of reshaping the borders of kingdoms. It's said his devastating strikes can annihilate entire legions.
strings.adventurer_shadow_crawler_description: Specialized in concealment within the shadows, the Shadow Crawler can be very hard to hit in dark areas
strings.adventurer_shadow_dancer_description: Uses darkness as his hideout, and strike enemies when they least expect it.
strings.adventurer_silver_tongue_description: A persuasive manipulator who bends hearts and minds, able to inspire his allies and push them over their limits.
strings.adventurer_spire_acolyte_description: Acolytes, as full-fledged members of the Spire, have mastered the organization's secret technique. They are pivotal agents dispatched across the Realms, ensuring no target is beyond the reach of the Spire.
strings.adventurer_spire_initiate_description: The Spire, an age-old clandestine organization, recruits only the realm's most skilled assassins. Its select few members wield profound influence over the political landscape of kingdoms, capable of eliminating virtually any target with a secretive technique known solely to them.
strings.adventurer_spire_leader_description: Upon the passing of the former Spire leader, often under circumstances far from the natural, the most experienced Acolyte is entrusted with assuming their role, and the organization's deepest secrets are revealed to them. Deployed only for exceptionally difficult tasks, and throughout history, they have been credited with toppling rulers and deities alike.
strings.adventurer_spire_sage_description: Spire Sages are those who advance the lethal techniques of the spire assassins. New Sages may not emerge for centuries, as the cynical resolve needed to pursue such knowledge is extremely uncommon.
strings.adventurer_spirit_engraver_description: This one-of-a-kind assassin, gifted with unparalleled skill, can strike at the very essence of a being's consciousness, reaching beyond mere flesh. No living creature, mortal or divine, is safe from his dark art.
strings.adventurer_spitfang_rider_description: Displaying an incredible riding ability, Spitfang Riders managed to tame the fearsome Spitfang Snakes, a fearsome beast that can attack from a distance.
strings.adventurer_sureshot_description: A master of archery, a Sureshot with a good positioning can take out even small groups of enemies all by herself.
strings.adventurer_tempest_description: Bane of invading armies, the Tempest will haul barrages of arrows shot with devastating strength and precision, singlehandedly defending strategic hideouts from entire regiments.
strings.adventurer_templar_description: Among the strongest crusaders of the Holy Temple, the Templar serves as a commander of the vanguard that enforces the law in undiscovered lands.
strings.adventurer_thief_description: A nimble outlaw whose skills are invaluable for detecting dangers well in advance.
strings.adventurer_titan_description: An unbreakable warrior, renowned for traversing the chaos of battle unscathed. Whole armies have attempted, yet failed, to inflict even the slightest injury upon him.
strings.adventurer_toxic_stalker_description: The Toxic Stalker has perfected her art of creating deadly toxins, and can severely disrupt the activity of unaware hostile entities.
strings.adventurer_trickster_description: A cunning rogue who thrives on deception, adept at distracting foes and seizing unexpected opportunities in the chaos of battle.
strings.adventurer_tyrant_description: A leader capable of unspeakable evil, he stands as the unrivaled champion in realms where only the mightiest prevail.
strings.adventurer_unchained_description: Most of those who aspire to become a Lich through the forgotten rituals realize too late they cannot pay the price required. The necromancer who begs for the release of death is confronted with a grim offer: his mortal body as an instrument for the entities he communed with.
strings.adventurer_undying_bastion_description: A walking, impenetrable fortress clad in unbreakable battle gear. Deployed in epic battles to stabilize the frontline on newly conquered lands, he is able to withstand a full charge from opposing armies alone.
strings.adventurer_warrior_description: An infantry unit with some experience in the battlefield. Warriors constitutes the bulk of regular armies.
strings.adventurer_whisper_description: Mythological beings from whom the Spire assassins appear to draw their powers, they exist on the boundary between realms, slaying their prey through mysterious means.
strings.adventurer_white_archmage_description: Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. With their exceptional mastery of white magic, White Archmages are strategic units that can turn the tides of a battle.
strings.adventurer_white_elder_description: Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. White elders unleash an unending stream of healing, making any frontline extremely resilient.
strings.adventurer_white_mage_description: Widely used in the ranks of any army, white mages divisions provide reliable healing from the backlines to the most exposed soldiers.
strings.adventurer_wolf_rider_description: Not indicated for beginner riders, wolves provide a formidable companion that can viciously bite enemies already overwhelmed by arrows.
strings.adventurer_worg_rider_description: An extremely vicious beast, the worg will tear apart the flesh of its enemies while his rider shoots with deadly aim.
strings.adventurer_wounds_weaver_description: Unparalleled in the knowledge of anatomy, his enemies are a living canvas to him. While victim's realization rises with each stroke, his art comes to life while life comes to an end.
strings.adventurer_wraith_description: Gradually altered by constant exposure to various toxins, she has developed complete immunity to poison. This venomous demon slips through enemy towns under cover of night, hidden in shadows, leaving soldiers helpless before the coming invasion.
strings.adventurer_wyrm_rider_description: Wyrms are colossal, legendary creatures famed for the chaos they unleash in myths and folklore. These magical beasts possess elemental breath powerful enough to level entire towns, which led to them being relentlessly hunted in centuries past. No human has ever been known to ride a wyrm—except, perhaps, in the tales told by bards.
strings.adventurers_dialog_confirm_ascension_mes:
Are you sure you want to ascend %s?

After the ascension they will revert to a %s and they will require double experience to level up, but they will gain:

• Base HP, Constitution, Dexterity, Intelligence increased by 50%%

• Increased max drinkable potions

• Access to Doctrines
