If you promote this adventurer, the %s exploration will be interrupted.
strings.all_ads_watched_dialog_body:
You watched all the ads for today.
As a gift, here are 10 extra Gems!
strings.armor_heavy_absolute_zero_description:
The coldest material ever forged makes up an armor that not only is incredibly resilient, but will FREEZE enemies on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.armor_heavy_ancient_armor_description: Extremely durable armor made with the hardest known metal, lined with remains of prehistoric giants.
strings.armor_heavy_animated_cuirass_description: Heavy armor made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
strings.armor_heavy_armor_of_the_dryad_descripti: Incorporates a single, long Dryad hair that works as a powerful, permanent healing spell.
strings.armor_heavy_armor_of_the_undying_descrip: A forbidden artifact used to defy death merged with ancient, cursed metal. Serves as a decoy for the life of the wearer, restoring it with an enhanced version of the regular status every time they are hurt.
strings.armor_heavy_black_iron_armor_description: Very hard plates made with the pirate's Black Iron make this armor difficult to break.
strings.armor_heavy_celestial_armor_description: Armor made with alien Celestial Metal. Its superior properties grant an increase in protection from almost any armor crafted with metals found in the Realms.
strings.armor_heavy_champion_armor_description: Further enhanced with part of the soul of the Primordial titan, this armor reached a perfect attunement with the wearer's mind.
strings.armor_heavy_copper_armor_description: A heavy armor made of copper held together with leather straps.
strings.armor_heavy_dreamwrought_armor_descripti: Heavy armor made from a metal dreamt by a powerful being. Its ethereal nature makes it less hard than its alternatives, but allows far more mobility.
strings.armor_heavy_duelist_armor_description: Living armor in a synchronic communication with the wearer's mind, greatly enhancing their reaction times.
strings.armor_heavy_fleetfoot_armor_description: Heavy armor padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
strings.armor_heavy_frostmetal_armor_description: The hardest frostmetal coupled with trollskin paddings give this armor an extreme durability, while gifting the wearer with an increased regeneration.
strings.armor_heavy_frozen_embrace_description:
Enhanced with powerful ice magic, every attacker who touch this armor will be feeling its freezing nature.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.armor_heavy_ghastly_cuirass_description: Heavy chest armor infused with an otherworldly substance, able to attract the enemies attention.
strings.armor_heavy_golden_armor_description: Standard, high quality equipment issued to the Empire Army soldiers.
strings.armor_heavy_ice_cage_description:
Incredibly hard and cold armor enhanced with rare reagents from the coldest mountains of the Realm. Will FREEZE attackers on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.armor_heavy_iron_chainmail_description: Iron rings woven together to confer basic protection in battle.
strings.armor_heavy_kabelian_armor_description: Armor donned by the leaders of the Crusade from the Eastern Kingdom, radiating light into the darkest corners of the Realms.
strings.armor_heavy_metamorphic_armor_descriptio: Shapeshifting spikes poke out from this armor when needed, orienting themselves towards attackers.
strings.armor_heavy_nil_armor_description: An incredibly resistant armor, coated with the flesh of a Slime God. Will grant an unmatched protection to the wearer.
strings.armor_heavy_obsidian_cuirass_description: Very heavy chest armor that grants the wearer with the highest levels of protection.
strings.armor_heavy_orichalcum_armor_description: Incredibly resistant armor made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal. While this material offers the best available protection, It may limit the wearer's mobility.
strings.armor_heavy_patrician_armor_description: A golden armor adorned with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur, worn in social occasions by high ranking generals and diplomats.
strings.armor_heavy_primeval_armor_description: Armor plated with the scales of an enormous behemoth, extremely heavy but capable of withstanding devastating blows.
strings.armor_heavy_prismatic_armor_description: Combines different types of elemental magic to provide an unbreakable defense, while neutering their individual elemental properties.
strings.armor_heavy_sage_armor_description: Armor enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.
strings.armor_heavy_shielding_cuirass_descriptio: Heavy armor enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.
strings.armor_heavy_slime_armor_description: Protective armor made with sticky, green slime that can dissipate the force of any impact, lowering their effectiveness.
strings.armor_heavy_spiked_skeleton_description: The skeleton of an undead monster, studded with very sharp spikes.
strings.armor_heavy_swarmkeeper_armor_descriptio: An ethereal swarm inhabits this armor, and will chew at the flesh of any enemy getting close enough.
strings.armor_heavy_tortoise_armor_description: Heavy armor made with the thick, resilient shell of a large tortoise.
strings.armor_heavy_undead_cuirass_description: Heavy chest armor made from undead remains.
strings.armor_heavy_unholy_cuirass_description: The malignant aura surrounding this armor will harm any enemies daring to enter its range.
strings.armor_heavy_unholy_spellcage_description: Bound within this ungodly cuirass by a potent spell, the seal of the Ten Hells burns fiercely, swiftly dissolving any foe bold enough to draw near.
strings.armor_heavy_void_armor_description: Not fully understood in its properties, adding a void drop to an already stable mixture of elements seems to further enhance their properties, giving life to the hardest material known to exist.
strings.armor_light_ancient_robe_description: Extremely light robe made with the remains of a prehistoric wing.
strings.armor_light_breathtaking_robe_descriptio:
A robe made with the wings of a Giant Moth treated to increase the normal amount of choking powder present by several orders of magnitude. Causes swelling in the airways of enemies getting too close, SILENCING them for 2 turns.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.armor_light_chief_scientist_coat_descrip: An apparently simple coat that belonged to the brightest mind of Kaunis. It increases the wearer attributes in an unknown way that doesn't rely on magic.
strings.armor_light_cloak_of_redemption_descript: An intricate pattern made with magic chains is applied on a fire magic enhancing tunic, embedding the wearer in a protective field that reflects a part of the incoming force.
strings.armor_light_cloth_robe_description: A light robe made of cloth derived from plants.
strings.armor_light_deep_sea_robe_description: The velvet infused with deep sea reagents used in the weaving of this robe confers it enhanced protection against external elements.
strings.armor_light_dreamwrought_robe_descriptio: An ethereal robe woven from cloth dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices resistance to grant a better intelligence improvement.
strings.armor_light_elastic_robe_description: An unknown light, elastic material sewn in the shape of a robe. Offers great protection, without hindering the wearer mobility, which is vital for spellcasting.
strings.armor_light_exotic_robe_description: Woven with Velvet imported by pirates, these robes are sought after by all the mages and nobles in the highest spheres.
strings.armor_light_feather_robe_description: A light robe made of feathers, displaying the color of the desert birds.
strings.armor_light_fleetfoot_robe_description: Light robe made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
strings.armor_light_ghost_rabbit_cloak_descripti: Light cloak made from ghastly fabric mixed with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.
strings.armor_light_kaunian_robe_description: Extremely resistant robe woven from cloth employed by Kaunis elite troops. Grants increased protection to the wearer, but the lack of magic used in its making will reduce the boost to intelligence.
strings.armor_light_laroxian_robe_description: Light and versatile robe woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox.
strings.armor_light_moth_robe_description: Resistant but very light robe made from the wings of a Giant Moth.
strings.armor_light_robe_of_the_archmage_descrip: A robe enchanted with powerful protection spells, usually worn by members of the High Council of Larox.
strings.armor_light_robe_of_the_lich_description: A preserved, ancient robe taken from the cold body of a slain Lich. The blueprints for its making are now lost in time. Grants enhanced powers to the undead caster if its servants are alive.
strings.armor_light_sage_cloak_description: Cloak enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.
strings.armor_light_silk_robe_description: Garment made with precious fabric, provides little protection but grants a wide range of movements.
strings.armor_light_slime_robe_description: Peculiar light equipment that sacrifices mobility to grant increased protection.
strings.armor_light_spectral_robe_description: Cloak made with mysterious, ethereal fabric of unknown origin.
strings.armor_light_spider_robe_description: Made entirely with Giant Spider silk, whose elasticity and resistance is unparalleled.
strings.armor_light_tunica_ignis_description: Slime robe infused with a fiery artifact. Maintains its original properties while granting better control over fire magic.
strings.armor_light_tunica_infernalis_descriptio: Adding a fireproof coating to this unique robe allows to apply different enchantments during its crafting, since protection from it's own fiery power is no longer needed.
strings.armor_light_winter_cape_description: The peculiar properties of the troll's Wintercloth allows to craft this very light albeit resilient light clothing
strings.armor_light_wyvern_cape_description: Enhanced with real Snow Wyvern scales, this robe allows for an enhanced channeling of white magic.
strings.armor_medium_ancient_jacket_description: Extremely versatile jacket made with the remains of prehistoric giants.
strings.armor_medium_banshee_jacket_description: Made of resilient Banshee scales, one of the hardest known organic materials that can bend enough to not reduce the wearer's mobility too much.
strings.armor_medium_beastmaster_jacket_descript: Elite armor embedding several fiery gems. It has a great versatility in combat, and grants increased control on domesticated creatures. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point.
strings.armor_medium_belt_jacket_description: Crafted from the belts in use by the Golden City Wardens, this equipment is surprisingly resilient despite its improvised nature.
strings.armor_medium_cottontail_jacket_descripti: Simple jacket padded with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.
strings.armor_medium_cunning_demise_description:
This armor components, harmonized by a central magical seal to build the most disruptive interference, modifies the properties of the air around to make transmission of sound impossible, hindering spellcasters effectiveness.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.armor_medium_cunning_downfall_descriptio:
This armor components can vibrate so fast they disrupt the propagation of sound in the air, making spellcasters unable to cast their spells.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
strings.armor_medium_cursed_jacket_description: Made with an ancient metal with unique properties, makes deep wounds inflicted by the wearer hurt even more.
strings.armor_medium_deep_sea_jacket_description: Hides processed with reagents gathered in the depth of the ocean, to confer the wearer additional protection against external elements.
strings.armor_medium_dreamwrought_jacket_descrip: Jacket assembled from materials dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices defense to grant a superior mobility to the wearer.
strings.armor_medium_fleetfoot_jacket_descriptio: Jacket padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
strings.armor_medium_ivory_jacket_description: Belt jacket enhanced with precious Ivory.
strings.armor_medium_leather_jacket_description: A simple jacket made of leather.
strings.armor_medium_monkey_hide_jacket_descript: Very flexible and resilient armor made with monkey hides.
strings.armor_medium_mutant_jacket_description: Jacket made from a monster mutated through the use of alien technology. Extremely resistant at the cost of a lower mobility.
strings.armor_medium_nightwing_jacket_descriptio: Made with a type of leather that comes from giant bats rarely found in very deep caverns, allows for superior mobility and protection.
strings.armor_medium_reassembling_jacket_descrip: Jacket enhanced with a powerful rune through the manipulation of its ethereal aspect, often achieved using a powerful instrument.
strings.armor_medium_sage_jacket_description: Jacket enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.
strings.armor_medium_scarlet_shroud_description: The legendary Veil, mechanically enhanced using the parts of the mysterious Machine. It autonomously helps the wearer in its movements in a deadly synergy.
strings.armor_medium_scarlet_veil_description: Legends talk about unseen assassins wearing this Veil who were able to take over entire armies. Gifted from an ancient God to allow their worshippers to pursue its goals, only a few shreds of these artifacts exist by now, displaced all around the Realms.
strings.armor_medium_shielding_jacket_descriptio: Padded jacket enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.
strings.armor_medium_slime_jacket_description: Dissipate the force of incoming blows very effectively, but sacrifices some mobility.
strings.armor_medium_spellwoven_jacket_descripti: Jacket made from a very resistant type of leather, produced by magical means.
strings.armor_medium_spitfang_jacket_description: Made entirely with Spitfang's scales and padded with fabric made by Moth wings. Will allow for great mobility while offering extremely good protection.
strings.armor_medium_trollskin_jacket_descriptio: Hard as stone while allowing for a wide range of movements, secretes an oil that hastens the healing of wounds.
strings.armor_medium_undead_jacket_description: Grim piece of equipment made with undead remains. Offers good protection against external attacks maintaining some mobility.
strings.armor_medium_wurmscales_jacket_descripti: Made with wurm scales for increased integrity, padded with feathers.

strings.confirm_upgrade_body: Are you sure you want to buy %s
strings.consumable_evo23_vial_description:
A mysterious liquid employed by the Celestials to permanently enhance their soldiers' combat efficacy. It directly manipulates organic tissues, inducing extraordinary structural modifications.
This item can modify an adventurer rare trait.
strings.consumable_evo23_vial_description_altern: This item can modify an adventurer rare trait.
strings.consumable_geode_description: Hollow rock that contains a precious gem. Rarely, they can contain a massive amount of gems.
strings.consumable_intercession_description:
Allows an Adventurer to ascend without resetting their level. Used on an ascended Adventurer, it grants the next Paragon rank (up to Paragon 3), also without resetting the level.

Ascended adventurers gain access to Doctrines, increased base stats and an increased potion limits, but require more experience to level up.
strings.consumable_potion_of_clumsiness_descript: A liquid brewed through unknown means. Will reset the amount of Potions of Agility drank by an adventurer to zero. This cannot be undone.
strings.consumable_potion_of_precision_descripti: Permanently increases Critical Hit Chance by 1%.
strings.consumable_potion_of_rejuvenation_descri:
Resets an adventurer to its base rank, preserving ascension status.
This potion should be used to correct mistakes when choosing a class branch. This is not a prestige mechanic, but an Adventurer reset.
strings.consume_egg_no_spaces_body: Upgrade your shelter capacity or free up a space to hatch more eggs.
strings.dialog_change_trait_confirm_body: %s: are you sure you want to replace %s with %s?
strings.dialog_clumsiness_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset the amount of Potions of Agility drank by %s?
strings.dialog_doctrine_confirm_choose: Are you sure you want %s to follow %s?
strings.dialog_doctrine_confirm_reset: Are you sure you want to reset the Doctrine for %s?
strings.dialog_intercession_confirm_choose: Are you sure you want %s to ascend?
strings.dialog_quests_refresh_description:
Would you like to refresh your quests?
This is available once per week.
strings.dismiss_dialog_dungeon: If you dismiss this adventurer, the %s exploration will be interrupted.
strings.dismiss_dialog_dungeon_pet: If you remove this pet, the %s exploration will be interrupted.
strings.doctrine_ability_arcane_suppression_desc: Deal %s magical damage per turn for each negative Status Effect inflicted by this unit.
strings.doctrine_ability_beat_the_odds_descripti: Rolls three times for damage and uses the best result.
strings.doctrine_ability_chilling_flow_descripti:
%s FREEZE for 1 turn on hit.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.doctrine_ability_divine_intervention_des: Healing abilities that target all allies have an increased %s chance (additive) of reviving them.
strings.doctrine_ability_false_life_description: After each turn, %s chance to gain the Status False Life. The next time the unit would receive damage, it takes none and this effect is removed.
strings.doctrine_ability_genus_vampyri_descripti: Lifesteal can overheal, granting a shield of up to %s the max HP value.
strings.doctrine_ability_healing_nova_descriptio: On every enemy death, heal every ally by %s of their missing health.
strings.doctrine_ability_lightning_speed_descrip: %s chance to perform an additional attack at the end of the turn.
strings.doctrine_ability_lore_master_description: Accessories grant double HP, Constitution, Dexterity, Intelligence.
strings.doctrine_ability_mind_bender_description: %s to ignore status immunities when applying Status Effects.
strings.doctrine_ability_mirror_of_anguish_descr: Gains Retaliate (Physical) equal to Defense, and Retaliate (Magical) equal to Magic Defense.
strings.doctrine_ability_necrosis_porphyrica_des: Ignores %s of extra damage from critical hits.
strings.doctrine_ability_overheal_description: If the target is healed beyond their maximum HP, a shield is applied, capped at %s HP.
strings.doctrine_ability_servus_umbrae_descripti: Increase damage by %s per point of Darkness.
strings.doctrine_ability_star_gaze_description:
%s PETRIFY for 1 turn on hit.
PETRIFY: This unit can't dodge, takes 15%% increased damage and skips its turn.
strings.doctrine_ability_tactical_knowledge_desc: Ignores %s of target's Defense and Magic Defense.
strings.doctrine_ability_true_agony_description: When False Life is removed by an enemy, deals %s damage to them as retaliation (magical).
strings.doctrine_affliction_description: Followers of this doctrine believe that suffering is synonymous with strength. They willingly inject themselves with an unknown pathogen that brings unrelenting agony and an insatiable thirst for blood. Over time, they have adapted to endure—and even revel in—the torment of their decaying flesh.
strings.doctrine_control_description: Adherents of the Doctrine of Control seek absolute dominance over themselves and others. They refine techniques to manipulate their enemies by commanding the elements and wield powerful abilities that grant them access to even the most guarded minds.
strings.doctrine_control_description_short: Status Effects and Status Effects resistance.
strings.doctrine_fortitude_description: Adherents of the Doctrine of Fortitude regard resilience as the ultimate virtue. They subject their bodies to relentless physical trials, pushing themselves to the brink of destruction and beyond. Through sheer determination and unyielding discipline, they transform pain and exhaustion into unshakable strength, forging a will as unbreakable as steel.
strings.doctrine_grace_description: Followers of the Doctrine of Grace are devoted to aiding the injured and the afflicted. They reject violence as a path to power, dedicating themselves instead to alleviating pain and suffering and bringing comfort to those around them.
strings.doctrine_illusion_description: Adherents of the Doctrine of Illusion devote themselves to mastering the art of deception. They see reality as malleable, shaped not by truth but by perception. To them, control over one's subjective judgment is the key to true power.
strings.doctrine_knowledge_description: Followers of this doctrine are jack-of-all-trades, seeking to gain expertise in as many fields as possible. They believe that true power lies in the pursuit of pure knowledge, with its practical application being a secondary—though undeniably valuable—tool.
strings.doctrine_ruin_description: "Attack is the best defense" is the creed of those who follow the Doctrine of Ruin. They swiftly unleash the full potential of their destructive power, paying little to no regards to their own safety.
strings.doctrine_ruin_description_short: Damage at the expense of safety.
strings.doctrine_war_description: Adherents of the Doctrine of War revere conflict as the ultimate crucible for growth and dominance. They dedicate their lives to mastering the art of combat, honing their bodies into lethal weapons. For them, battle is not just a means to an end but a sacred pursuit where strength, strategy, and unrelenting willpower define one's worth.
strings.drawer_cloud_description:
Last cloud save: %s

Data is saved to cloud every hour.
Loading from cloud will restore your most recent backup. The app will close, and when you reopen it you will find everything that was saved.
This operation is not reversible.
strings.drawer_consume_food_empty_list: - There are no pets that can eat this food.
strings.drawer_consume_potion_empty_list: - There are no adventurers that can drink this potion.
strings.drawer_faq_death_body:
When adventurers lose all their HP in a dungeon, they faint.

When one adventurer faint, they lose 20% of the total experience towards the next level (this does not happen in raids and epic raids).

When all adventurers faint, they will lose all progress towards the next areas and respawn with full HP after 18 seconds.
strings.drawer_faq_dismiss_reorder_body: At the bottom of the Adventurers tab, there is a small arrow pointing up. You can tap it to open a menu that lets you dismiss or reorder your adventurers. After you dismiss an adventurer, if you change your mind, you have 24 hours to recall them from "Recall adventurers" in the drawer menu.
strings.drawer_faq_epic_raids_body:
Epic Raids are like regular Raids, with the following differences:

• An Epic Raid has memory of your previous runs. If you win a fight once, you will not encounter it again.

• When you finish the Epic Raid and collect all loot, which will contain powerful unique items, it will disappear forever.
strings.drawer_faq_idle_progression_body: The progress will continue while the app is closed without any difference. The only limit to this progress is that it goes on for a maximum of 12 hours.
strings.drawer_faq_raids_body:
Raids are harder challenges similar to Dungeons, but with a few differences:

• Only one try per day. More can be purchased with gems.

• The allowed team size is a minimum of 5, but can be greater.

• Experience is not lost on death.

• On death or completion the team will automatically exit the Raid.

Tap on "Raids" at the bottom of the screen to see the unlocked raid!
strings.drawer_recall_adventurers_confirmation_b: Would you like to take back %s?
strings.drawer_recall_adventurers_empty_list: - There are no adventurers to recall
strings.drawer_recall_adventurers_info: If you dismiss an adventurer and change your mind within 24 hours, you can ask them to come back to your guild.
strings.drawer_recall_adventurers_warning_no_spa: Your Quarters are full. If you want to take back %s, you first need to dismiss an adventurer or upgrade your quarters.
strings.drawer_settings_auto_open_dungeon: Open dungeon view after sending a team:
strings.egg_avian_description: Egg that will hatch an Avian pet. Avian pets usually like to attract enemy attention, distracting them from the party.
strings.egg_construct_description: Egg that will hatch a pet Construct. Constructs usually like to use magic to impair enemies and illuminate dark areas.
strings.egg_esoteric_description: Egg that will hatch an Esoteric pet. Esoteric pets like to provide indirect bonuses, like granting enhanced learning, or finding more items.
strings.egg_insect_description: Egg that will hatch a pet Insect. Insects usually like to attack enemies, and grant damage reduction.
strings.egg_reptile_description: Egg that will hatch a pet Reptile. Reptiles usually enhance the team offensive capabilities.
strings.egg_wild_description: Egg that will hatch a Wild pet. Wild pets usually provide strategic support to the team, enhancing health management and offensive capabilities.
strings.egg_wooden_description: Egg that will hatch a Wooden pet. Wooden pets like to help the team stay alive, and are rarely keen for harming enemies.
strings.enemy_abomination_description: Defying all the laws of basic biology, this monstrosity of connected tissues and nervous dead ends displays the strength of the many body it is made of. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_amanita_obscura_description: Purple fungus with white grains. Its flesh contains a paralyzing agent capable of halting respiratory functions in nearly every living creature. It moves slowly but with a rhythmic pattern, hinting at a form of sentience.
strings.enemy_ancient_ent_description: Left undisturbed for millennia, this living tree grew to a massive size. Its body is covered in spikes, a mighty weapon along with its size to keep the forest safe against harmful intruders.
strings.enemy_arcane_assassin_description: The Arcane Assassins were a special operation group under direct command of the Seer, Kasimir, employed across the realms to take out targets that aimed to deteriorate the fragile peace among the various factions. They wield magical daggers gifted by the Seer, whose origin is a mystery.
strings.enemy_archmage_of_larox_description: Extremely powerful and dangerous, Archmage is the title conferred upon the brightest mages in the city. They participate in the city's Higher Council, overseeing every major development.
strings.enemy_avatar_of_the_ancient_description: A frail and feeble manifestation of an aspect of the Outer God. If the rituals were to be completed, it would bring dramatic and irreversible changes to life across the realms.
strings.enemy_banshee_description: A terrifying breed of armored beasts that roam the Barren Wastelands. Due to their presence, this area was uninhabited since the beginning of recorder history, but fortunately they keep to their hunting grounds.
strings.enemy_beholder_description: Extremely smart but evil creatures only found in the depth of the earth, beholder will smite their opponents with their eldritch powers.
strings.enemy_berserker_description: An ancient warrior armed with twin mithril axes, his fury intensifies with every blow he endures, turning him into an unstoppable force as the battle rages on.
strings.enemy_bleak_deacon_description: A corrupted bishop of an eldritch deity, wielding a grotesque form of magic gifted by their malevolent god. This power can heal extraordinary wounds but exacts a terrible price.
strings.enemy_bleak_disciple_description: This humanoid of unknown origin, warped beyond recognition, has dwelled beneath these caverns for millennia. It toils ceaselessly to bring its long-forgotten god back into existence.
strings.enemy_boar_description: Wild boars are omnivorous animals commonly found in the forest. They can be hard to kill due to their thick skin.
strings.enemy_celestial_destroyer_description: Only a handful of these flying fortresses are sent with the first wave to limit the risks associated with their loss, but as the campaign advances they slowly cover the target world's surface to assist the ground troops in the eradication of any form of life present.
strings.enemy_celestial_lancer_description: The backbone of the Celestial Army. These fearless soldiers push through foreign worlds animated by unwavering loyalty, counting on a supernatural agility despite their large size.
strings.enemy_centaur_description: Half men and half horses, these magical creatures are skilled hunters that used to live in harmony within the forest.
strings.enemy_cerebrum_description: A sentient brain encased in nearly indestructible glass. It cannot move, but can manipulate the surrounding world in other ways.
strings.enemy_chief_scientist_ava_description: A pale girl draped in a grimy white coat. Her modest appearance betrays the enormous knowledge she possesses.
strings.enemy_city_warden_description: A law enforcement unit operating in the Capital. They are not part of the Imperial Army, and their responsibility is to maintain order and catch criminals.
strings.enemy_claris_description: One of the three cultist rebels. An extremely powerful mage, still couldn't manage to make the Primordial corruption-proof.
strings.enemy_crusader_description:
A member of one of the many crusades from the eastern cities to eradicate the evil that has been abducting their citizen. They wander the halls aimlessly, having lost their ego over time to the magical influences.
People from these lands seem to naturally display psyonic capabilities, and could present a formidable menace in large numbers.
strings.enemy_death_hound_description: A war hound employed by the Imperial Army, reanimated by the corruption after falling in battle. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_deckhand_description: A capuchin colored monkey commonly found in the exotic Skull Island, home of the pirates. It has been trained to perform the lowliest duties of a pirate crew, like cleaning the decks and bringing the rum. It has also been trained in using the knife, and is a surprisingly strong adversary.
strings.enemy_djinn_description: Powerful, benevolent desert spirit said to grand a wish to lucky travelers. After he became corrupt, he unleashes his wrath on every poor soul he crosses.
strings.enemy_dreamwrought_beast_description: An incorporeal creature resembling a horse, with a single horn on its forehead.
strings.enemy_dreamwrought_dragon_description: This majestic, incorporeal dragon flies in hypnotic, looping patterns before striking with fierce power.
strings.enemy_dreamwrought_forge_description: A mysterious, incorporeal figure seated behind an arcane instrument. Unfazed by the surrounding chaos, it is fully focused on its task.
strings.enemy_dreamwrought_swarm_description: An endless multitude of spectral, ravenous insects that tear their prey apart in seconds.
strings.enemy_dryad_description: Elusive magical creature found in the southern woods. Its origin is unknown, but the travelers that spotted it before the corruption struck reported a timid but kind temperament.
strings.enemy_eldritch_hound_description: These twisted, wolf-like creatures relentlessly hunt any creature that dares to approach the underground temple.
strings.enemy_electric_slime_description: Electric charge flows through this slime body, threatening to shock anyone getting close enough.
strings.enemy_emperor_clovis_xxviii_description: Regent of the new dynasty, chosen to keep the throne warm until the heir came of age. The Eye above found him first.
strings.enemy_enforcer_description: A warrior grotesquely altered through agonizing experiments, gifted with immense strength and a towering size.
strings.enemy_ent_description: Ancient guardians of the forest, these massive trees possess enormous strength.
strings.enemy_ethereal_soul_description:
A fallen soldier of the Imperial Army, died during the last ditch effort of the Empire to stop the treacherous Seer.

It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_fire_slime_description: This slime is engulfed by flames, but it seems okay with this condition.
strings.enemy_first_minister_atos_description: A powerful figure in the Kaunian hierarchy, who gained terrible powers through the manipulation of its own body.
strings.enemy_forest_spirit_description: The oldest spirit of the Elderwood. It still remembers the guild that once camped at the edge of its trees, and it does not trust the one that came after.
strings.enemy_frozen_slime_description: An extremely cold slime. Maintained the jelly-like texture despite the frozen coating, somehow.
strings.enemy_gcss_description: Gaussian Coil Security Station. Accelerates a giant metal projectile through a mysterious field, reaching incredible speeds and causing devastating damage upon impact. It's heavily armored, to sustain a prolonged assault.
strings.enemy_ghoul_description: For unknown reasons, sometimes undead are animated by a strong urge to feed on other dead bodies. These creatures often develop a more feral appearance, with longer teeth and sharper nails, and after some time they lose all of their similarity with human beings. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_giant_moth_description: Flies thanks to a magic powder that covers its wings. This powder is known to irritate the airways of many other creatures, including humans.
strings.enemy_giant_spider_description: This kind of spider is usually found in much smaller sizes around the northern kingdoms. Left undisturbed for decades in the darkness of the Obsidian Mines, it reached the size of a grown man.
strings.enemy_giant_tortoise_description: A huge tortoise weighting several tons, with a very hard shell covered in sharp spikes.
strings.enemy_golden_rabbit_description: Old legends speak of the pet of a forest spirit in the form of a golden rabbit, but despite a few sighting its presence was never confirmed.
strings.enemy_green_spitfang_description: Large snake found in the southern regions that hunts by hurling saliva at its enemies at tremendous speed.
strings.enemy_healdess_knight_description: This nightmarish knight radiates an evil that defies imagination. Its own burning head, brandished as a morning star, grins malevolently as it is hurled at its foes.
strings.enemy_herald_kali_description: The true form of the Seer Ysolde. Unlike her predecessor, she does not intend to be devoured when the Graft breaks.
strings.enemy_herald_maya_description: A powerful servant of the Black Serpent. Maintains the link through the Core, and will replace the Seer if its mission fail.
strings.enemy_herald_shoran_description: The last form of the Herald of the second cycle, fused with the machine at the planet's core. She has stopped asking her master for forgiveness.
strings.enemy_herald_xavi_description: A powerful servant of the Black Serpent. Maintains the link through the Core, and will replace the Seer if its mission fail.
strings.enemy_ice_elemental_description: A mysterious creature that takes the form of extremely cold, inanimate rocks arranged in strange patterns. It appears to have complete mastery over the ice around, manipulating it offensively to dissuade attackers.
strings.enemy_iconoclast_description: Slaves to the Celestial Goddess, abducted from the worlds she destroyed. Their bodies are modified to allow them to live through raging flames, and their mission is to cleanse the lands designated for the Cleansing.
strings.enemy_imp_description: A small, winged servant of the Wizards of Larox, summoned through magic and lacking any will of its own. It is typically used for simple tasks but can also assist in defending the city when needed.
strings.enemy_imperial_guard_description: A member of a special division of the Imperial Army appointed to the defense of the Imperial Palace and the many decentralized Imperial institutions. They are experts at protecting vulnerable targets, and can be formidable opponents even in their unhinged state.
strings.enemy_imperial_mage_description: Strategically crucial in every Imperial Army division, these highly trained mages conjure thunders above the enemy ranks, dealing substantial damage and disrupting their strategy.
strings.enemy_insane_citizen_description: A citizen of the Empire Capital, who lived among luxury and wealth, never knowing any real hardship. The eye's appearance stole their sanity, and now they wander the streets in a feral state.
strings.enemy_insane_merchant_description: Merchants from distant lands often stopped by in the Golden City to sell exotic goods. They pose no greater danger than a normal citizen, but may carry more valuable resources.
strings.enemy_insane_priest_description: A priest of one of the many places of worship in the city, used to offer guidance to the poor and the miserables. His strong faith granted him healing powers, that remained even after the loss of his sanity.
strings.enemy_kabar_the_rotten_description: A powerful mage devoted to the forbidden arts who successfully completed the transformation into a lich. It remained well hidden into the catacombs for centuries, taking advantages of the large number of fallen soldiers to build a huge army. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_kasimir_the_seer_description: Advisor to the new dynasty, praised for bringing peace after a thousand years of quiet. She is the Herald of the second cycle, and she has studied every mistake of the one before her.
strings.enemy_king_aino_description: The enormous shell of what was once a man. Wheter its current state is the result of external deception or its own hubris remains unknown.
strings.enemy_lazarus_description: This elegant, charismatic man conceals a dreadful curse behind his blood red eyes.
strings.enemy_legate_hadrian_description: Hadrian's successor at the head of the Celestial Army. He has read every report of the first Cleansing, and he brought ten times the ships.
strings.enemy_lesser_titan_description: The result of a botched conjuring ritual. It possesses great strength, but it's existence is suffering.
strings.enemy_lost_miner_description: Clad in a broken brass diving gear, barely producing any noise despite their limping gait, they can be rarely spotted in the obsidian mines. Their origins and purpose are unknown, but they appear to come from the lowest levels of the mine.
strings.enemy_magic_armor_description: Armor crafted from a unique metal and brought to life through a blend of technology and magic. The city is teeming with these constructs, ever vigilant and prepared to fend off any potential invasion.
strings.enemy_mimic_description: Not unlike a usual old, worn out chest filled with treasures (or spiderwebs), the Mimic true nature emerges when a poor soul tries to reach for its contents, often leaving more than they can retrieve. They are rarely found in the places under the control of the Skull Island pirates, and no one knows exactly what animates them.
strings.enemy_mysterious_tentacle_description: Viscid, lined with suction cups, and with a tendency to sink random ships passing by. The only scarier thing than this tentacle is the creature it is attached to.
strings.enemy_necrobot_description: A soldier resurrected not by magic but through unknown technology, bound to carry out the commands of its masters.
strings.enemy_necrolith_description: A colossal bone construct animated by forbidden magic. Bones are calcified together, therefore it can't move, but it's surface is harder than the hardest stone.
strings.enemy_nexus_researcher_description: Lacking any magical power themselves, they work together to complete the Nexus of Larox and to discover new types of spells.
strings.enemy_obsidian_golem_description: Animated by unknown forces, this massive obsidian creature is impervious to any magic damage thanks to this element's properties. While hard to take down without a strategy, the massive size hinders it's offensive capabilities.
strings.enemy_oculus_description: Flying organic-machine hybrid used to map terrain, find enemy locations and generally gathering information on the battlefield. Equipped with a small but powerful magic cannon that allows, through unknown technology, to replicate a destructive spell usually casted by mages through their rituals.
strings.enemy_pale_hermit_description: Lurking in the depths of the Obsidian Mines, this ancient horror made the original miners flee for their lives when it was mistakenly awaken. It strikes from the dark, leaving no chance to the unaware explorer.
strings.enemy_phantasm_description: Almost imperceptible to the naked eye, this extremely fast assassin will meet unprepared victims with a tremendous fate.
strings.enemy_phoenix_description: A massive bird resembling an eagle, with shimmering golden feathers and a gaze that burns like fire.
strings.enemy_pirate_captain_description: Only the most fearsome and ruthless pirates are given the command of a galleon. The pirate captains are formidable warriors, well versed in the art of diplomacy and rum drinking. They are in charge of some of the most difficult missions around the Realms.
strings.enemy_pirate_description: The most common member of a pirate ship crew, Skull Island pirates are feared all over the realms. Trained in the use of the Cutlass, a traditional piratesque sword, they also have access to an exclusive technology capable of shooting iron projectiles with incredible force.
strings.enemy_pirate_lieutenant_description: Higher in the Skull Island pirate's hierarchy than the regular pirate, this seasoned lieutenant commands small crews in their plunders.
strings.enemy_primeval_wurm_description: An ancient being of terrifying size, capable of devouring entire villages in a single bite. One of them is said to roam the ground below the Southern Grove, roaming in circle and unable to leave due to the rocky terrain surrounding the area.
strings.enemy_primordial_titan_description: The Primordial Titan was never destroyed, only chained. The cult that worships the Herald melted down the chains and forged it anew.
strings.enemy_pterodactyl_description: A massive, flying living fossil from the dawn of this world. Remarkably strong, yet astonishingly agile in the air.
strings.enemy_reinforced_door_description: A large, imposing door. Attacks through a smaller Gaussian Coil fixed above, and the system that powers the room is reliant on its integrity.
strings.enemy_sand_demon_description: The last resort of the Sha'huri defense system. When invaders threaten the safety of their God, the defense system draws upon all its energy to conjure these fearsome warriors, capable of defeating large armies by themselves. Due to the immense energy cost these assaults should be short timed, albeit overwhelming.
strings.enemy_sand_statue_description: A sand warrior summoned by the legendary Sha'huri defense system, the last resort against external invaders to protect the core of their empire and their god. While not particularly strong by itself, they present a mortal threat by swarming the invaders in large numbers.
strings.enemy_sand_vulture_description: Birds of prey that scavenge on carrion. Not very dangerous alone, but ranged units are required to take them down.
strings.enemy_sha_kire_first_swordsman_descripti: Descendant of the legendary First Swordsman. The pyramid is empty, but the oath to guard it was passed down for forty generations.
strings.enemy_sha_the_hidden_god_description: A god built by priests who could not accept that theirs was gone. It looks like the one that hid in the pyramid. It is not.
strings.enemy_shahuri_archer_description: Skilled archer of the Sha'huri tribe, he offers ranged support for ground troops. They wield special bows able to disrupt enemy actions.
strings.enemy_shahuri_mage_description: Gifted with a fragment of their god's magic, they can manipulate the desert sand to encapsulate and crush their enemies.
strings.enemy_shahuri_warrior_description: Fearsome warrior of the Sha'huri tribe, he executes the orders of the desert god.
strings.enemy_singularity_description: The first physical, seemingly living being to appear in this world. Countless souls fused together as one, radiating an immense amount of energy.
strings.enemy_slime_description: A green, semi-transparent creature rarely spotted in the depth of the forest. From the few witnesses lucky enough to witness a Slime, they used to display an elusive behaviour before the corruption.
strings.enemy_slime_king_description: A thousand years ago the King of the Slimes seeped into the ground. Something grew from what it left behind, and it rules the pond with a court of its own.
strings.enemy_smoldering_titan_description: A colossal demigod as tall as a mountain, birthed from the fiery depths of an active volcano. It moves slowly, crushing and incinerating everything in its path.
strings.enemy_snow_wyvern_description: A majestic flying creature rarely spotted around the frostbite peaks. Unlike other draconids, it spits an ice tempest capable of sweeping away an unprepared army.
strings.enemy_stone_shaman_description: A mystic wielding a unique form of magic derived from stones unlike anything found on the surface. These stones allow them to command wild beasts with ease and grant them some healing powers.
strings.enemy_tekeli_li_first_apostle_descriptio: This vast, amorphous mass of organs and appendages dwells hundreds of meters beneath the Submerged Temple, orchestrating the Ritual. It is the most powerful of the Ancient's original, devoted apostles, it will stop at nothing to restore its master from its cosmic exile.
strings.enemy_terrorsaurus_description: An immense, heavily armored dinosaur—slow-moving but with razor-sharp teeth. It can endure staggering amounts of damage before finally succumbing.
strings.enemy_the_ancient_description: To meet it's gaze is to peer into the unfathomable void of cosmic indifference. One glimpse at its figure unravels reason like a fragile thread. The terrified adventurers, however, feel like they already met this nightmare.
strings.enemy_the_exiled_description: An extremely strong man slightly taller than average, who looks extremely calm. He looks out of place among the other prisoners. What secret is he hiding?
strings.enemy_the_machine_description: An enormous mechanical construct, an ever-shifting maze of angles and cogs, defying geometry and logic with every change in its configuration.
strings.enemy_thorvus_description: One of the three cultist rebels. An extremely powerful mage, still couldn't manage to make the Primordial corruption-proof.
strings.enemy_treant_description: These living trees of medium dimensions used to be kind and caring towards wild creatures and travelers alike.
strings.enemy_troll_description: The very existence of these creatures baffled lore experts from around the Realms for centuries. They live in small sized tribes and conduct a primitive lifestyle based mainly on hunting. Their natural strength is unparalleled, and killing even one of them is a difficult feat.
strings.enemy_troll_shaman_description: These trolls manifest some kind of healing power, different from the traditional white magic used by clerics but very effective in keeping their peers alive. Along with the troll's natural regenerative capabilities, killing a troll while they are alive is a difficult task.
strings.enemy_troll_warrior_description: In the hierarchy of trolls, these individuals are assigned to the protection of the troll's hunting grounds from external forces. They are usually the strongest trolls of the pack, wielding a huge hammer as a weapon and striking fear into the hearts of explorers unlucky enough to have a close encounter with them
strings.enemy_troll_whelp_description: A young troll, not as dangerous as it's older peers, but already presents the defining features of their species, such as enhanced regeneration and a very hard skin.
strings.enemy_ultraslime_description: An endless figure that entirely occupies the immense chamber. Housing this monstrosity must alone be the reason of the sheer size of this tower.
strings.enemy_undead_archer_description: The corpse of a fallen archer, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_undead_description: The corpse of a fallen infantry soldier, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_undead_general_description: A reanimated high-rank General of the Imperial Army. During their life they were an exceptionally gifted soldier, deciding the outcome of key battles and leading hundreds of soldiers. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_undead_warlord_description: This undead was likely a skilled commander, visibly stronger than the normal undead and clad in a spiked armor that hurts attackers. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_vampire_bat_description: An extremely agile creature, it flies above its preys striking at the first opportunity, drawing their blood to restore its energy.
strings.enemy_void_slime_description: A very unusual slime, with the texture of a starry night. It corrodes every surface in its trail, suggesting a conflict between its matter composition and the surrounding world's one.
strings.enemy_wicked_tribute_description: A mysterious being from another world, brought into the fold as a result of Laroxians seeking unconventional alliances to bolster their ranks. The cost of its allegiance demands a sacrifice of untold proportions.
strings.enemy_will_o_wisp_description: This incorporeal spirit is rarely spotted in large battlefields or cemeteries. There were never reports of them being aggressive towards the living. Completely ignores physical damage.
strings.enemy_wizard_of_larox_description: A gifted mage, made even more powerful through the endless knowledge of the Laroxians.
strings.enemy_wolf_description: A wild wolf living in the forest. They can hunt alone or in packs.
strings.enemy_wurm_description: Worm-like creatures with razor sharp teeth that dwell in the desert. They usually attack from below, and can draw energy from the flesh of their preys.
strings.epic_raids_help_body:
You unlocked your first Epic Raid!

Epic Raids are like regular Raids, with the following differences:

• An Epic Raid has memory of your previous runs. If you win a fight once, you will not encounter it again.

• When you finish the Epic Raid and collect all loot, which will contain powerful unique items, it will disappear forever.
strings.food_algae_description: Thin, greenish-brown plant that lives underwater. Its taste is salty and briny, and it's used mostly for exotic recipe typical of seaside settlements.
strings.food_ambrosia_description: A golden ethereal drink, extremely sweet and with a caloric intake which is off the charts. The way it's produced is unknown, but is sometimes carried from unknown lands by the traveling merchants.
strings.food_apple_description: Round and glossy, with skin colors ranging from red to yellow. It’s crisp, juicy, and sweet, with a slight tartness.
strings.food_apple_pie_description: A golden, flaky crust surrounds a soft, spiced apple filling. It’s sweet and slightly tart, with cinnamon adding warmth to the juicy, tender apples.
strings.food_avocado_description: It has a smooth, dark green skin with a creamy, buttery flesh inside. It’s mild and rich in fats, with a subtle, nutty flavor. Complements some of the most exotic, fish based recipes.
strings.food_banana_description: Yellow, sweet fruit found in tropical lands. Monkeys love them, even ones employed by the Skull Island fleet.
strings.food_blueberry_description: Small and round, deep blue or purple in color. Usually found in the colder mountain trails, it has a slightly tart flavors, and leaves a mildly floral aftertaste.
strings.food_blueberry_pancake_description: A fluffy, golden-brown pancake dotted with juicy blueberries. It’s soft and sweet, with bursts of tart blueberry flavor in each bite.
strings.food_blueberry_smoothie_description: A thick, purple blend of blueberries and creamy ingredients. This recipe is not commonly found, as the few blueberries brought back from the troll ridden mountains were reserved for kings and princes.
strings.food_bread_description: A soft, golden-brown crust gives way to a fluffy, airy interior. It's one of the most common foods in the Realms, enjoyed by paesants, soldiers and nobles alike.
strings.food_butter_description: A smooth, pale yellow spread that’s rich and creamy. It melts quickly, releasing a mild, slightly salty flavor with a hint of sweetness.
strings.food_ceremonial_cake_description: A grand, multi-layered cake with intricate decorations. Reserved for special occasions like the marriage of a royal, one of these cakes can feed a hundred guests.
strings.food_cheese_description: Solid milk derivative, ranging in color from yellow to orange. Its flavor is sharp and salty, and it's used in many delicious recipes.
strings.food_cheese_risotto_description: Creamy, soft rice infused with melted cheese. It tastes mildly salty, with a smooth consistency.
strings.food_cheesecake_description: A creamy, dense dessert with a smooth, rich texture. Tastes incredibly good, and pets love this.
strings.food_chocolate_description: Exotic food that only the upper class citizen of the Capital can usually acquire. Melts on the tongue releasing sweet, slightly bitter, and complex cocoa flavors with a creamy finish.
strings.food_coffee_description: Deep brown liquid with a strong, earthy aroma. Nutritional content is close to zero, but allows for cooking delicious recipes.
strings.food_cookie_description: Golden and slightly crispy chocolate sweet with a soft, chewy center. A refined food destined to the breakfast of nobles, ambassadors and rich merchants.
strings.food_deviled_eggs_description: Halved boiled eggs with a yolk filling. The filling is extremely spicy, so this dish is not for every palate.
strings.food_dino_ribs_description: Massive, meaty ribs with a thick, tender texture. Packed with protein, they make a hearty meal, but the ancient beasts they come from are incredibly challenging to hunt.
strings.food_egg_description: A smooth, oval shell encasing a firm white and a bright yellow yolk. When cooked, it becomes either soft and creamy or firm, with a mild, rich taste.
strings.food_exotic_fruit_salad_description: Complemented with pineapple pieces, this fruit salad is juicy, sweet, and tangy, offering a burst of tropical flavors.
strings.food_fresh_salmon_description: A vibrant pink-orange fish with a firm, yet tender meat. Fished in the waters just above Blackwater Port, its taste is rich, buttery, and slightly sweet, with a moist, flaky texture when cooked.
strings.food_fresh_tuna_description: Deep red, firm flesh that’s meaty and dense. Valuable fish rarely found in the high seas, it has a clean, mild flavor with a slight hint of salt.
strings.food_frozen_breath_broth_description: A cold, misty soup with an icy, translucent appearance. The broth helps to make the Wyvern meat more tender, but chewing it is still a daunting task for many.
strings.food_fruit_salad_description: A colorful mix of fresh, juicy fruits, sweet and with a soft bite and a vibrant, refreshing flavor.
strings.food_glazed_donut_description: A soft, fluffy ring of dough coated in a glossy, sugary glaze. Popular among the north-eastern settlers, the exact recipe is not known.
strings.food_gourmet_icecream_description: An experimental way of serving a cold , sweet flavoured cream. It's a rare speciality only a few select food lovers ever had a chance to taste.
strings.food_grains_description: A small bag of dry kernels with various shapes and colors. They have a slightly chewy texture when cooked and a neutral, earthy flavor.
strings.food_grilled_cheese_description: Golden, crispy bread surrounds melted, gooey cheese. The sandwich is warm and rich, with a satisfying crunch and a creamy, salty interior.
strings.food_heaven_and_hell_description: The epitome of experimental, nouvelle cuisine. A taco using the hard Wyvern meat as filling, completed with the hottest sauce in the realms. A unique experience for sure, but definitely not for everyone.
strings.food_hellish_rations_description: A dark, revolting soup with an eye floating in it. You can’t tell if the eye fell in by accident or if it’s part of the recipe. It looks vile, and there’s only one way to find out if it will kill you.
strings.food_leek_description: Long and cylindrical with pale green and white layers. Its flavor is mildly sweet, like a delicate cross between onions and garlic, with a crisp, firm texture.
strings.food_mascarpone_cheese_description: Smooth, creamy, and white with a rich, buttery texture. It has a mild, slightly sweet taste and a velvety consistency that melts easily.
strings.food_maxxiburger_description: A massive, towering burger with layers of juicy meat, melted cheese, crisp lettuce, and savory sauces. Not very healthy, but extremely caloric.
strings.food_meat_chop_description: A thick, juicy cut of meat complete with a bone. It's the cheap, nutritious base for most meat based dishes.
strings.food_meat_pie_description: A golden, flaky pastry crust surrounds a savory filling of tender meat. It’s warm, hearty, and packed with robust, meaty flavors.
strings.food_meat_stew_description: A warm, hearty mixture of slow-cooked ingredients. Tender chunks of meat float along with vegetables in the broth.
strings.food_meaty_mushroom_description: Soft and spongy with an earthy, mild flavor. Rarely found in the southern forests, where the damp climate sometimes allows for their growth.
strings.food_milk_description: White and smooth with a creamy consistency. It’s mild, slightly sweet, and soothing. Can be turned into many derivatives, used in a large amount of recipes.
strings.food_mushroom_omelette_description: A fluffy, golden omelette filled with tender mushrooms. It’s soft and savory, with a rich flavor and a slightly creamy texture.
strings.food_mushroom_risotto_description: Creamy rice with tender Meaty Mushrooms. A very esteemed dish, given the difficulty of importing this kind of mushrooms in the northern cities even prior to the corruption.
strings.food_mushroom_stew_description: A warm, earthy dish filled with tender mushrooms. The broth is thick and flavorful, with a slightly spongy texture.
strings.food_pasta_description: Long spaghetti derived from grains, a common food found in many towns and villages. It provides a satisfying, slightly chewy texture and can be perfected with sauce.
strings.food_pasta_with_sauce_description: Long spaghetti derived from grains, a common food found in many towns and villages, coated in a bright red sauce.
strings.food_pear_description: With a smooth yellow skin, their flesh is soft, juicy, and sweet with a grainy texture that will melt in the mouth.
strings.food_pear_pie_description: A buttery, golden crust holds a soft, sweet pear filling. The pears are tender and juicy, with a delicate sweetness and subtle spiced aroma.
strings.food_pineapple_description: A spiky, golden-brown exterior hides bright yellow flesh. It’s juicy, tangy, and sweet with an exotic, refreshing flavor.
strings.food_potato_description: A starchy, oblong vegetable with a brown skin, considered a staple in the common villager diet. Its inside is soft, fluffy, and mildly earthy when cooked.
strings.food_potato_mash_description: Smooth, creamy mashed potatoes with a buttery flavor. It's a simple dish enjoyed by every social class in the Realms.
strings.food_pumpkin_description: Vibrantly orange with smooth, firm flesh. They grow only in the upper caverns below the Gates of Hell, thriving in the Nexus artificial light.
strings.food_red_reaper_description: A small, wrinkled red pepper with a sinister appearance. Its taste is fiery and incredibly spicy, leaving a sharp, lingering heat on the tongue.
strings.food_red_reaper_sauce_description: A fiery, bright red sauce with an intense, lingering heat. It’s incredibly spicy, not very nutritious by itself and it's highly recommended to not eat this alone.
strings.food_rice_description: Tiny, white smooth grains that, when cooked, present a neutral taste and a soft texture. Often used as the main supply for soldiers embarked in long expeditions, as it is easy to conserve for long times.
strings.food_salad_description: A simple mix of crisp leeks and colorful tomatoes. It’s light, crunchy, and refreshing, but not one of the most nutritious dishes.
strings.food_salmon_nigiri_description: A slice of fresh, bright orange salmon atop a small bed of rice wrapped in seaweed. A staple dish in the diet of sailors, pirates and sea merchants.
strings.food_salmon_roll_description: A sushi roll with soft rice, avocado and fresh salmon. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities.
strings.food_salt_description: Small, white granules or crystals with a sharp, savory taste. While it's not advised to consume salt alone, it can enhance most recipes. It is also widely used to conserve foods.
strings.food_sauce_description: A smooth, liquid or semi-liquid mixture derived from tomatoes, leek and a bit of salt. It adds moisture, richness, and depth to dishes.
strings.food_spices_description: Colorful and aromatic, while not able to sate hunger by themselves, they can be added to a lot of recipes to emphasize their taste and appearance.
strings.food_steak_braise_description: A slow-cooked, tender steak with a deep brown exterior. It’s rich and flavorful, with a slightly smoky taste.
strings.food_stew_description: A warm, hearty mixture of slow-cooked ingredients. It’s thick and comforting, with tender chunks of vegetables suspended in broth.
strings.food_strawberry_description: Bright red, heart-shaped berries with tiny seeds on the outside, known to grow in the southern forests because of the warmer climate. It’s juicy and sweet, with a slightly tart edge.
strings.food_strawberry_pancake_description: A light, fluffy pancake topped or filled with sweet strawberries imported from the southern forests. It’s soft and slightly sweet, with a fresh, juicy pop from the strawberries.
strings.food_strawberry_smoothie_description: A pink, creamy drink bursting with sweet, juicy strawberries. A common, albeit expensive recipe before the corruption struck, when the southern forests creatures were shy and peaceful.
strings.food_sweet_and_sour_meat_description: Tender meat chunks coated in a glossy, reddish sauce and pineapple pieces. The flavor is a perfect balance of tangy sweetness and a mild sour kick.
strings.food_taco_description: A crunchy bread slice filled with meat, cheese, and sauces. It’s savory and nutritious, with a mix of different textures.
strings.food_tiramisu_description: A layered dessert with creamy mascarpone and espresso-soaked cookies. It has a smooth and sweet taste, and it's extremely nutritious.
strings.food_tomato_description: Round and smooth, with a bright yellow color. Its flesh is juicy and slightly sweet with a tart, refreshing flavor and soft seeds inside.
strings.food_tuna_nigiri_description: Deep red tuna on rice, firm yet tender, wrapped in seaweed. A delicacy sometimes found in the diet of pirates and wealthy sea merchants.
strings.food_tuna_roll_description: A sushi roll made with red tuna, avocado and rice. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities.
strings.food_vinegar_description: Slightly colored liquid with a sharp, pungent aroma. It delivers a sour, tangy taste that is perfectly suited for some of the more elaborate dishes.
strings.food_wyvern_chop_description: Few people manage to take down a Wyvern, and even fewer manage to bite through its extremely hard meat. The taste is described as very intense, and the meat as extremely nutritious, with a single bite able to sustain a soldier for a day.
strings.food_yoghurt_description: Creamy and smooth milk derivative. White in color, it’s tangy and slightly sour, with a rich, thick consistency that varies from silky to dense.
strings.gems_replenish_raid_tries_body: Are you sure that you want to buy another try for %d gems?
strings.headquarters_market_help: You can see the items you put for sale here. After some time, visiting travelers will purchase them.
strings.headquarters_quarters_description_help: Adventurers rest here. By expanding your quarters, you will be able to recruit more adventurers.
strings.headquarters_shelter_description: You can house your Pets in the Shelter. You will be able to house more pets as you expand its capacity.
strings.headquarters_shelter_description_autofee: - Long press to mark a pet for auto feeding
strings.headquarters_shelter_help:
Pets can be hatched from Eggs, which are randomly dropped by several enemies.

You can level up pets giving them Food. Leveling up, they will unlock new abilities, and improve the strength of their current ones.

Autofeed allows to select pets that will automatically feed on any food item found, the moment it is collected.
strings.headquarters_storage_description_1: Short tap to view, long press to sell
strings.headquarters_tavern_description_help: Travelers from distant settlements may stop here for a drink from time to time. If you like any of them, recruit them into your guild!
strings.headquarters_tavern_help:
When the tavern is full, the older guests will leave to make room for new ones.

If you see an interesting unit but you prefer to recruit it later, you can freeze the current list by toggling the "lock" icon.
strings.headquarters_workshop_help: This is the place where your most skilled blacksmiths, tailors and alchemists create new items.
strings.help_attack:
The minimum and maximum damage inflicted with every basic attack.

%s
strings.help_attack_bows: Damage of Bows scales with Dexterity
strings.help_attack_daggers: Damage of Daggers scales with Constitution + Dexterity
strings.help_attack_enemy: The minimum and maximum damage inflicted with every basic attack.
strings.help_attack_staffs: Damage of Staffs scales with Intelligence
strings.help_attack_swords: Damage of Swords scales with Constitution
strings.help_constitution: Affect the damage of Swords and Daggers. After damage is reduced by Defense or Magic Defense, it is further reduced by one for every 8 points of Constitution.
strings.help_counterattack: Chance to counterattack with a basic attack when hit by a melee strike.
strings.help_darkness_damage: Percentage increase in damage dealt for every point of darkness in the current area.
strings.help_darkness_reduction: Reduction to the level of darkness in the current area.
strings.help_decay: Health lost at the start of every turn.
strings.help_defense: Percent reduction to physical damage received
strings.help_dexterity:
Affect the damage of Bows and Daggers.
Physical attacks have 0.4% critical chance per point, up to 40%.
Affect the chance to dodge physical attacks.
strings.help_dodge: Bonus dodge chance added to the base one rolled comparing the relevant statistic.
strings.help_exp_bonus: Percentage of experience gained after defeating an enemy.
strings.help_experience: When the experience bar is full, the adventurer gains a level. When the adventurers faints, experience towards the next level is lost.
strings.help_heal_modifier: Percentage of health restored by healers.
strings.help_hp: When the HP reaches 0, the adventurer faints. Once the whole team is fainted, the party will need a while to resume the exploration.
strings.help_intelligence:
Affect the damage of Staffs and mana regeneration.
Magic attacks have 0.4% critical chance per point, up to 40%.
Affect the chance to dodge magical attacks.
strings.help_level: When an adventurer reaches its maximum level, they can be promoted to a stronger unit.
strings.help_lifesteal: Percentage of damage inflicted that is converted to health for the attacker.
strings.help_magic_defense: Percent reduction to magical damage received
strings.help_mana: When the mana reaches %d, the adventurer will cast its Active Skill. The mana gain formula is [10 + (Intelligence / 10)] per turn.
strings.help_potion_agility: For every potion drank, increase Dodge Chance by 1%.
strings.help_potion_constitution: For every potion drank, increase Constitution by 1.
strings.help_potion_darkness: For every potion drank, increase damage dealt per point of darkness by 0.1%
strings.help_potion_defense: For every potion drank, increase Defense by 1.
strings.help_potion_dexterity: For every potion drank, increase Dexterity by 1.
strings.help_potion_health: For every potion drank, increase maximum HP by 5.
strings.help_potion_immunity: For every potion drank, increase Status Immunity by 1.
strings.help_potion_intelligence: For every potion drank, increase Intelligence by 1.
strings.help_potion_magic_defense: For every potion drank, increase Magic Defense by 1.
strings.help_potion_precision: For every potion drank, increase Critical Hit chance by 1%.
strings.help_potion_viciousness: For every potion drank, increase Critical Hit damage by 2%.
strings.help_regeneration: Health regenerated at the start of every turn.
strings.help_retaliation: Physical/Magical damage dealt back to melee attackers.
strings.help_status_immunity: Chance to avoid being inflicted a negative Status Effect.
strings.help_threat: The weight of this unit when a target is rolled among a pool of units.
strings.item_aberrant_fabric_description: A piece of fabric of unknown origin, worn by the members of a cult that wishes for the return of the Ancient.
strings.item_abiotic_core_description: An artificial mechanism that can control an organic brain, amplifying its capabilities enough to manipulate the physical world that surrounds it.
strings.item_abyssal_goo_description: Viscous potion that can enhance some base materials with additional, terrifying properties.
strings.item_abyssal_ingot_description: A black Iron ingot blessed with eldritch properties from the depth of the abyss.
strings.item_abyssal_seashell_description: Large seashell found in the north-western seas. Mostly used as decoration, possesses some interesting properties.
strings.item_aether_ignis_description: Flammable liquid used to make flight possible for the heavy flying ships of the Celestial Army.
strings.item_alchemic_powder_description: The mysterious substance responsible of infusing life into the titans roaming the cultists lair. The origin seems organic.
strings.item_alpha_wolf_fang_description: A partitularly long tooth, once belonging to the leader of a pack of wolves.
strings.item_ancestral_blood_description: Blood drawn from Lazarus, the first vampire.
strings.item_ancient_hide_description: Scale covered hide of a giant, archaic beast living at the center of the world.
strings.item_ancient_membrane_description: An incredibly durable yet lightweight membrane, taken from the wing of a creature believed to have gone extinct millions of years ago.
strings.item_ancient_seed_description: A hardened, very old seed that seems to possess magical properties.
strings.item_animated_ingot_description: Metal ingot smelted from pieces of Living Metal.
strings.item_animated_scraps_description: Pieces of an unknown metal. They move erratically when left alone, and pulsate with an eerie light.
strings.item_astral_goo_description: A chunk of a giant, nightmarish monster that surpasses a mortal's wildest fantasy. You are not sure of its utility.
strings.item_bag_of_choking_powder_description: A bag of irritant powder that Giant Moth wings are covered in. It allows for a more aerodynamic flight, but irritates the airways of most other living beings.
strings.item_banshee_claw_description: The sharp and resilient claw of a Banshee
strings.item_banshee_horn_description: Twisted, black horn of a Banshee
strings.item_banshee_scale_description: Hard scale making up the skin of a Banshee
strings.item_bat_tooth_description: Frontal tooth of a Vampire Bat. Sometimes used as alchemic ingredient.
strings.item_bat_wing_description: The resilient wing of a Vampire Bat.
strings.item_beast_pelt_description: The pelt of a wild animals, usually refined to make Leather.
strings.item_black_hide_description: The skin of a horrible monster preying in the dark.
strings.item_black_iron_ingot_description: Extremely resistant metal alloy. It's formula is jealously guarded by the pirate blacksmiths.
strings.item_black_iron_scraps_description: Scraps of the famed metal, ready to be fused into an ingot.
strings.item_black_ooze_description: A dense, sticky black substance. It is believed to be a byproduct of the soul-stealing process from the eldritch gods.
strings.item_boar_tusk_description: A well preserved tusk from a wild boar.
strings.item_bone_fragment_description: Fragments of a bone once belonging to a valiant soldier.
strings.item_bottled_sand_spirit_description: A powerful Djinn spirit trapped in a bottle.
strings.item_celestial_metal_description: An ingot made from recovered scraps.
strings.item_celestial_scraps_description: Hard metal with an impossibly high fusion point. Must be some kind of alloy made with unknown ingredients.
strings.item_chain_link_description: Surprisingly light ring of unknown metal, seems to possess some magical properties.
strings.item_chain_of_redemption_description: Light but very resistant chain that seems to reflect part of the incoming force, magical or not.
strings.item_charred_heart_description: A coal chunk vaguely resembling the shape of a heart, still weakly beating despite its condition, and the fact that it has been extracted from the owner's chest.
strings.item_cleansing_potion_description: A clear blue concoction able to restore the original properties of items degraded due to the corruption.
strings.item_cloth_description: A versatile textile usually employed in the production of robes or cloaks.
strings.item_cobweb_bundle_description: Unrefined mass of Giant Spider's cobwebs. Can be refined into an unbreakable textile.
strings.item_coin_purse_description: A purse full of coins of various denominations. Worth it's weight in silver.
strings.item_containment_orb_description: Glass orb reinforced by magic, needed to contain powerful but dangerous artifacts.
strings.item_copper_ingot_description: An ingot made of copper. Can be smelted in any shape to produce all kinds of equipment.
strings.item_copper_ore_description: A malleable metal with a distinctive reddish-brown hue.
strings.item_corsair_leather_description: Exotic kind of leather that comes from processed Monkey Hide.
strings.item_cottontail_fur_description: The fur of the elusive Golden Rabbit.
strings.item_crimson_brew_description: A thick potion displaying a vivid red color.
strings.item_crusader_insigna_description: The woven seal of the Crusaders of the Eastern Kingdom. A symbol of hope for their people, heralding light in their darkest moments.
strings.item_cursed_silver_description: An extremely light chunk of silver that glows with an eerie light.
strings.item_deep_sea_velvet_description: A piece of Exotic Velvet blessed with eldritch properties from the depth of the abyss.
strings.item_diamond_description: A very hard gem that appears to be impossible to scratch. Only a handful of these have ever been found on the surface, making it an ideal gift for powerful kings or emperors.
strings.item_dreamwrought_hide_description: Hide fetched from a dangerous, colossal dream creature. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.
strings.item_dreamwrought_larva_description: The first stage of development of an insect materialized from a dream.
strings.item_dreamwrought_mane_description: The thick mane of a Dreamwrought Beast.
strings.item_dreamwrought_silk_description: Extremely flexible cloth woven from a dream like thread. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.
strings.item_dreamwrought_steel_description: Very malleable metal materialized from a dream by an expert blacksmith. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.
strings.item_elastic_membrane_description: A sheath of a weird material that could be either natural or artificial.
strings.item_eldritch_seal_description: The Seal of the Outer God, worn by his priests to show their unwavering faith.
strings.item_eldritch_shred_description: A fragment of a larger tapestry, it can be combined with other pieces to reveal the complete picture.
strings.item_eldritch_tendril_description: One of the tendrils of a Beholder. You can feel its powerful magic still flowing into the appendage.
strings.item_electric_catalyst_description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.
strings.item_elixir_of_affinity_description: Very difficult to brew even for the most skilled alchemists, made from ingredients of legendary rarity, this elixir acts as a neutral glue for substances that would otherwise reject each other.
strings.item_elixir_of_learning_description: Magic concoction that briefly boosts the ability of a student to learn new concepts.
strings.item_elongated_bone_description: An unusually long bone, probably coming from a hind leg of a war hound.
strings.item_elysian_wood_description: An extremely rare wood found in a minority of trees in the Southern Lands. Seems to keep sprouting new branches even when chopped off the original tree.
strings.item_emerald_description: Precious green gemstone, widely employed in the field of jewelry.
strings.item_essence_of_corruption_description: Pitch black potion distilled from the Black Ooze. When purified through additional steps, it can manifest unique properties.
strings.item_exalted_powder_description: Alchemic powder enriched to display new magical properties. Only this powder is pure enough to be merged with the Primordial, increasing its strength.
strings.item_exotic_velvet_description: Very smooth and prestigious textile imported by pirates from distant lands.
strings.item_eye_of_the_abyss_description: Seeing its dimensions makes you wonder what kind of monsters lurk in the ocean's depth. Powerful and very rare alchemic ingredient.
strings.item_eyes_of_the_swordsman_description: The eyes of the first general of the Sha'huri Army. A unique battle trophy.
strings.item_feather_description: A very light feather with a variety of uses.
strings.item_fire_catalyst_description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.
strings.item_fireproof_oil_description: An oil obtained through unknown means that allow anything covered in it to be immune to fire.
