strings.item_flake_of_infinity_description: A piece of an incredibly powerful being, that somehow crossed the threshold between the mortal world and something else.
strings.item_fleetfoot_fabric_description: A magic textile enchanted by unknown rituals. Grants the wearer a reduction in its weight.
strings.item_flux_limiter_description: An organic mass of nerves and tendrils, shaped to have specific optic properties.
strings.item_frost_crystal_description: An extremely sharp crystal displaying minor magical properties. Despite its nature, it never melts.
strings.item_frost_nucleus_description: The magic pebble around which an Ice Elemental can form.
strings.item_frostmetal_ingot_description: An ingot of a peculiar type of metal that mixes the properties of iron and ice.
strings.item_frostmetal_ore_description: A raw piece of very strong and cold metal. Can be smelted into ingots.
strings.item_frozen_egg_description: The egg of a Snow Wyvern. It's unique properties seem to increase the danger cold weather poses to those around it.
strings.item_frozen_scale_description: A scale of the fearsome Snow Wyvern. Always a few degrees lower than room temperature.
strings.item_ghostwood_stump_description: Ghostwood replacement for a lost leg, a common occurrence in the pirate's world.
strings.item_ghostwoood_board_description: Board of Ghostwood ready to be employed for the creation of various equipments.
strings.item_giant_moth_wing_description: A moth wing of unusual dimensions, possesses greater elasticity than its smaller counterparts.
strings.item_giant_shell_fragment_description: A piece of an extremely hard shell.
strings.item_gift_of_light_description: A mysterious reagent gifted by a god of light.
strings.item_glass_description: Sand heated to form transparent, smooth surface.
strings.item_gold_ingot_description: A precious metal widely employed in the production of high-grade military equipment for the Imperial Army.
strings.item_gold_scraps_description: Scraps of gold retrieved from broken equipment. Can be smelted into ingot.
strings.item_green_slime_description: Green, transparent jelly that makes up the body of Slimes.
strings.item_heart_of_darkness_description: The heart of a being predating existence itself. An expression of hatred unmatched by anything else.
strings.item_holy_water_description: Water blessed with a secret ritual by a bishop of the capital. Can be used to remove curses from items or living creatures, but due to the length of the rituals involved in its production only the most wealthy individuals can afford it.
strings.item_ice_catalyst_description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.
strings.item_ice_fiber_description: A thin thread of ice-like textile, likely made with a technique only known to the Trolls.
strings.item_infected_blood_description: Blood carrying the mysterious infection that can turn regular undead into ghouls. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.
strings.item_infernite_description: Mysterious mineral forged by the hottest fire, remarkably resistant yet light as a feather. Oddly cold at touch, allows to forge items with impossible aerodynamics, not reproducible with any other means.
strings.item_infusion_of_wisdom_description: An oil that can be applied to certain armors or garments, able to boost the learning speed of those who wear it.
strings.item_iron_ingot_description: A durable and resistant metal, usually employed to craft battle armaments.
strings.item_ivory_description: Smooth, pale white material derived from tusks of animals.
strings.item_kabelian_metal_description: Rare metal from the eastern lands. Displays some unique properties, likely coming from the psyonic ability of the people who smelted it.
strings.item_kaunian_fabric_description: Thick and hard fabric displaying properties more close to those found in metal. Doesn't display any magical property, but will do an excellent job in protecting its owner.
strings.item_kindlequartz_description: Cold at touch, this peculiar gem reflects light with a flame-like shimmer. Seems to draw the curiosity of the nearby wildlife.
strings.item_large_iris_description: An intact eye of a slain Beholder. Can be used as a perfectly focused magic lens.
strings.item_laroxian_fabric_description: An incredibly resistant but light fabric, enchanted with a variety of spells to enhance its properties.
strings.item_leather_description: A resistant but light material, usually employed in the making of armors or armor paddings.
strings.item_living_sap_description: The sap from a living tree.
strings.item_living_vine_description: A long, resistant vine ripped from an ancient tree that moves on its own volition.
strings.item_long_serpent_fang_description: A very long and sharp fang taken from a wild Spitfang.
strings.item_metamorphic_sand_description: Looks like regular sand at first glance, but displays peculiar shapeshifting properties.
strings.item_missing_page_description: A single page of some old book.
strings.item_mithril_description: A legendary alloy, unbreakable by traditional means. Its creation remains a guarded secret of the dwellers of the Forgotten Lands.
strings.item_monkey_hide_description: The hide of a Capuchin Monkey, a small primate usually kept as pet and assistant by some Skull Island pirates.
strings.item_mutant_hide_description: Extremely thick skin from a creature mutated through horrifying experiments. Hard to adapt to the human body, but impenetrable with conventional weapons.
strings.item_mysterious_appendage_description: The viscid limb taken from a deep sea monster.
strings.item_mysterious_cog_description: A simple brass cog. No one knoes its exact function, or can explain the immense power it contains.
strings.item_nightwing_leather_description: High end leather sought after in all the Realms. Retrieving this material is so dangerous that only few people have ever owned it.
strings.item_obsidian_chunk_description: Dark, reflective stone famous for its durability, and sharpness when broken into pieces.
strings.item_orb_of_ectoplasm_description: An orb of otherworldly matter, stirring upon itself in an endless dance.
strings.item_orichalcum_ingot_description: Unbreakable metal from another world. Sacrifices malleability to increase its resistance.
strings.item_orichalcum_scraps_description: Pieces of an unbreakable metal that can be melted into ingots.
strings.item_pearl_description: Perfectly round and with a smooth surface. Very prized material for jewelers.
strings.item_permafrost_core_description: Unstable core that instantly freezes everything around it.
strings.item_permafrost_essence_description: Stabilized Permafrost Core, can be used to craft powerful items.
strings.item_phoenix_feather_description: A feather plucked from the mythical Phoenix.
strings.item_phylactery_fragment_description: Fragment of a powerful artifact. Has something to do with death-altering magic.
strings.item_plant_fiber_description: A base ingredient used in the production of textiles.
strings.item_poisonous_flesh_description: The flesh of a mushroom that lives deep underground. It contains a strange poison with a paralyzing effect, and requires careful handling.
strings.item_prehistoric_mixture_description: A strange amalgam of ingredients from the depths of the Forgotten Lands, seamlessly fused together and exhibiting unique catalytic properties.
strings.item_primeval_scale_description: The enormous scale making up the armor of a colossal Wurm roaming below the Southern Grove.
strings.item_primordial_essence_description: The essence of a primordial being, commonly used as alchemic ingredient.
strings.item_prismatic_essence_description: Stabilized essence displaying a variety of colors, elementally neutral but radiating pure arcane energy.
strings.item_pterodactyl_claw_description: Giant claw of a flying monster previously thought to be extinct.
strings.item_quartz_description: Hard, crystalline mineral found rarely in the deserts and prized for its beauty.
strings.item_radiating_nucleus_description: A powerful, magical device that can store an immense amount of energy. Serves as an engine for Laroxian constructs.
strings.item_recurve_blade_description: A peculiar recurve blade. Unusable in the current state as it's handle is missing.
strings.item_redwood_description: Peculiar wood from the far east, rarely found in trading points thanks to traveling merchants. Displays a characteristic red shade.
strings.item_ruby_description: Deep red gemstone with a rich allure, and used to craft a wide range of jewels
strings.item_rune_of_power_description: Rune carefully engraved with great mastery into a simple rock, capable of increasing the power of a wizard by orders of magnitude.
strings.item_sandstone_description: A stone made of sand solidified into a stone-like block.
strings.item_scanner_description: An unknown device made of flesh, metal and stone. Seems capable to detect movement without relying on light.
strings.item_scarlet_strand_description: Gift from an ancient divine force to its worshippers. Only a few exemplars are known to exist, and their strength and quality is legendary. It can be spun in the workshop from materials gathered around the Drowned Port and the Shattered Peaks.
strings.item_scrap_metal_description: Pieces of metal that usually comes from broken battle gear. Can be smelted into ingots and recycled.
strings.item_seal_of_claris_description: Magic seal of Claris, the rebel Cultist.
strings.item_sentient_slab_description: A stone slab from one of the titans created in secret with a cursed ritual.
strings.item_shadow_gem_description: When a living being touches this gem, whatever their nature is, they are instantly drawn to darkness.
strings.item_shadow_potion_description: With a bright purple color, items can be infused to provide bonuses in dark areas.
strings.item_shahuri_bow_frame_description: The bow frame used to make the renowned Sha'huri bows.
strings.item_sharp_rib_description: A rib ripped from an undead soldier. It's well conserved and very sharp.
strings.item_silk_fabric_description: Luxurious, smooth fabric prized for its softness and sheen. Used to craft superior light clothing.
strings.item_silk_thread_description: Delicate fiber used to weave the fabric of the same name.
strings.item_sinister_stabilizer_description: A powerful catalyst used to clear the arcane properties of powerful artifacts that may be cursed, or magically bound to another entity.
strings.item_soul_shard_description: Condensed fragment of the multitude of souls, crystallized inside the creature they inhabited.
strings.item_spectral_cloth_description: Otherworldly textile made with a glowing thread. Clearly not crafted by human hands.
strings.item_spellwoven_hide_description: Skin of a creature conjured through a spell, persisting in this world after its defeat.
strings.item_spellwoven_leather_description: Leather made from the skin of a creature summoned through magical means.
strings.item_spider_leg_description: Leg of a Giant Spider. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.
strings.item_spider_silk_description: Made from an almost indestructible thread, this light material offers protection with minimal hindrance to one's movements.
strings.item_spirit_candle_description: A magic candle of mysterious origin. It never burns out, and cannot be extinguished with any known mean.
strings.item_spitfang_scale_description: Light and resilient scale making up the skin of a Spitfang.
strings.item_star_fragment_description: A fragment of a distant star, containing an immense amount of power.
strings.item_static_core_description: Unstable core displaying an extremely strong electric field.
strings.item_static_essence_description: Stabilized Static Core, can be used to craft powerful items.
strings.item_sunfire_core_description: Unstable core burning with the power of a small sun.
strings.item_sunfire_essence_description: Stabilized Sunfire Core, can be used to craft powerful items.
strings.item_synapse_description: A small wire capable of conducting electric and thermal energy extremely well.
strings.item_tattered_hide_description: The decomposed hide of an undead war beast.
strings.item_terrorsaurus_fang_description: Giant tooth of a voracious creature found in the depth of the world.
strings.item_thaumaturgic_blood_description: Once infected blood drawn from a fearsome ghoul, it has been purified by a powerful reagent. Unlike the base ingredient, it displays powerful healing properties.
strings.item_tortoise_thorn_description: A very sharp thorn broken off a Giant Tortoise shell.
strings.item_troll_hide_description: Hard as a stone but light as regular leather. Used to craft superior quality equipment.
strings.item_unholy_potion_description: All living beings are naturally repelled by its smell. The antithesis of all that is good, conveniently condensed in liquid form.
strings.item_unstable_gem_description: A gem that vibrates in its own magical frequency. These are the building blocks of the immense Laroxian Nexus, and will one day be correctly attuned and integrated into its design to amplify its power.
strings.item_veil_breaker_description: A staple tool in the bag of the arcane engineer. Allows workers without the gift of magic to manually operate across the veil that separates the physical world from the Arcane Flow.
strings.item_veil_shatterer_description: An extraordinarily powerful magical artifact, capable of overcoming any opposing magical force. It is the only known way to directly interact with the Nexus Core.
strings.item_void_core_description: Unstable core surrounded by a void area where no regular matter can exist.
strings.item_voodoo_doll_description: Permeated with an ancient, despicable magic, in the right hands this simple cloth doll could inflict unimaginable suffering to an unaware victim.
strings.item_warden_belt_description: Hard leather belt characterizing the outfit of the wardens of the Golden City.
strings.item_warlord_skull_description: An intact skull of a renowned soldier, once leading it's ranks against the enemy.
strings.item_werewolf_fang_description: Something is really wrong with this tooth…
strings.item_white_slime_description: A white blob taken from the body of a one of a kind slime deity.
strings.item_wicked_seal_description: እንደ ላይ እንደ ታች። አሥርቱ ገሃነሞች እንደገና ተከፍተው ይሆናል፣ በመሠዊያችንም እንደ ሁሉም ይበላሉ።
strings.item_wing_fabric_description: Very light and elastic textile made from the wings of moths.
strings.item_wintercloth_description: Despite being a very thin cloth, it isolates almost perfectly from the external cold.
strings.item_winterwood_description: Very sturdy wood from the only tree that can grow in sub-zero temperatures, the Winter Tree.
strings.item_wood_description: Just a simple piece of wood.
strings.item_wurm_blood_description: Blood drawn from a Wurm. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.
strings.item_wurm_scale_description: Very hard keratin scales covering the body of the desert Wurms. Can be used as plates to reinforce equipment.
strings.label: Label
strings.log_amulet_of_resurrection: %s is resurrected by the Amulet of Resurrection
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_encounter_1: From a nearby wall, reanimated bodies crawl towards the expedition
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_encounter_2: A nearby wooden door is shattered into a thousand splinters by a towering presence.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_encounter_3: In front of them, an undead clad in a golden armor orders its followers into the battle. A curious display of sentience for an undead, the team notes.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_encounter_4: From the darkness, the monsters start running at the adventurers.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_encounter_5: A second wave of undead leaves the team no respite.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_encounter_6: Inside the crypt, a decrepit skeleton holding a metal scepter lets out a frightening scream.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_enter: The guild enters the Catacombs below the Ashen Field. A thousand years ago a lich was silenced here, not killed. The silence is over.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_event_1: Without its master's magic to hold the pieces together, the Necrolith crumbles to dust.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_1: The adventurers take the first step beyond the open door.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_10: The voice speaks again, clearer now: "A thousand years… and still they send adventurers. Come forth, my children."
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_11: The door is unlocked, and reveals a circular crypt.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_12: Kabar the Rotten falls quiet once more. There is still no way to kill a lich, and this one has learned to wait. The team climbs back to the surface.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_2: Piles of skulls and bones are piled up on the sides, covering the walls of the corridor.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_3: The air becomes more chilling, the corridor darker. The noises from below are almost unbearable.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_4: The corridor ceiling gets a bit lower.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_5: The group resumes their expedition, taking a flight of stairs down to the lower levels.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_6: The stairs end, and the corridor opens into a large, dark hall.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_7: A voice of unknown origin, as dry as these putrid walls, echoes in the hall. It is not loud enough to understand.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_8: In the center of the circular hall, a pillar made of bones holds up the tall ceiling.
strings.log_ancient_grave_digging_room_9: At the end of the now empty hall, an adorned iron door blocks the path.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_encounter_1: The team steps into an unavoidable fight.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_encounter_2: In the open field, the team is spotted from far away.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_encounter_3: Just in time, the adventurers turn around to find enemies charging at them.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_encounter_4: After a strenuous run, the expedition realizes it must face the chasing threat.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_encounter_5: From behind a large fire burning in the plain, something attacks the expedition.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_enter: The plains are burning again. The Celestial Goddess has begun a second Cleansing, larger than the first: golden ships fill the sky, and the Banshees are nearly gone. Somewhere in the chaos, the Herald's trail continues south.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_finding_1: In the ground, in an abandoned Banshee burrow, lies a poorly concealed alien weapon. The team is about to step on the tripwire.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_1: Far away, a Banshee crawls out of the ground and leaps to an unsuspecting invader trying to burn some remains. It's over before he even notices the attacker.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_10: Fires are burning all around the team, making the air almost unbreathable.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_2: A large celestial platoon is marching to the north. The team hides behind a nearby rock, waiting for them to pass.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_3: A wounded Banshee digs a hole in the ground at surprising speed and disappears inside it.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_4: A flying ship is scanning the ground for living targets. You hope it didn't locate the expedition.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_5: A huge golden ship, clearly not from this world, appears in the sky out of thin air. Tens of celestials jump down several meters on an unsuspecting Banshee.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_6: On your left, a group of celestials are pouring an unknown liquid inside one of the holes on the ground.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_7: The team proceeds with caution, surrounded by the sounds of the ongoing battle.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_8: On the ground are still visible the remains of a recent skirmish.
strings.log_barren_wastelands_room_9: A large group of flying eyes floating above suddenly divides, each racing in a different direction.
strings.log_blackwater_port_encounter_1: Hostile entities appear from behind a nearby lowered sail
strings.log_blackwater_port_encounter_2: A glass bottle cracks nearby. Immediately after, something attack you.
strings.log_blackwater_port_encounter_3: Distracted by the rustling of the waves, you realize almost too late you are being followed.
strings.log_blackwater_port_encounter_4: From below the docks, something emerges. It wants your heads.
strings.log_blackwater_port_encounter_5: The cracking of the wood planks below alerts you of the incoming attack.
strings.log_blackwater_port_enter: Half of Blackwater Port lies under the sea now. The monster that a guild wounded here a thousand years ago survived, and it dragged the docks down with it. The pirates of Skull Island live on the wrecks that still float.
strings.log_blackwater_port_event_1a: There are no pirates on these decks. Something has been feeding.
strings.log_blackwater_port_event_1b: You notice a huge, dark spot just below the surface. What kind of horror lies under the sea?
strings.log_blackwater_port_event_1c: The unknown mass goes back to the dark ocean depths.
strings.log_blackwater_port_event_1d: A small round object floats to the surface: an Eye of the Abyss. The old wound has opened again. The monster is far from dead.
strings.log_blackwater_port_finding_1: A scared capuchin monkey emerges from beyond some crates. How long was it hiding there? It hands you a polished oyster pearl, and runs to the woods outside the port.
strings.log_blackwater_port_finding_2: A tripwire suddenly snaps, triggering nearby flintlock guns aimed at the team.
strings.log_blackwater_port_finding_3: When a team member steps on a hidden pressure plate, a huge anchors falls from above.
strings.log_blackwater_port_finding_4: A pile of gold is sitting in front of the adventurers. As soon as they touch it, the curse activates and it turns into a sticky, corrosive substance.
strings.log_blackwater_port_finding_5: A suspended net is released onto the adventurers, ensnaring them. The water in the chamber starts rising.
strings.log_blackwater_port_room_1: Walking along the quay, the several docked ships are all in ruins. You swear you saw a candle light in a distant cabin.
strings.log_blackwater_port_room_2: A building near the coast crumbled on the paved street. The team is forced to board one of the decaying ship to circumvent the obstacle.
strings.log_blackwater_port_room_3: The wood below the team's feet creaks dangerously as they advance through the docks.
strings.log_blackwater_port_room_4: A ship sailing far from your position sounds its horns. It's unlikely they saw the expedition… right?
strings.log_blackwater_port_room_5: A feral monkey rushes at the team with a dull knife. A tentacle as old as the port rises from the water and drags it below.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_1: Two flying devices spot the team; one immediately flies off.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_10: He flips a switch and charges toward the adventurers.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_2: A nearby patrol shifts its focus toward the team.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_3: The first wave reaches the team and attacks with full force.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_4: Another wave prepares to halt the advance.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_6: A massive ship hovers overhead, as ground units leap several meters to the ground.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_7: More ships approach, accompanied by ground support.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_8: Two unknown devices on the side of the door are armed.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_encounter_9: Two devices, identical to the ones encountered before, are activated.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_enter: At the edge of the Burning Plains, the flagship of the second Cleansing has landed. The Kingdom orders the guild to strike its power source before the whole region is burned.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_event_1: With its source of power irreversibly compromised, the G.C.S.S. deactivates.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_1: As they approach, it becomes clear the structure is of artificial origin.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_10: With the whole Celestial Army at your heels, the team manage to climb onto the structure.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_11: Inside, the structure is even more alien: vast, empty spaces with ceilings soaring tens of meters high and architecture unlike anything they've ever seen.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_12: In front, an imposing metal door blocks the path.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_13: Behind the door is a large round room, with no other exits in sight.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_14: In the center, a lone lever is present. When pulled, it lifts the team to the upper levels.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_15: A small atrium lies ahead, with a door similar to the one they forced open earlier.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_16: A long corridor leads to a round room filled with switches and levers.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_17: In the command hall, Legate Varro rises from his chair. Hadrian's sword hangs on the wall behind him.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_18: Cracks begin to form on the structure's ceiling, suggesting the triggering of some safety mechanism.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_19: As the hall collapses, someone pulls a lever. The team is thrown miles away and watches the flagship fall. Among its charts is a map of the deep caverns, marked with the sign of the Herald.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_2: Beneath the structure, hundreds of thousands of celestial soldiers stand ready in the distance.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_3: Suddenly, the enemy ranks stir, metal clattering as they advance toward your position!
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_4: The expedition hurries across the barren landscape, skipping through the ever present banshee burrows.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_5: As the celestial structure looms closer, the team shivers, awestruck by its immense size.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_6: Chased by the entire celestial army, the team sharply veers into a narrow passage, hoping to delay the advance.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_7: After a few minutes of running, the metallic clatter of the celestial horde fades a little, and the team spots the exit of the passage.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_8: The expedition is now no more than a minute away from the building.
strings.log_celestial_mothership_room_9: Several ropes hang from a metal platform above. The horde is closing in.
strings.log_darkness_0: [Darkness: %d%%] - There's plenty of light, and Adventurers can explore safely.
strings.log_darkness_1_25: [Darkness: %d%%] - It might be a bit harder to hit enemies and dodge attacks and traps.
strings.log_darkness_26_50: [Darkness: %d%%] - It will be difficult to hit enemies and dodge attacks and traps.
strings.log_darkness_51_75: [Darkness: %d%%] - It will be very hard to hit enemies and dodge attacks and traps.
strings.log_darkness_76_100: [Darkness: %d%%] - It will be almost impossible to hit enemies and dodge attacks and traps.
strings.log_divine_archeology_encounter_1: A small Sha'huri group, likely standing guard to the sacred site, spots the team.
strings.log_divine_archeology_encounter_2: The ancient defense system activates once again, and warriors emerge from the sand. They look way more threatening than the ones you have met before.
strings.log_divine_archeology_encounter_3: Another wave of statues emerges from the sand, still gaining consistency at the time they first strike you.
strings.log_divine_archeology_encounter_4: The relentless stream of sentient sand keeps coming without a break.
strings.log_divine_archeology_encounter_5: A towering guardian with four swords bars the corridor. Its armor bears the crest of Sha'Kire, the First Swordsman.
strings.log_divine_archeology_encounter_6: In the inner chamber stands a figure shaped like the hidden god. It opens a single eye. Something behind that eye is looking at you, and it is not Sha.
strings.log_divine_archeology_enter: Far to the east of the dunes stands the pyramid that once hid the Sha'huri god. It should be empty. Yet the guards are back, and fresh torches burn at its entrance.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_1: The adventurers navigate through the dunes, their boots sinking into the warm sand. Slowly, the pyramid is getting closer.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_10a: Together, the adventurers push the door with all their strength. However, it doesn't seem to move. [Global Constitution required: 200]
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_10b: Together, the adventurers push the door with all their strength. Slowly, it opens wide to reveal a single, inner chamber.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_11: The False Idol cracks and falls apart, and the presence behind its eye withdraws. Among the debris lies a small trinket and a line of fresh writing: "The Herald walks north."
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_2: The rhythmic crunch of footsteps harmonizes with the desert winds, as the expedition starts to make out the intricate block pattern that makes up the building.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_3: The sound of blaring trumpets is heard in the distance, and the sand starts twisting below your feet. This is unlikely to be a good sign.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_4: Sha'huri deterrent system activated, threat level: EXTINCTION.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_5: The trumpet sound finally stop, and the sand is once again at rest.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_6: After some more minutes, the team is getting close to the pyramid. As they advance, the immense size of the construction becomes more apparent.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_7: At the base of the pyramid, carvings show a god fleeing from a serpent that eats the sky. The corridor ahead is lit.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_8: The team walks deeper into the corridor that seems to never end, being thankful for the torches that make the travel less frightening.
strings.log_divine_archeology_room_9: A giant stone door blocks the path. The old seal of the open eye has been chiselled away, and a new one carved over it.
strings.log_dodge_attack: %s attacked %s, but it was dodged. Dodge chance was %s%%
strings.log_dodge_flying: %s attacked %s, but it can't reach flying targets
strings.log_enchanted_forest_encounter_1: There is a sound of a branch cracking. The team turns around.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_encounter_2: Few meters ahead, from the bushes, a pair of eyes are watching the expedition.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_encounter_3: Something was here before you, and has no intention to leave.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_encounter_4: A low pitched growl echoes in the air.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_encounter_5: You notice a movement behind the trees.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_enter: The new guild sets out from its camp, raised on the ruins of the old one. A thousand years have turned the forest into the Elderwood: older, darker, and once again touched by the corruption.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_event_1a: A piercing scream echoes through the ancient trees. It's rapidly getting closer…
strings.log_enchanted_forest_event_1b: Among the trees, an old spirit stands before you. "You are not them…" — the wind whispers.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_finding_1:
The group approaches an old fountain, covered in moss but otherwise perfectly functioning. After drinking its water, all wounds instantly disappear.
Adventurers' HP are fully restored.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_finding_2:
The team finds a small fairy, trapped in a hunter's net and screaming at the top of her lungs. When they free her, she performs a quick spell and disappears into the crowns of the trees.
Adventurers' Mana has been filled.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_finding_3: A large pitfall setup by hunters, concealed by a patch of leaves, lies in front of the team.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_room_1: The team makes its way into a forest clearing, bathed in dim sunlight and surrounded by ancient trees.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_room_2: There is a narrow forest path ahead, enclosed by towering trees.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_room_3: This area is engulfed by an abundance of high trees and untamed wilderness. It's very hard to see the sky above.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_room_4: Blooming wildflowers are scattered everywhere, along with a few trees. Would have been a nice place for a camping trip in better times.
strings.log_enchanted_forest_room_5: The trees make space for a narrow forest path, now muddy and overgrown with shrubs.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_encounter_1: Dead hands grasp the ground below the team's feet, struggling to reach the surface.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_encounter_2: Right in front of you, something notices your presence. It instantly attacks.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_encounter_3: Surprised by an unbearable stench, the team turns around to discover the enemies following them.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_encounter_4: Something stands up from the burning pile of bodies, refusing to stay dead.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_encounter_5: Without notice, the wind briefly opens up the smoke barrier, revealing the group to a hostile presence.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_enter: The thousand-year battlefield is two thousand years old now. Ash covers everything, and the Imperial and Sha'huri dead still refuse to rest.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_event_1a: The Will o' Wisp thanks you for freeing it from its mortal body. [Will o' Wisps slain: %d/200]
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_event_1b: A Will o' Wisp descends from the sky. Unlike the others, he doesn't seem hostile. It offers an Orb of Ectoplasm as a gift and departs without a word.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_finding_1: A cable holding an Imperial's explosive trap is stepped on.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_finding_2: The team finds themselves on a hidden Sha'huri seal, covered by the ashes. It lightens up, and horrible visions flood the adventurers minds.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_room_1: The adventurers cover their mouths as they pass a pile of burning remains.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_room_2: The team enters a frugal encampment, now deserted, with plates still full of food near an extinguished campfire.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_room_3: The sun, high in the sky, is barely visible though the tick fog.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_room_4: The ground is scattered by Sha'huri remains, displaying the kind of wounds that no weapon made by men could inflict.
strings.log_eternal_battlefield_room_5: In the distance, an army of the dead marches north, as if called.
strings.log_flee: After a long fight, the team realizes they are not going to win and run from the fight. [Fights end after 400 cumulative turns!]
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_encounter_1: The team notices a pungent smell in the air. Not long after, it discovers why.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_encounter_2: There are footsteps in the snow. The trail ends soon to a group of enemies.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_encounter_3: Behind a nearby rock, enemies were waiting for you.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_encounter_4: Something was perfectly camouflaged in the white snow. It attacks the expedition as soon as they approach.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_encounter_5: From a nearby cave opening, a group of enemies emerges to attack the team.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_enter: The Shattered Peaks were split by the first Graft and never healed. Trolls have left their caves and are fleeing down the mountain, away from something on the summit.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_event_1a: The wind gets suddenly colder. A blizzard descends upon the mountains, greatly reducing visibility and increasing the threat of freezing.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_finding_1a: Behind a nearby rock lies a winterwood crate with a huge iron lock. It must be a Troll storage of sorts. With a Dexterity of %s, %s tries to pick the lock. It has a %s%% proability of success.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_finding_2: A pressure plate, hidden by snow, makes the ice crack below the teams feet. Soon enough, everyone will be submerged in freezing water.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_1: A narrow passage forces the expedition to form a line and hug the mountain, being extremely careful as to not fall in the chasm below.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_2: Even with the heaviest equipment, the ice cold climate makes every step harder than the previous.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_3: The expedition stops for a break and lights a fire in a shallow caves opening.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_4: From the summit, a purple pillar can be seen rising to the sky, exactly like the one in the old chronicles. A new Graft is being raised.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_5: The team discovers a frozen pile of bodies, perfectly preserved from the cold. Bite marks and sings of blunt force trauma indicate that cold was unlikely the cause of death.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_6: Climbing gear hangs from the cliff, so old it has turned to stone. A guild crest is still visible on it.
strings.log_frostbite_peaks_room_7: Fresh equipment lies around a cold campfire: cult robes, and a forge hammer bearing a titan's mark.
strings.log_healing_nova: Adventurers are healed %s%% missing HP by %s
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_encounter_1: A sharp, whistling sound approaches at lightning speed.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_encounter_2: Turning a corner, menacing figures notice the team's presence, and suddenly attack.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_encounter_3: Behind the team, enemies try a surprise attack.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_encounter_4: Quick, unintelligible words are uttered nearby just before the team is attacked
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_encounter_5: A nearby wooden door is obliterated by an overwhelming power. From the dark room beyond, enemies surge toward the team.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_enter: The Nexus of Larox now changes shape every hour, and the council of mages has split in two. One half follows the Herald, the other has locked itself in the lower streets. The team slips in through the old sewer passage.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_event_magic_amp:
In the distance, the Nexus shifts rapidly, forming shapes that defy human understanding. It emits a pulsating light before settling into a new, enigmatic configuration.
Magic Damage amplification is now %d%%
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_finding_1: From the feet of one of the team members, light begins to reveal the radial symmetry of a magic seal. A fraction of second later, a defensive spell is triggered.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_finding_2: The air grows intensely dry. In the distance, the massive artifact begins to pulsate with increasing intensity. Along the sides of the street, obsidian walls spring up in an instant, shielding the civilian buildings.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_finding_3:
An old mage pulls the team aside. His family kept the record of the guild that came here a thousand years ago, and he hopes you are as stubborn as they were. He uncorks a vial with a dark liquid.
Adventurers' HP are fully restored.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_1: From a nearby house, its walls adorned with arcane symbols, faint whispers in an ancient language can be heard.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_10: Two tall empty armors, animated by a blue light, stand guard to a nearby street.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_2: In the distance, the Nexus emits a strong shockwave, and reconfigures itself once more.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_3: A procession of robed individuals walks through a large street ahead. The team proceeds with extreme caution.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_4: On a nearby doorstep, five candles around a burnt, red incision suggest some kind of ritual recently took place.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_5: A skeleton lies suspended below a second floor window. What kind of civilized society allows this?
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_6: Several crystals emerging from the ground, a natural occurrence in these caverns, vibrate in the same frequency of the Nexus.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_7: Candles in a nearby house are immediately put off as the team approaches.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_8: A loud shout echoes in the distance, swiftly followed by a lightning in the same spot.
strings.log_hidden_city_of_larox_room_9: High above, a small, misshapen flying creature with a reddish hue soars through the air, clutching a piece of furniture.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_1: A crowd of enraged citizen fills the courtyard. They attack you.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_2: Another wave comes at you with bloodshot eyes.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_3: Another group engages. They want your heads.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_4: A group of guards is wandering the corridors aimlessly. As soon as they see you, they engage the fight.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_5: Another team of sentinels attacks you.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_6: The guests, probably struck by the corruption during the cursed meal, are still sitting at the table.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_7: A team of palace guards is roaming before the door.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_encounter_8: An inhumane scream comes from above the opened door, behind the team. Looking up, a hideous creature, still dressed in royal insignia, leaps down from the ceiling.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_enter: The heir to the throne is to be crowned today, and the coronation has become a ritual for the Eye. The Kingdom of Roderic's line orders the guild to save the heir before the Eye claims a new body.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_1: The team reaches the entrance of the huge courtyard. The Eye above is looking interested.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_10: Looking at the table, they notice the food is black with mold: it must have lied there for weeks.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_11: At the end of the room, an open door leads to a short corridor. It leads to a single door, at its end.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_12: The door bears the seal of the new dynasty, carved over the old crest of the Clovis family. It is closed, but unlocked.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_13: The door opens on the coronation hall. Golden banners hang over a ritual circle drawn in black ink.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_14: The heir lies unconscious beside the throne. On the throne, the Regent wears the crown.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_15: The Regent falls, and the Eye above closes. The heir wakes. On the throne, someone has carved: "The Herald walks north." The team carries the heir out of the palace and reports to the Kingdom.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_2: Marble statues with golden detail stand all over the perimeter, an immortal testament of the opulence of this court.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_3: In the middle of the courtyard an adorned fountain, now out of function, acts as the central decoration.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_4: At the end of the courtyard, a wide granite staircase leads up to the entrance of the Palace.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_5: One side of the door is halfway open. The expedition enters the palace.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_6: On the ground, a red carpet with golden edges extends all the way through the intertwined corridors.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_7: The team advances through rows of marble statues, recognizing at least a couple renowned generals.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_8: At the end of the corridor, the team finds a locked door, intricately decorated but easy to break down.
strings.log_imperial_rescue_room_9: The adventurers find themselves in a large dining room, with a long laden table.
strings.log_kaunis_encounter_1: A wave of mutated horrors surges down the road.
strings.log_kaunis_encounter_2: It crushes the old man in an instant and turn toward the adventurers.
strings.log_kaunis_encounter_4: They direct their attention at the intruders.
strings.log_kaunis_encounter_5: The manor's security force descends from all directions.
strings.log_kaunis_encounter_6: Instantly, they sprint down to attack.
strings.log_kaunis_encounter_7: They raise from their seats and attack.
strings.log_kaunis_enter: The machine opens a passage to Kaunis. A thousand years later, its self-repairing technology has spread across the whole land.
strings.log_kaunis_room_1: Rag-clad villagers glance at the newcomers and wave them away in fear. Moments later, they all retreat inside their homes.
strings.log_kaunis_room_10: The gates of a grand manor draw near. On the front steps, a group of disfigured mutants stands guard.
strings.log_kaunis_room_11: Inside, the manor's main hall is decrepit. Piles of broken furniture are stacked against one wall.
strings.log_kaunis_room_12: On the wide marble staircase, more writhing masses of flesh await.
strings.log_kaunis_room_13: A long corridor stretches above the stairs. The throne room must be close.
strings.log_kaunis_room_14: At the corridor's end stands a massive cracked door, half-open.
strings.log_kaunis_room_15: Beyond the door, the Royal Council sits around a table, strewn with rotten food and shattered bottles.
strings.log_kaunis_room_16: A monstrous figure wearing a rusted crown, once a man, now something else, calls for the guards. No one answers.
strings.log_kaunis_room_17: The council members lie on the ground. Their bodies are already more machine than flesh, and they are already repairing. The adventurers return to the portal.
strings.log_kaunis_room_2: An old man emerges from one of the crumbling houses. He warns that others will come soon, then begins recounting the story of his world: a utopia turned nightmare.
strings.log_kaunis_room_3: He speaks of the discovery of immortality, and of the mental decay triggered by the repeated return of the Black Serpent.
strings.log_kaunis_room_4: Of the discovery of the Panacea, able to stop the decline and allowing the ruling class to cling to power indefinitely.
strings.log_kaunis_room_5: And of the lie begotten by their fear, which created a demented government guided by madness, focused on creating the most advanced forms of repression disregarding all ethics.
strings.log_kaunis_room_6: From behind a building, a large monster emerges along with its following.
strings.log_kaunis_room_7: A red castle, enveloped by lightnings, looms at the horizon.
strings.log_kaunis_room_8: The adventurers continue down winding country roads, surrounded by barren fields.
strings.log_kaunis_room_9: The march is long and uneventful, until they spot something far away.
strings.log_lost_lands_encounter_1: From beyond the thick wall of leaves, enemies charge at the team.
strings.log_lost_lands_encounter_2: Behind the team, enemies are quickly approaching.
strings.log_lost_lands_encounter_3: A group of enemies emerges from the dark entrance of a nearby pyramid.
strings.log_lost_lands_encounter_4: The team is ambushed by enemies, who were waiting on the tall trees.
strings.log_lost_lands_encounter_5: As they round a bend in the winding stone path, the team is confronted by a group of enemies.
strings.log_lost_lands_enter: Below the Nexus lies the Molten Valley. The tribes of the volcano have begun the Fire Ritual again, this time in the Herald's name.
strings.log_lost_lands_event_summon: The Smoldering Titan rises from the volcano, answering a call that is not the tribe's.
strings.log_lost_lands_finding_1: A brief shimmer on a nearby rock, unassuming at first glance, catches the attention of one of the adventurers. Once broken, the rock reveals the most beautiful gem they have ever seen.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_1: The team opens its way through a thick patch of ferns.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_10: A rhythmic, tribal song is being chanted in the distance. No one can recognize the language.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_2: A stream of lava cuts the expedition path. They coast it for a while, looking for a way to cross it.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_3: A small path made of cobblestone leads somewhere in the middle of the vegetation.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_4: A tall pyramids made of giant stone blocks stands in the middle of a small valley. Rolling drum noises come from inside.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_5: An ear shattering roar comes from ahead. The team hides for a while.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_6: In the distance, a deep rumble is followed swiftly by a small jet of lava erupting from the volcano.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_7: Above your heads, a swarm of the biggest birds you have ever seen crosses the sky.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_8: A small, abandoned encampment lies in the middle of the forest. Below a steel cauldron, the embers are still smoking.
strings.log_lost_lands_room_9: The team sees two tree stumps, and a sharp stone axe planted firmly in one of them.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_encounter_1: Not far from your position, eerie steps on the rocky pavement alert the team.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_encounter_2: The limestone pillars concealed hostile presences.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_encounter_3: After turning a corner, something notices your presence and attacks you.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_encounter_4: Hidden in a dark spot, monsters leap at the expedition.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_encounter_5: From a dark pit in the ground, leading to the infested mine depths, monsters are crawling towards the team.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_enter: The Bleak Disciples dug below every level the Empire ever mined, and called the new depth the Hollow Deep. They are looking for a new body for their master. The horror at the bottom is still there, and it is no longer alone.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_event_1a: An unspeakable horror noticed your presence.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_1: Extinguished torches line up the walls of a corridor, way too damp to be ignited again.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_2: An empty abandoned cart lies on rails now full of rust.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_3: Thousand years old stalagmites descend from the rock ceiling, trickling drops of water in a small puddle.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_4: You hear flowing water near you: a small river must have found its way in the mine's crevasses.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_5: The team coasts a precipice leading into the void. Below, tens of skeletons still clad in imperial armors lie suspended into a huge spiderweb.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_6: Mining tools lie abandoned on the ground. An old mining expedition must have met something they were unprepared for.
strings.log_obsidian_mines_room_7: Disciples' tools lie beside imperial bones. The new tunnels go deeper than any map.
strings.log_respawn: Slowly, team members regain consciousness and medicate their wounds.
strings.log_search_item_found: Looking around the place, you found %s %s.
strings.log_search_no_item: Looking around, you didn't find anything of value.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_encounter_1: "You have to leave, or we'll feast on your bones"
strings.log_sleeping_planet_encounter_3: "You will not wake it. Leave now, and don't interfere!"
strings.log_sleeping_planet_encounter_4: "We won't allow you to hurt the Singularity!"
strings.log_sleeping_planet_encounter_5: The frequency of the sound intensifies. It is now almost unbearable.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_enter: The machine opens a passage to the dreaming world. The Singularity that the old guild put back to sleep is awake again.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_1: As they explore, strange patterns, resembling living animals, begin to flicker in rhythmic pulses.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_10: You have to find a way to free it. No one deserves its destiny.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_11: An enormous titan, sat behind an immense forge, stares down at the expedition.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_12: "And then, when death was abolished and defenses were lowered, the Serpent came to our skies. It always comes back. It came back for your Seer, too."
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_13: The Singularity lies in a valley ahead.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_14: Deprived of its dreams, the Singularity twitches erratically.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_15: The Singularity falls asleep once more. Far above, a shape in the sky turns away, still hungry.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_2: A deep rumbling echoes through the air. With each swell of sound, the visions grow more vivid.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_3: Drawn to the source of the sound, the expedition pushes forward.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_4: The images of three horses materialize before the adventurers.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_5: You have to help them. Their suffering is immeasurable
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_6: Baffled, the adventurers continue toward the sound.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_7: A different image materializes, this time of a giant flying beast.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_8: They escaped wars, poverty, suffering. The most powerful mages of this universe gave everything to become One.
strings.log_sleeping_planet_room_9: A swarm of incorporeal insects surrounds the expedition.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_encounter_1: A single entity stands in the middle of the room, almost as tall as the ceiling.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_encounter_2: Soldiers dressed in white and red garments are wandering aimlessly inside the room.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_encounter_3: Two hooded cultists were waiting in the room. They start muttering something in an unknown language.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_encounter_4: The construct wakes up, and effortlessly breaks its chains with supernatural strength.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_enter: The manor with the four metal coils still stands among the snow. Smoke now rises from its chimneys, and the coils glow red. Below it, the cult of the Herald has built a foundry.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_1: Two staircases lead to the upper floor, filled with snow and broken, old furniture.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_10: The next room is much bigger than the others, without any other doors and fully furnished. A dining table lies in the center, and three beds are placed against the left wall.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_10a: The next room is perfectly circular. In its center the Forged Titan stands in a pool of cooling metal, with no chains left to hold it.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_11: The foundry falls silent. Among the ashes lies a sealed order: "Send everything to the Second Ascent." The team starts the climb back to the surface.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_2: On the first floor, there seems to be nothing valuable or interesting.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_3: In a corner, near a frozen fireplace, the team notices a closed trapdoor. It opens without too much effort.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_4: A narrow flight of stairs leads in the depths of the building. After minutes of walking, the team emerge in a completely different setting.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_5: The adventurers finds themselves in a square room with four doors at the sides. The floor and walls are made of white marble.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_6a: The team chooses the door on the left, and find themselves in a square room identical to the previous.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_6b: The team chooses the door straight ahead, and find themselves in a square room identical to the previous.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_6c: The team chooses the door on the right, and find themselves in a square room identical to the previous.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_7: This room holds a workbench and a stack of forge logs, written in a neat hand.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_7a:
The log reads:

Casting n.1:
Material: the old Primordial chains, melted.
Result: failure, two lesser titans cast.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_7b:
The log reads:

Casting n.2:
Material: a pilgrim who came to the foundry seeking the Herald.
Result: failure, one lesser titan cast.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_7c:
The log reads:

Casting n.3:
Material: Varn's own apprentice, at her request.
Result: failure, one lesser titan cast. We should have waited.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_7d:
The log reads:

Casting n.4:
Material: a deserter from the Kingdom's army.
Result: success! The body merged with the Primordial. The Forged Titan stirs.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_7e:
The log reads:

Casting n.5:
Material: a guild scout, caught near the coils.
Result: failure, one lesser titan cast. The guilds are watching us.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_8: The team chooses one of the doors, and find themselves in a square room. It's empty, and there are only two other doors: one locked, bearing the symbol of a skull with red eyes, the other unlocked.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_9:
Without a way to open the locked door, the expedition chooses to advance through the unlocked one.
They find themselves in a square room, with three doors on the sides.
strings.log_the_cultist_rebels_room_9a: Noticing a resemblance between the symbol and the handle of the Skeleton Key, they try to see if it fits. It does! The door unlocks.
strings.log_the_desert_encounter_1: A shadow in the barren wastelands quickly raises the group attention.
strings.log_the_desert_encounter_2: The group is not alone. Few steps ahead, an enemy threat is ready to fight.
strings.log_the_desert_encounter_3: Unusual vibrations below your feet precede the fight that is going to take place.
strings.log_the_desert_encounter_4: Concealed by a dune, enemies were waiting for your arrival.
strings.log_the_desert_encounter_5: Screams pierce the stillness of the air, as the team is assaulted from ahead.
strings.log_the_desert_enter: Beyond the Elderwood lie the Sha'huri Dunes. The war with the Empire ended long ago, and the Sha'huri rebuilt their ancient defense system. It no longer asks who you are.
strings.log_the_desert_event_1a: Sha'huri deterrent system online. Outsider detected. Threat level: [%d/100]
strings.log_the_desert_event_1b: The dunes rise like a stormy sea. Sand soldiers form around you, rebuilt over centuries of silence. They stretch as far as the eye can see…
strings.log_the_desert_event_1c: The team bravely advances between the overwhelming horde.
strings.log_the_desert_event_1d: The ancient Sha'huri army attacks you with all its might.
strings.log_the_desert_event_1e: As suddenly as it rose, the endless army crumbles to dust, unrecognizable from the sand below your feet.
strings.log_the_desert_finding_1: The sky darkens suddenly, and a brief but powerful sandstorm overwhelms the adventurers team.
strings.log_the_desert_finding_2: Not much further, the team finds a rare desert oasis, full of palm trees and with a small pond of crystal clear water. They decide to rest for a while. Everyone recovered 10 HP and 10 Mana.
strings.log_the_desert_room_1: The sand drags below the adventurer's steps, in a landscape that hasn't changed for hours.
strings.log_the_desert_room_2: A small trail of footprints lies on the ground. It must be recent.
strings.log_the_desert_room_3: With the sun so high in the sky, every step is harder than the previous.
strings.log_the_desert_room_4: The adventurers keep going forward, with only the occasional cactus breaking the landscape's monotony.
strings.log_the_desert_room_5: Scorching winds caress the dunes ahead as the sand seems to dance atop of them.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_enter: Beneath the volcano lies the machine that the old guild left for King Roderic's researchers. The Herald reached it first.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_event_1: %s used %s, but no one answers the call.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_1: A faint light pierces the darkness ahead, suggesting the Core is near.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_2: Voices echo through the tunnels. One of them is Ysolde's, and she is not praying.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_3: The light grows brighter, intensifying along with the heat.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_4: The core is wide open. Purple light pours out of the machine, and the stars can be seen through it.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_5: Before the chasm, three Heralds guard the machine. The third is Ysolde, fused with its frame.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_6: The long battle has left the team exhausted, and barely alive. The machine goes dark.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_7: The door Ysolde tried to open stays closed. But beyond the stars, something has noticed the guild, and it is patient.
strings.log_the_dire_descent_room_8: The second cycle is over. The machine belongs to the Kingdom again, and it can open other doors. One day the master will try a third time.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_encounter_1: All around the team, the spirits of long forgotten warriors emerge from the mountain.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_encounter_2: From below the team's feet, ghastly arms are digging upwards.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_encounter_3: Knights with vitreous eyes advance towards the expedition.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_encounter_4: The unsteady ethereal blob around the team forms a few, definite hateful figures.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_encounter_5: The restless mountain materializes again in the form of long forgotten souls, forgotten for millennia.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_encounter_6: "You cowardly insects dare speak to me while i'm performing the holy ritual? Die, and nourish the Mountain!"
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_enter: Outside the Hollow Deep, a new mountain of souls has risen in the place of the old one. At its summit, the Seer Ysolde performs the ritual of the second cycle.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_1: The team takes a deep breath and begins the dreadful ascent.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_10: The Seer Ysolde opens her eyes and turns to face the adventurers. She does not look surprised.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_11: My predecessor was devoured because he waited for the end. I will not wait. Witness my true form!
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_12: The Graft is lost… but this cycle is not. Master, I will open the door another way.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_13: The purple pillar snaps and the mountain collapses. Two colossal maws descend from the stars and close on the summit, but they close on nothing. The Herald is gone. Far to the south, the ground begins to shake.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_2: The grotesque mass below, stretching endlessly into the ashen sky, provides an extremely unstable terrain.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_3: The adventurers feet plunge into undulating sea of spectral forms with every new step.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_4: The team presses through the swirling miasma of hate and resentment, forging a new path with only determination as their tool.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_5: The screams of agony around the group almost breaks the sanity of the climbers.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_6: In the distance, a colossal wraith formed from the amalgamation of countless souls watches the surrounding.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_7: The team hides for some minutes waiting for the gigantic threat to direct its gaze elsewhere.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_8: Ghastly appendages try to pull the explorers down into the throbbing mass at every occasion.
strings.log_the_dreadful_ascent_room_9: The expedition resumes, with the pillar on the summit now closer than ever.
strings.log_the_golden_city_encounter_1: After turning a corner, angry citizen attack the group.
strings.log_the_golden_city_encounter_2: From behind a granite statue, an armed group comes forward.
strings.log_the_golden_city_encounter_3: In front of the team, a mob with bloodshot eyes unsheathes its weapons.
strings.log_the_golden_city_encounter_4: A calm, albeit incomprehensible discourse turn into screams of blind rage as the team approaches its source.
strings.log_the_golden_city_encounter_5: The adventurers turn around, alerted by steps rushing from behind.
strings.log_the_golden_city_enter: The Gilded Capital rose again on the ruins of the old Golden City. Its new dynasty rebuilt the marble streets in gold, and in secret it worships the Eye that once drove the city mad.
strings.log_the_golden_city_event_1a:
Suddenly a dull, static rumble fills the air. You can feel the endless anger of the being above, as its eye widens and the inhabitants enter a delirious state.
Enemy damage is doubled for the duration.
strings.log_the_golden_city_event_1b: Finally the rumble stops. You can see a group of citizen nearby collapsing to the ground, exhausted.
strings.log_the_golden_city_finding_1:
You hear calls for help from a nearby basement. An old priest, who managed to hide before the fall of the city, asks you for some food. After fulfilling his request, he performs a healing spell to restore the team's energies.
Adventurers' HP are fully restored.
strings.log_the_golden_city_finding_2: The eye focuses on the Adventurers, drawing energy from them. This damage is magic, and reduced by Constitution.
strings.log_the_golden_city_finding_3: As a team member opens a door nearby, an iron wedge swings towards the group.
strings.log_the_golden_city_room_1: As the team is walking the marble streets, you hear a cracking sound from inside one of the houses. You enter to investigate.
strings.log_the_golden_city_room_2: Under the gaze of the monstrous eye in the sky, the explorers struggle to maintain their resolve.
strings.log_the_golden_city_room_3: The adventurers keep walking the city streets, among golden statues with intricate designs.
strings.log_the_golden_city_room_4: The screams permeating the air seem to be getting closer, as you advance through the marble streets stained with blood.
strings.log_the_golden_city_room_5: A citizen walks past, smiling at the sky and whispering prayers to the Eye above.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_1: The shadow, disturbed by the light, turns with a twitching movement.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_2: Suddenly, several miners are encircling the group.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_3: The hideous inhabitants of the temple immediately attack.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_4: More deformed creatures swarm the team.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_5: Following their leader's orders, the monstrous creatures attack.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_7a: The team is shaken by the most horrible roar they have ever heard.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_enter: Deep below the Hollow Deep lies the lake and the temple that a guild found a thousand years ago. The portal they could not close is still open, and the temple has grown into a city of the faithful.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_1: The expedition moves forward with caution. In the distance, the deep, haunting notes of an organ reverberate through the cavern, sending shivers down your spine. You can’t help but dread what might be hiding in the suffocating darkness.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_10: The team proceeds toward the altar at the end of the room. A tall figure, dressed in what seems like a mockery of a priest's attire, whispers rapidly in an unknown language.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_11: Behind the altar, a wooden door bearing strange symbols stands partially open. The team proceeds through it.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_12: The door leads to a long corridor, swallowed by total darkness like the rest of the temple.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_12a: One of the adventurers accidentally triggers a hidden pressure plate. A trapdoor opens beneath them, and they plummet several meters, landing hard on a stone pavement.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_13: The corridor opens into a vast hall. Hundreds of faithful kneel below the portal, which has grown wider than the hall itself.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_13a: Unable to climb back up, the team is forced to descends into the bowels of the temple through a spiral staircase.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_14: Beneath the portal, the black matter has gathered into a shape, larger than the one recorded in the old chronicles.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_14a: The descent lasts for minutes, then stretches into hours. The stairs appear to be carved from a single, endless stone block. The effort to create this passage must have required an unimaginable amount of resources.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_15: The Avatar is gone and the faithful scatter into the dark, but the portal burns on. From inside it, something old turns toward the light the way a door turns on its hinge.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_15a: The team continues descending the unchanging stairs, questioning whether there’s an end in sight. Such a deep passage couldn't have been built merely to expand the temple above, but to reach a specific, previously isolated destination.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_16a: As they wonder what awaits them at the bottom of the stairs, the adventurers' conversation is cut short by the sound of another set of footsteps growing closer.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_17a: Finally, the stairs open into a short corridor.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_18a: At the end of the corridor lies a vast, semi-spherical room. In the center, something that defies human comprehension is being fed the corpse of a massive beholder by obedient servants.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_19a: Shaken by the terrible monster they just vanquished, the team begins to climb the endless stairs towards the temple's entrance.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_2: Suddenly, torches reveal a hunched shadow looming over the water.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_3: These miners belong to an expedition lost a thousand years ago. They have not aged, and they have not stopped walking.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_4: After a moment, the sound of more footsteps splashing through the water echoes nearby.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_5: The sound of footsteps in the water now echoes from all directions. The expedition quickens its pace.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_6: A faint silhouette of a distant building appears ahead. The team sprints toward it, hoping to find shelter from the miners lurking in the shadows.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_7: As the building comes into clearer view, the team realizes it's an ancient temple. It's adorned with strange, unsettling decorations. The organ sounds appear to come from within.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_8: Without hesitation, the team forces open the heavy stone door and slams it shut behind them. The organ music abruptly stops.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_9: A door bursts open from a side of the main room.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_encounter_2: The slimes jump down from the trees, as the team prepares for the fight.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_encounter_3: Surrounded, the adventurers raise their weapons once again.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_encounter_4: With unnatural agility, it makes a higher leap and lands exactly in front of the team.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_enter: Deep within the Elderwood, a secluded path leads to an eerie pond. The water is too thick and too bright, and the forest around it is strangely quiet. Legends say a king once dissolved here.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_1: After removing the last remaining twigs obstructing the way, the team moves towards the pond to investigate.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_2: Almost invisible below the body of water, creatures unlike anything they've seen before swarm the expedition.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_3: Turning around, the team discovers that the trees around the pond are swarming with slimes, coming out of their hideouts to aid their companions.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_4: Without a break, the neverending stream of slimes keep coming out of the water and down from the trees.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_5: Thumping sounds make the leaves tremble. The slimes stop their assault and part, as if for a procession.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_6: An iridescent mass wearing a crown of hardened goo leaps towards the group. The court bows.
strings.log_the_slime_pond_room_7: The Slime Queen loses her shape and seeps into the ground, exactly where her predecessor did a thousand years ago. The court scatters. Something tells you this pond is not done.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_encounter_1: Silently, something descends from the branches above.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_encounter_2: In a nearby clearing surrounded by spikes, enemies are alerted by the team steps.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_encounter_3: With a swift knife strike, the team cuts a spike curtain that reveals the hostile creatures behind.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_encounter_4: Something is following the team. The escape is interrupted by a mass of brambles that would take too long to cut.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_encounter_5: Wild creatures crawl out from below the side of a collapsed path.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_enter: Since the second Graft broke, the earthquakes in the south have never stopped. The brambles of the Quaking Grove shake day and night, and the Primeval Wurm rises more often than ever. The Herald's trail leads straight through it.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_finding_1: A huge bramble mass, shaken by the constant earthquake, falls from the branches above.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_finding_2: The team notices a white haired Dryad sitting on a nearby branch, staring at them while whispering the formula of an unknown spell.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_1: The adventurers cut a thick branch full of spikes before proceeding to the next areas
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_10: The expedition carefully advance through a patch of shaking trees.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_2: Carefully enough, the expedition crosses a small muddy stream
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_3: The sound of cracking trees alert the team. It's probably a wise idea to head in the opposite directions.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_4: A thick curtain of dead branches blocks the path. The team has to find a way around it.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_5: A patch of trees in the distance suddenly falls, swallowed by the terrain below. The team hastens its pace.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_6: The expedition passes a huge tree growing around long dead remains, but you can't tell the species of the unfortunate victim.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_7: Around the corner, several cracked eggs as big as an average person lie on the ground.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_8: A natural bridge of brambles allows to safely cross a large, deep creek running through the forest.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_room_9: The constant earthquake increases for a moment, prompting the expedition to run away from the tallest trees.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_wurm_chase: A rumbling sound is quickly approaching. With an average dexterity of %d, it will reach the team in %d turns.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_wurm_spawn: The Primeval Wurm stands as tall as a mountain. It tries to devour the team with unexpected speed.
strings.log_the_southern_grove_wurm_trap: The ground below collapses into the maws of a colossal Wurm. Adventurers must get out of the way, and fast!
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_1: The first bearer of the curse, who doomed countless worlds to eternal hunger.
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_2: The mother of herself; a blasphemy against life, death, and causality.
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_3: A being of pure burning hatred, rejected by the Otherworld out of sheer fear.
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_4: Once thought to be a moon of the prosperous planet of Neferis. The inhabitants only had a couple minutes to acknowledge their mistake.
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_5: A benevolent god of enlighted people, subdued by the trickery of those hungry for power
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_6: A wound on this universe, barely contained but never healed. Eternal glory will come to its saviour, unending suffering to everything else.
strings.log_the_tower_encounter_7: A piece of art that sculpts itself, and you, and me, and everything else. Its downfall, the laws it forged to bind us.
strings.log_the_tower_enter: The machine lights up, and the molten core reveals a passage to the interior of a building. It is lavishly furnished and impeccably maintained, beyond the large window on the wall, the cold void of space stretches endlessly.
strings.log_the_tower_room_1: The puzzled adventurers look around, wondering how could this mansion be floating through space and what purpose it might serve.
strings.log_the_tower_room_11: A second door opens on the left wall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_12: A massive golden-feathered bird flies into the room.
strings.log_the_tower_room_13: A pile of dust is swept away by a sentient broom.
strings.log_the_tower_room_15: A third door opens on the left wall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_16: A knight clad into a black armor, missing its head, walks out.
strings.log_the_tower_room_17: An invisible force drags the unconscious knight back to its cell.
strings.log_the_tower_room_19: The first door on the right wall opens into an enormous chamber.
strings.log_the_tower_room_2: Suddenly, a disembodied voice breaks the silence.
strings.log_the_tower_room_20: "For… logistical reasons, I'll have to ask you to enter the cell yourselves this time."
strings.log_the_tower_room_21: The adventurers step in, discovering an enormous room with a sky-high ceiling.
strings.log_the_tower_room_22: In the darkness, an immense mass is stirring.
strings.log_the_tower_room_23: Victorious, the adventurers return to the main hall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_25: A fourth door opens on the left wall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_26: A man taller than average and with an extremely fit build walks into the main hall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_27: The man bows before you, as to acknowledge his defeat, and walks back to his cell.
strings.log_the_tower_room_29: Maintain your composure. What comes next would shake mortals and gods alike.
strings.log_the_tower_room_3: Welcome back, visitors, to the Tower. It has been a while.
strings.log_the_tower_room_30: A fifth door opens on the left wall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_31: A vision of pure terror drifts out of its cell. Darkness invades the hall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_32: The horror explodes into tiny shards. Once again, the animated broom sweeps them back into the cell.
strings.log_the_tower_room_34: A sixth door opens on the left wall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_35: A mountain of cogs and cables rolls out of the cell.
strings.log_the_tower_room_36: The machine explodes into a thousand pieces. After a few seconds, it rebuilds itself, and teleports back to its cell.
