strings.log_the_tower_room_37: Well done, Adventurers! The deeper vaults have not been emptied since your predecessors did it, a thousand years ago.
strings.log_the_tower_room_38: Some things have changed. The tenant of cell #6, for instance, has grown up considerably…
strings.log_the_tower_room_39: Tales will be written about this. I had a lot of fun, and I will keep the vaults ready for the next cycle.
strings.log_the_tower_room_4: "This place served as a cosmic prison for countless ages. As you may have guessed, it could not escape Yadalbaoth's corruption."
strings.log_the_tower_room_5: Each prisoner here is confined for a different reason—deceit, betrayal, the extermination of whole civilizations or, in some cases, as the victim of a cruel setup.
strings.log_the_tower_room_6: As per our rules, visitors may challenge them. I will now present your first opponent.
strings.log_the_tower_room_7: A heavy door opens on the left wall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_8: An elegant but otherwise unremarkable man enters the hall.
strings.log_the_tower_room_9: After being defeated, he silently returns to his cell.

strings.lore_10_body:
Year 0.
Another cycle is completed, my Master departs after having satiated its hunger for a hundred years. Hail great Yadalbaoth, my euphoria is endless!

Year +5
The preparation of this iteration is almost done. I picked a boy, whose family managed to survive in a network of tunnels under the Capital for 100 years, to be the next Great Emperor. They were ecstatic!
I will once again step into the shoes of the benevolent, eternal Seer, and guide the world into annihilation for my glorious master.

Year +200
The repopulation plan is going well, as always.
The Golden City is flourishing, and so are the realms in the south. I made sure everyone is reassured enough to never build large armies and wage wars, as more deaths now means less food for the Eternal.
One exception, as always, is the constant attacks from the Sha'huri: but, my Master told me, it's a fair price to pay for a taste of the spirit of the God in the pyramid. For aeons i tried to find a way to clear its memory, but to no avail. It HAS to tell the prophecy at every occasion, doesn't it?

Year +800.
Everything is going as planned. The war in the south is locked into an impasse, the people of the realms trust my directions blindly. Soon we shall meet again, Master.

Year + 1000.
The protocol is complete. I fled to the north to initiate the connection of the Astral Graft, to allow Him to manifest into this world.
The Emperor has been "enhanced" as an extra security measure, it's likely pointless but better be safe: those realms in the south sometimes send some late reinforcements to the party.
Now, the ritual shall commence.

Year -99.
The Astral Graft has been conjured, and not long ago Yadalbaoth manifested its presence. Everyone will soon be eager to offer their energy and life. The dead will come back to life, briefly, to give whatever essence remained attached to their rotten bones.
The Imperial Army generals caught on my plan eventually, but they will crash upon the Mountain of Souls, becoming additional soldiers for the next iteration. Isn't it ironic? An army fighting against thousands of its undead versions, only to lose and make it a stronger foe.
Oh, and i'm not worried about their fool's errand either: in the microscopic possibility that they succeed and kill me, my Master will simply send another of his apostles to perform the next ritual through the secret passage in the broken mantle. They literally cannot win!
But i digress. The feast has commenced, now i only need to focus and maintain the ritual for another 99 years. And then, a new iteration will take place, as always.
strings.lore_11_body:
Guild Master, i must write to you once more to request your aid.

In the south, in the barren wastelands over the Southern Grove, there are sightings of blinding lights coming from a fiery battle. We have no idea about what the source could be: the area is inhabited by a terrifying breed of armored beasts, but they usually stay within their territory.

We will send an ambassador to try to speak with any invading force down there and i will come back to you if they make it back alive, but in the mean time every guild who wishes to help will have to cross the Southern Grove and prepare a line of defense between us and the attackers.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_12_body:
I am happy to see the party you sent made it to the Barren Wastelands.

Our diplomatic delegation made it back. They saw a full blown war between the Wasteland's beasts and a breed of humanoid never seen before in all the realms. They spoke to one of the higher generals, who delivered a terrible news: our world has become the center of a cosmic war.

The enemy of Yadalbaoth, the Celestial Goddess, saw that her enemy briefly lost control over this world. He informed us that, while this cycle of corruption is stopped, the very core of this world is infected and another emissary like Kasimir will be sent here in 1000 years. Yadalbaoth draws its strength from the corrupted souls of the worlds he infects, therefore… the Celestial Army will try to eradicate all the life from our planet, so that it will be useless for the next cycles. Our wise elders believe that we have no way to oppose the invading army due to its sheer strength, but maybe we can close the portal inside the rotten core. This way, the Army of Light will have no more business here.

If you wish to help, you will have to cross the ongoing battle and head to the Gates of Hell. It's just a name, worry not: it's a hole in the ground leading to the depth of our world, hopefully going down all the way to the core.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_13_body:
I hope this letter, carried by avian messenger, reaches you, Guild Master. I have dispatched some of our finest soldiers via an alternative route to establish a camp near the Gates of Hell, though the journey may take several weeks.

In the meantime, I must deliver an urgent warning: while we remain uncertain whether anything resides beneath the Gates, our wizards have detected a strange disruption in the magical fields surrounding the entrance. We cannot determine if this is a natural phenomenon, but I urge you to exercise the utmost caution.

Most importantly, please move swiftly toward the core—the Celestial Army is advancing with ruthless speed.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_14_body:
Guild Master,

I write to share urgent developments. The Celestial Army has cleared the Barren Wasteland and is now visible to our sentinels at the Southern Grove’s edge. At their current pace, they will reach our Kingdom within two weeks.

On a brighter note, we’ve successfully established a camp near the Gates of Hell, improving supply lines and communication with your expedition. Analysis of the Nexus of Larox’s frequency patterns suggests they are constructing a weapon to combat the cyclical corruption of the upper realms. While their stance is hostile, we are confident they are not allied with the Black Serpent.

With this in mind, press onward into the caverns’ depths. We are certain the Portal is near.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_15_body:
I have dispatched our finest infiltrators through the City of Larox and the Forgotten Lands beneath the tunnels, hoping this missive reaches your valiant expedition.

The Army of Light have cleared the Southern Grove. Though their vanguard suffered heavy losses, their numbers are not faltering, with two soldiers seemingly replacing every one that falls. From our towers, we now see the banners of the Goddess of Light. At most, we have a few days before the cleansing of our homeland begins.

Guild Master, I implore your expedition to advance with haste and eliminate whatever entity, spell, or device sustains the link with the Black Serpent. Time is against us.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_16_body:
You arrived just in time, Guild Master! The Army of Light has begun its retreat, only hours before they would have reached our gates. A multitude of ships can be seen lifting off on the horizon, and we’re confident they’ll soon depart from the Barren Wastelands as well.

We also received your missive regarding the strange, intact device discovered beneath the volcano. I have dispatched our most knowledgeable researchers to study it further and uncover its purpose.

You can return home now and enjoy your well-earned rest. A grand parade is being prepared to welcome you and your fellow adventurers with all the honors you deserve.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_17_body:
Guild Master,

I write to inform you of the remarkable progress we have made in our research on the mysterious device you discovered. Our investigations have revealed that it was used by the three Harbingers to enter our world and establish yet another puppet regime in the Golden City, preparing the way for the next coming of the Serpent.

Thanks to the exceptional skill of our wizards, we have discovered a method to reverse the flow of essence within the device. In simpler terms, it can now be used to access other worlds ruled by Yaldabaoth that are linked to our own.

Though the immediate threat has passed, these worlds remain open for exploration. They may hold not only crucial insight into the nature of the Serpent’s curse, but also unimaginable power and wealth. Keep in mind thatyou will be able to send considerably larger expeditions, since the time constraints requiring a small, faster group are no longer present.

In recognition of your invaluable service to the kingdom, I hereby grant you unrestricted access to the device, along with the freedom to explore these realms as you see fit.

May your path be guided by wisdom and strength.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_1_body:
To all the law abiding citizens:

It is with great sadness i have to announce that the 1000 years old prophecy of the Sha'huri, ignored by some and ridiculed by many, came true ten days ago.

The eye of the Serpent is watching our world, and every day we are losing contact with more of our allies in the north. We are a small mercantile state, and our army is very limited, but our wealth is large. Therefore, the King will provide some land and basic structures to any of you willing to form an adventurer guild and embark on a quest to the Golden City.

Your mission is to find Kasimir, the immortal seer that served the emperor family for many generation and worked so hard to maintain peace across the Realms. He had been missing for almost a year, but we are sure he will find a solution.

We must succeed or, according to the prophecy, 100 years of darkness awaits us all.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_2_body:
So, the corruption already reached the Enchanted Forest. We may have less time than we thought.

What awaits you in your travel towards the north is a vast desert, home of the Sha'huri people. They are peaceful people, who worship an immortal god living in a giant pyramid, but no one outside the desert could confirm the existence of either.
The Sha'huri were adamant on preventing the coming of the Great Serpent, spreading the prophecy that everyone refused to believe, and for unknown reasons in the last thousand years they waged an unsuccessful war against the Golden City called The Eternal War.

We used to have trade deals in place, but since two months ago they cut all contacts and every ambassador we sent went missing and we fear they have fell victim to the Corruption.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_3_body:
I'm happy to see you made it through the desert, Guild Master.

In front of you lies the Eternal Battlefield, the place where the Eternal War took place. Both the Sha'huri and the Imperial armies were recalled when the eye appeared in the sky, so we expect it to be an uninhabited area. But be careful: it's speculated that living being aren't the only ones affected by the corruption. If it were the case…

You will need to cross these wretched lands, enter the Golden City and find out what happened to the immortal seer. The clock is ticking, and the time isn't on our side.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_4_body:
In front of you are the unhinged gates to the Empire's capital, now overrun by the corruption and decay. The eye is watching its inhabitants, draining them of their remaining sanity like a vulture gazing over its dying prey.

Our spies revealed that, despite the bulk of the imperial army traveling north some months ago to stop the cataclysm, loud noises are coming from the palace. We fear the seer didn't actually go missing, but was always kept prisoner inside for unknown reasons.

We have no time to lose: you must force your way to the imperial palace, so i can send a delegation to investigate it.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_5_body:
Out of the 30 soldiers sent to investigate the palace, only one survived. The seer isn't there, but something else is, and it reduced our soldiers to a pulp with an overwhelming strength. The survivor managed to hide in the Seer's chambers, and by sheer luck found a stash of hidden documents. These contain detailed instructions on how to perform a ritual. You guessed right: a ritual about summoning an eldritch god.

We do not know why a benevolent ally of our people would commit such a terrible act, but we have no time for a better assessment: in this moment, your mission is to go north, follow the trails of the imperial army and stop the Seer's ritual. We don't know if this will end the ritual, but we have to try.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_6_body:
I see you survived the fearsome pirates of Blackwater Port. Excellent!

You must now head North-East and cross the perilous Frostbite Peaks, where our sources say the Imperial Army traveled. Be careful though: these mountains are inhabited by Trolls, creatures with an incredible strength and resilience adapted to the extreme weather.

We also shed further light on the documents retrieved in the Seer's chambers: it seems the ritual has been performed every 1000 years since time immemorial, and the Black Serpent is summoned periodically to harvest the souls from this world.
The few survivors rebuild everything after its departure, and the world is ready to be consumed again in a thousand years, while the "prophecy" is dismissed in few generations.
Only the Sha'huri still believe it, because their immortal god survives being consumed at every iteration, and warns them of the danger.

If only we knew, we could have helped them win their Eternal War and stop Kasimir in time.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_7_body:
The destination is near, Guild Master. In a valley, between the mountains, lies the entrance to an abandoned cave where centuries ago precious obsidian used to be mined. The cave should run all the way below the mountains and emerge on the other side, where we will see what fate awaits us.

You must be very careful though: our historical records are incomplete, but at a certain point something from the depths scared the miner so much that, despite the incredible value obsidian presents for weapon manufacturing, the mines were left abandoned to this day.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_8_body:
The missing Imperial Army has been found. They came into contact with this… mass of spectral bodies, to give it a name. Trying to fight their way to the top they perished one by one, and became part of it as reanimated corpses, only increasing its size.
We can see a magic "tendril", lacking a better name, emanating from the summit into the dark clouds.
We believe Kasimir, the Seer, is up there performing the ritual that allows the presence of the evil Serpent, protected by the endless army below him.

You have to find a way to climb it, and end the ritual once and for all.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI
strings.lore_9_body:
Congratulation, Guild Master, to You and your brave Adventurers!

Kasimir is defeated, and the connection to the eldritch God is severed. It is still visible in the sky, but unable to feed on our energy. Our elder mages believe it will soon drift away in the distant space.
The effect of corruption, like a wound inflicted upon these realms, will persist for this generation but eventually die out with those afflicted, and its spread is to be considered halted.

Our elder mages are analyzing the diary found on the body of Kasimir, a copy of which you will find attached to this letter, to understand more of the nature of our defeated enemy. Your guild is one of the most powerful assets at the service of our kingdom, and you will surely be notified if we discover anything important.

Your loyal Sovereign,
King Roderic XXXI

strings.pet_beetle_description: A small, hard-shelled insect with sturdy legs and antennae. It scuttles with purpose, often gleaming in metallic colors.
strings.pet_crocodile_description: A massive, armored reptile with powerful jaws and a stealthy, low-slung body. It lurks in water, ready to launch explosive ambushes with a swift lunge.
strings.pet_dove_description: A gentle bird with soft feathers and a cooing call. It soars gracefully through the air, often seen as a symbol of peace and harmony.
strings.pet_eagle_description: A fierce bird of prey with sharp talons and keen vision. It flies high above, scanning for prey with intense focus, before diving with unmatched speed and precision.
strings.pet_floating_eye_description: A hovering orb of flesh, bristling with tendrils and stalks. Its gaze is unsettling, filled with cold, alien intelligence.
strings.pet_floating_seed_description: A small, round seed with a helix-like appendage. It just shuffles about, searching for fertile ground.
strings.pet_golem_description: A small, compact figure of dense stone and clay. Despite its size, it’s incredibly tough and unyielding, moving with steady purpose, driven by an inner force.
strings.pet_holy_tree_description: A small bonsai tree not taller than the average human. Despite its unassuming appearance, these trees belong to an almost extinct ancient species of sentient trees.
strings.pet_lizard_description: A small reptile with agile limbs and darting eyes. It scurries nimbly over rocks and through foliage, quick to flick its tongue and bask in the sun.
strings.pet_merge_body: Are you sure you want to merge %s into %s?
strings.pet_merge_description: By merging this pet, you will permanently lose it and transfer 80%% of its global Feed Power ( %d ) to another pet.
strings.pet_mosquito_description: A tiny, buzzing insect with needle-like mouthparts. It flits through the air with an annoying persistence, always seeking a warm-blooded host to siphon from.
strings.pet_owl_description: A nocturnal bird with large, forward-facing eyes and a round face. It glides silently on wide wings, its haunting hoot echoing through the darkness.
strings.pet_rat_description: A quick, wiry rodent with sharp teeth and twitching whiskers. It scurries in the shadows, scavenging for scraps and finding its way into the smallest crevices.
strings.pet_red_wolf_description: Rare wolf sometimes found roaming the forests looking for prey. It has a timid and elusive nature, but it's also extremely loyal.
strings.pet_rockling_description: A squat, rocky creature covered in jagged stone plates. It shuffles slowly, grinding against the earth, its mineral-rich body blending seamlessly with crags and boulders.
strings.pet_set_free_body: Are you sure you want to set free %s?
strings.pet_squirrel_description: A sleek, agile rodent with sharp claws and a bushy tail. It moves with a silent grace, watching its surroundings with a mix of curiosity and calculated intent. Loves to eat nuts.
strings.pet_tarantula_description: A large, hairy spider with eight watchful eyes and thick, bristling legs. It moves slowly and deliberately, ready to pounce or retreat into the shadows.
strings.pet_tentacle_tangle_description: A writhing, pulsating clump of rubbery tendrils, constantly coiling and twisting. It slithers with unsettling grace, its searching limbs probing for anything to grasp.
strings.pet_tesseract_description: A shimmering, geometric construct that defies conventional shapes. It twists in and out of itself, folding space in mind-bending ways, giving glimpses into other dimensions.
strings.pet_thing_from_the_abyss_description: A shadowy, amorphous entity with flickering, spectral limbs and piercing, formless eyes. Very small for the abyssal horrors standards, but it still radiates a cold dread.
strings.pet_tree_frog_description: A small, bright green amphibian with a powerful legs. Its sharp, resonant croak echoes through the forests, and it has a voracious appetite for anything it can swallow.
strings.pet_walking_bush_description: A dense, thorny shrub with rustling leaves that move on their own. It scuttles across the ground, roots writhing like legs, driven mostly by its curiosity.

strings.raids_help_body:
You unlocked your first Raid!

Raids are harder challenges similar to Dungeons, but with a few differences:

• Only one try per day. More can be purchased with gems.

• The allowed team size is a minimum of 5, but can be greater.

• Experience is not lost on death.

• On death or completion the team will automatically exit the Raid.

Tap on "Raids" at the bottom of the screen to see the unlocked raid!

strings.tutorial_2: These are your Guild's Headquarters, where you can view and upgrade your buildings. Right now, your small Quarters has only room for two. Head to the Tavern to recruit your first Adventurer!
strings.tutorial_3:
Well done. For the next step, tap on Dungeons at the bottom, and send your Footman to explore the Enchanted Forest.
Come back after he defeats that unusually angry wolf and collects its loot.
strings.tutorial_4: The wolf dropped something! Tap on the loot icon that appeared on the dungeon, then open the Workshop in your Headquarters, select Recipes in the lower left corner, craft a piece of Leather and collect it.
strings.tutorial_5: Good job! Here, take these Copper Ingots. Tap on Workshop and then Recipes: you can use them with your Leather to craft a new Copper Armor for your Footman.
strings.tutorial_6: Now, tap on Adventurers at the bottom. Select the central of the three Footman's slots, and equip the new Copper Armor.
strings.tutorial_7: Excellent! One last thing: a mage specialized in healing magic was sent in your aid from the Royal Army Reserve to help your guild get started. You should check in the tavern!

strings.weapon_dagger_banshee_dagger_description: Short knife build from a Banshee claw, which takes advantage of the very sharp edge to inflict tremendous damage.
strings.weapon_dagger_black_iron_dagger_descript: Knife made with the pirate's Black Iron.
strings.weapon_dagger_ceremonial_dagger_descript: A blade crafted for the ancient rituals of the mountain Trolls. While its combat effectiveness is far inferior to that of a simple dagger, a lingering spell imbued in the weapon grants it power in other, more mystical ways.
strings.weapon_dagger_corrupted_dagger_descripti: A dagger of fine making, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.
strings.weapon_dagger_crystal_dagger_description: With a blade derived from an original Frost Crystal, inflicts tremendous damage when striking vulnerable points.
strings.weapon_dagger_dryads_curse_description: With a resilient Dryad hair running upon its edge, this weapon can cut through defensive spells like an axe through butter.
strings.weapon_dagger_fang_dagger_description: A dagger made with a huge wolf fang in place of the blade.
strings.weapon_dagger_flying_reaper_description: This flying knife can be thrown to enemies, and recalled with a single gesture.
strings.weapon_dagger_frostmetal_dagger_descript: Dagger made with the coldest Frostmetal.
strings.weapon_dagger_fullmoon_dagger_descriptio: Dagger that uses the tooth of a wolf as a blade. However, this particular tooth seems to exhibit some weird properties.
strings.weapon_dagger_glass_knife_description: A sharp dagger with an edge made of glass.
strings.weapon_dagger_infernal_chakram_descripti: The razor-sharp edges of this circular weapon, expertly forged from Infernite, make it lethally effective against enemies at any range.
strings.weapon_dagger_infinite_despair_descripti: Grants a premature end to both the wielder and their enemies.
strings.weapon_dagger_mithril_dagger_description: An incredibly light and resistant dagger crafted from the legendary Mithril.
strings.weapon_dagger_mottiphobia_description: The blade of this dagger is colonized with small flying critters gathered from an ethereal dream. They will help the holder by swarming a random target, dealing a ranged attack with damage equal to the holder's HP.
strings.weapon_dagger_mutual_despair_description: Grants a swift demise in skilled hands, demanding a painful toll from its wielder in return.
strings.weapon_dagger_obsidian_dagger_descriptio: Extremely sharp weapon with a blade in Obsidian.
strings.weapon_dagger_orichalcum_dagger_descript: An extremely sharp blade crafted from an unbreakable metal from another world.
strings.weapon_dagger_ritual_blade_description: A dull blade, unfit for combat but designed for esoteric rituals to honor the mountain gods. Magically enhanced by the gems embedded in its handle, it grants its wielder healing powers.
strings.weapon_dagger_serpent_lunge_description: An eldritch artifact from another world. The holder blinks randomly between dimensions, making them difficult for enemies to target.
strings.weapon_dagger_shadow_dagger_description: A blade drawn by darkness, turns its owner into a dangerous night hunter.
strings.weapon_dagger_sickle_description: A farming tool used to cut and trim
strings.weapon_dagger_sylvan_mandate_description: Infused by divine light, this dagger embodies the will of the forest and grants its holder with the power to enact it.
strings.weapon_dagger_undead_knife_description: A dagger made with a long, sharpened undead rib.
strings.weapon_dagger_vampire_dagger_description: With an extremely sharp blade, has been enhanced to draw energy from wounded enemies.
strings.weapon_dagger_verdant_blade_description: An unusual dagger with a Spitfang tooth instead of a blade.
strings.weapon_staff_animated_staff_description: Staff made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
strings.weapon_staff_black_iron_scepter_descript: Crafted with the most popular iron variation among the pirates, this staff is well balanced and allows magic to flow within with little resistance.
strings.weapon_staff_cane_description: A wooden cane, without any magical properties.
strings.weapon_staff_corrupted_staff_description: A staff built by expert hands, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.
strings.weapon_staff_crimson_leech_description: Corrupted with an otherworldly force bound by an alchemist through forbidden rituals, grants the holder a fragment of the power of the Unholy Serpent.
strings.weapon_staff_crystal_staff_description: Built from the remains of an Ice Elemental, this superior staff has the additional property of making the holder resistant to harmful statuses.
strings.weapon_staff_cursed_scepter_description: A terrible instrument when wielded by the right hands, this unholy weapon will raise walking nightmares from defeated enemies.
strings.weapon_staff_death_ray_scepter_descripti: A staff relying on celestial technology that can focus its ray into a thin, but perfectly aimed ray that hits its target with unmatched precision. An unknown device, inorganic but capable of behaving as a living creature, has been integrated in the scepter's mechanism to unlock its true damaging potential.
strings.weapon_staff_dreamwrought_staff_descript: Ethereal staff made from an impossible metal, brought to reality by an otherworldly being.
strings.weapon_staff_dryads_blessing_description: An average staff when considering its offensive potential, this intricate weapon really shines in the hands of an experienced healer.
strings.weapon_staff_enchanted_staff_description: An ancient seed from an Ent makes this staff a bit attuned to the holder's magic.
strings.weapon_staff_focused_scepter_description: A magic staff built with an alien alloy, integrated with an organic construct able to focalize the energy released into a ray as thin as a hair. While not as powerful as many alternatives, this staff completely nullifies any dispersion of the caster's energy.
strings.weapon_staff_icicle_description:
Staff built around an ice magic generator, enhancing the holder's magic with the power of frost.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.weapon_staff_imperial_staff_description: A staff traditionally held by the powerful Imperial Mages, working with the Empire's army. Only the best pieces from the Golden City artisans make it to the battlefield.
strings.weapon_staff_molten_staff_description: A poorly contained fire magic engine allows mages to channel their powers through this staff, albeit inaccurately.
strings.weapon_staff_obsidian_scepter_descriptio: Perfectly balanced scepter sculpted from obsidian, offers minimal resistance to the owner's flow of magic.
strings.weapon_staff_panopticon_staff_descriptio: Aligned Beholder irises allows for the dispersion of light from the caster's spells to be focused with a constructive interference, producing a large amount of light.
strings.weapon_staff_serpent_staff_description:
An eldritch artifact from another world. Significantly impairs the holder's control over white magic, but confers a the buff "FRENZY" for 3 turns to every target hit.
FRENZY: This unit deals 30% increased damage.
strings.weapon_staff_staff_of_the_archmage_descr: Powerful staff used by Laroxian mages. Using their extensive magical knowledge, this staff energy source was bound with complex spells into a high-energy state. The crafting process is long and expensive, and they are held only by the most powerful wizards.
strings.weapon_staff_stellar_staff_description: Infused with the essence of a distant star, this staff burns hotter than any flame known to this world.
strings.weapon_staff_sun_staff_description: A fire artifact has been isolated into the staff's head, granting its wielder a better control on fire magic.
strings.weapon_staff_sylvan_blessing_description: The gift of light was bestowed upon this staff, granting it an exponentially higher power and ability to protect allies.
strings.weapon_staff_undead_staff_description: Made with undead remains, allows for some control over the flow of magic forces.
strings.weapon_staff_unstable_staff_description: Magic staff that draws its power from an arcane gem of unpredictable behaviour. The energy released will vary greatly without a known pattern.
strings.weapon_staff_vampire_scepter_description: Enhanced with a peculiar brew, empowers the holder's magic with the ability to return from the target as a healing force.
strings.weapon_staff_wicked_scepter_description: A horrible weapon instinctively repelling all living beings, though no one can explain the cause of this feeling. When the wielder summons a minion, this staff will summon a powerful accessory bound to it.
strings.weapon_staff_winterwood_staff_descriptio: The peculiar properties of the material allows for good magic attunement, making it a prized possession among spellcasters.
strings.weapon_sword_abyssal_cutlass_description: A variation of the typical Cutlass, forged using an enhanced metal to make it lighter.
strings.weapon_sword_aegis_description:
An ancient artifact of unknown origin, held by the heroes who wish to protect the weak. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.weapon_sword_aegis_mechanica_description:
Enhanced with mechanical parts taken by a mysterious, ancient creature. This unique artifact will change its shape by pressing a small trigger on its hilt, and is able to reach far away targets. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.weapon_sword_animated_sword_description: Sword made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
strings.weapon_sword_black_iron_cutlass_descript: A curved blade commonly wielded by Skull Island pirates.
strings.weapon_sword_celestial_mercy_description: A Celestial Sword imbued with a fluid typically used as fuel for advanced Celestial ships. When ignited, the fluid emits a bright light but does not harm the blade, thanks to the unique metal of its construction. Deals damage in a broader area, landing hits even when they should miss.
strings.weapon_sword_celestial_sword_description: Sword made from an alien alloy, with a durability above every known material.
strings.weapon_sword_colossal_sword_description: The sword of a colossal titan, too heavy to be held by a common human.
strings.weapon_sword_copper_sword_description: A standard iron sword commonly used throughout the Realms.
strings.weapon_sword_decomposed_limb_description: The rotting limb of an undead creature
strings.weapon_sword_dreadful_morningstar_descri:
A terrible weapon taken from a nightmarish knight. When the holder hits an enemy it has a chance to inflict TERRIFY on them.
TERRIFY: The unit skips its turn and takes 20% max hp as magic damage.
strings.weapon_sword_frostmetal_sword_descriptio: Thick, heavy sword made from the coldest Frostmetal.
strings.weapon_sword_ghastly_scimitar_descriptio: With a consciousness enhanced by undead spirits, this living sword reacts with heightened speed.
strings.weapon_sword_golden_sword_description: Superior swords issued to the Imperial Army infantry.
strings.weapon_sword_living_scimitar_description: A living weapon imbued with the spirit of a Djinn. Will sometimes act on its own, showing incredible mastery.
strings.weapon_sword_living_whip_description:
An unconventional weapon made with improvised materials, after careful research about the nature of the mysterious Dryad's hairs. Taunts enemies on hit for one turn, and has much greater range than the regular melee weapons.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
strings.weapon_sword_mithril_sword_description: An incredibly light and resistant sword crafted from the legendary Mithril.
strings.weapon_sword_obsidian_sword_description: A double edged sword made with the sharpest stone. Can inflict terrible wounds with one swing.
strings.weapon_sword_orichalcum_sword_descriptio: A large sword made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal from another world.
strings.weapon_sword_scimitar_description: Sword with a peculiar, recurve blade used by the Sha'huri people of the Desert.
strings.weapon_sword_serpent_bite_description: An eldritch artifact from another world. A tangible paradox allowing the holder to blend in more effectively with its surroundings, and allowing them to deal more damage the less they blend in.
strings.weapon_sword_serpent_jaws_description: The jaws of a slithering undead monster.
strings.weapon_sword_spade_description: A simple tool used for farming
strings.weapon_sword_undead_sword_description: A grim sword made with undead remains.
strings.weapon_sword_unholy_sword_description: Antithesis to all that is holy, will inflict damage to any enemy entering it's malevolent aura.
strings.weapon_sword_vampire_sword_description: An Obsidian Sword that gained the ability to draw energy from enemies, restoring the holder HP.
strings.weapon_sword_void_crusher_description: An enormous sword, so heavy that it can't be lifted by any human. Imbued with the power of darkness, it deals enormous damage.
strings.active_meteor_iii_description:
Deals 260% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for 2 turns.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_meteor_iv_description:
Deals 350% damage to all enemies and sets them ABLAZE for 3 turns.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_feint_ii_description:
Feigns a movement and strikes unexpectedly, dealing 125% damage and STUNNING an enemy for 1 turn.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_petrifying_melody_ii_description:
Plays a string of notes with his lute, dealing 130% damage and PETRIFYING an enemy for 1 turn.
Critical hit bonus damage × 1.5.
This ability is always ranged.

PETRIFY: This unit can't dodge, takes 15% increased damage and skips its turn.
strings.active_thousand_cuts_mid_description:
Stabs an enemy and applies a charges of BLEED for every 2.5 damage dealt.
Critical hit bonus damage × 3.

BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
strings.active_elemental_bolt_i_description:
Hurls a bolt of raw elements at an enemy for 200% damage, with 20% chance to FREEZE, STUN or set it ABLAZE for 1 turn.

FREEZE: this unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_elemental_bolt_ii_description:
Hurls a bolt of raw elements at an enemy for 230% damage, with 20% chance to FREEZE, STUN or set it ABLAZE for 1 turn.

FREEZE: this unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
strings.active_frost_nova_description:
Deals 210% damage to all enemies and FREEZES them for 2 turns.

FREEZE: this unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_blizzard_description:
Deals 260% damage to all enemies and FREEZES them for 3 turns.

FREEZE: this unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_chain_lightning_i_description:
Strikes 3 different enemies for 240% damage, with 20% chance to STUN each for 1 turn.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_chain_lightning_ii_description:
Strikes 4 different enemies for 300% damage, with 25% chance to STUN each for 1 turn.

STUN: the unit skips its turn. A stunned flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.
strings.active_tremor_description:
Deals 195% damage to all enemies, with 35% chance to PETRIFY each for 1 turn.

PETRIFY: This unit can't dodge, takes 15% increased damage and skips its turn.
strings.active_earthquake_description:
Deals 235% damage to all enemies, with 50% chance to PETRIFY each for 1 turn.

PETRIFY: This unit can't dodge, takes 15% increased damage and skips its turn.
strings.passive_shatter_i_description: Enemies FROZEN by this unit take 20% more damage from every source.
strings.passive_shatter_ii_description: Enemies FROZEN by this unit take 35% more damage from every source.
strings.passive_static_i_description: Basic attacks jump to a second random enemy for 35% damage.
strings.passive_static_ii_description: Basic attacks jump to a second random enemy for 50% damage.
strings.passive_stoneskin_i_description:
At the end of its turn, shields itself and the ally with the lowest shield for 4% of its max HP.
The amount shielded is affected by healing modifiers, and cannot exceed 20% max HP.
strings.passive_stoneskin_ii_description:
At the end of its turn, shields itself and the 2 allies with the lowest shield for 5% of its max HP.
The amount shielded is affected by healing modifiers, and cannot exceed 20% max HP.
strings.adventurer_elementalist_description: A student of the Laroxian schools who bends fire, frost and lightning alike, mastering none of them yet.
strings.adventurer_elemental_adept_description: Trained by the Wizards of Larox, this caster weaves the elements into a single, unstable bolt.
strings.adventurer_elemental_magus_description: A master of the raw elements, ready to devote the rest of a lifetime to one of them.
strings.adventurer_cryomancer_description: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.
strings.adventurer_frost_elder_description: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.
strings.adventurer_glacial_elder_description: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.
strings.adventurer_frost_sovereign_description: Winter itself answers this caster. Frozen enemies cannot dodge, fall from the sky and shatter under every blow.
strings.adventurer_stormcaller_description: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.
strings.adventurer_thunder_elder_description: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.
strings.adventurer_tempest_elder_description: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.
strings.adventurer_storm_sovereign_description: Lightning leaps from one foe to the next at this caster's command, leaving the survivors stunned.
strings.adventurer_geomancer_description: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.
strings.adventurer_stone_elder_description: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.
strings.adventurer_mountain_elder_description: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.
strings.adventurer_earth_sovereign_description: A caster as sturdy as the mountains, shielding allies with stone while the ground swallows the enemy.
strings.weapon_sword_shahuri_spear_description: A long desert spear with a leaf-shaped blade. Sha'huri riders use its reach to strike the vultures circling the dunes.
strings.weapon_dagger_boomerang_description: A curved throwing stick of polished wood. It hits what flies and comes back to the hand that threw it.
strings.adventurer_zephyr_saint_description: A wandering archer who sings the wind into every volley. Each song shields the two most exposed allies and exalts them, trading a little accuracy for a hymn that keeps the line standing.
strings.enemy_wolf_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this wolf. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A wild wolf living in the forest. They can hunt alone or in packs.
strings.enemy_boar_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this boar. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Wild boars are omnivorous animals commonly found in the forest. They can be hard to kill due to their thick skin.
strings.enemy_treant_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this treant. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. These living trees of medium dimensions used to be kind and caring towards wild creatures and travelers alike.
strings.enemy_centaur_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this centaur. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Half men and half horses, these magical creatures are skilled hunters that used to live in harmony within the forest.
strings.enemy_shahuri_warrior_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sha'huri warrior. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Fearsome warrior of the Sha'huri tribe, he executes the orders of the desert god.
strings.enemy_shahuri_archer_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sha'huri archer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Skilled archer of the Sha'huri tribe, he offers ranged support for ground troops. They wield special bows able to disrupt enemy actions.
strings.enemy_shahuri_mage_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sha'huri mage. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Gifted with a fragment of their god's magic, they can manipulate the desert sand to encapsulate and crush their enemies.
strings.enemy_wurm_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this wurm. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Worm-like creatures with razor sharp teeth that dwell in the desert. They usually attack from below, and can draw energy from the flesh of their preys.
strings.enemy_sand_vulture_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this sand vulture. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Birds of prey that scavenge on carrion. Not very dangerous alone, but ranged units are required to take them down.
strings.enemy_undead_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this undead. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The corpse of a fallen infantry soldier, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_undead_archer_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this undead archer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The corpse of a fallen archer, reanimated by the corruption. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_death_hound_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this death hound. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A war hound employed by the Imperial Army, reanimated by the corruption after falling in battle. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_undead_warlord_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this undead warlord. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. This undead was likely a skilled commander, visibly stronger than the normal undead and clad in a spiked armor that hurts attackers. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_ghoul_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this ghoul. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. For unknown reasons, sometimes undead are animated by a strong urge to feed on other dead bodies. These creatures often develop a more feral appearance, with longer teeth and sharper nails, and after some time they lose all of their similarity with human beings. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
strings.enemy_city_warden_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this city warden. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A law enforcement unit operating in the Capital. They are not part of the Imperial Army, and their responsibility is to maintain order and catch criminals.
strings.enemy_insane_citizen_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this insane citizen. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A citizen of the Empire Capital, who lived among luxury and wealth, never knowing any real hardship. The eye's appearance stole their sanity, and now they wander the streets in a feral state.
strings.enemy_insane_priest_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this insane priest. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A priest of one of the many places of worship in the city, used to offer guidance to the poor and the miserables. His strong faith granted him healing powers, that remained even after the loss of his sanity.
strings.enemy_imperial_guard_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this imperial guard. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A member of a special division of the Imperial Army appointed to the defense of the Imperial Palace and the many decentralized Imperial institutions. They are experts at protecting vulnerable targets, and can be formidable opponents even in their unhinged state.
strings.enemy_arcane_assassin_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this arcane assassin. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The Arcane Assassins were a special operation group under direct command of the Seer, Kasimir, employed across the realms to take out targets that aimed to deteriorate the fragile peace among the various factions. They wield magical daggers gifted by the Seer, whose origin is a mystery.
strings.enemy_imperial_mage_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this imperial mage. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Strategically crucial in every Imperial Army division, these highly trained mages conjure thunders above the enemy ranks, dealing substantial damage and disrupting their strategy.
strings.enemy_pirate_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this pirate. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The most common member of a pirate ship crew, Skull Island pirates are feared all over the realms. Trained in the use of the Cutlass, a traditional piratesque sword, they also have access to an exclusive technology capable of shooting iron projectiles with incredible force.
strings.enemy_deckhand_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this deckhand. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A capuchin colored monkey commonly found in the exotic Skull Island, home of the pirates. It has been trained to perform the lowliest duties of a pirate crew, like cleaning the decks and bringing the rum. It has also been trained in using the knife, and is a surprisingly strong adversary.
strings.enemy_pirate_lieutenant_blight_descripti: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this pirate lieutenant. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Higher in the Skull Island pirate's hierarchy than the regular pirate, this seasoned lieutenant commands small crews in their plunders.
strings.enemy_troll_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The very existence of these creatures baffled lore experts from around the Realms for centuries. They live in small sized tribes and conduct a primitive lifestyle based mainly on hunting. Their natural strength is unparalleled, and killing even one of them is a difficult feat.
strings.enemy_troll_whelp_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll whelp. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A young troll, not as dangerous as it's older peers, but already presents the defining features of their species, such as enhanced regeneration and a very hard skin.
strings.enemy_troll_warrior_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll warrior. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. In the hierarchy of trolls, these individuals are assigned to the protection of the troll's hunting grounds from external forces. They are usually the strongest trolls of the pack, wielding a huge hammer as a weapon and striking fear into the hearts of explorers unlucky enough to have a close encounter with them
strings.enemy_troll_shaman_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this troll shaman. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. These trolls manifest some kind of healing power, different from the traditional white magic used by clerics but very effective in keeping their peers alive. Along with the troll's natural regenerative capabilities, killing a troll while they are alive is a difficult task.
strings.enemy_giant_spider_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this giant spider. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. This kind of spider is usually found in much smaller sizes around the northern kingdoms. Left undisturbed for decades in the darkness of the Obsidian Mines, it reached the size of a grown man.
strings.enemy_vampire_bat_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this vampire bat. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An extremely agile creature, it flies above its preys striking at the first opportunity, drawing their blood to restore its energy.
strings.enemy_obsidian_golem_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this obsidian golem. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Animated by unknown forces, this massive obsidian creature is impervious to any magic damage thanks to this element's properties. While hard to take down without a strategy, the massive size hinders it's offensive capabilities.
strings.enemy_beholder_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this beholder. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Extremely smart but evil creatures only found in the depth of the earth, beholder will smite their opponents with their eldritch powers.
strings.enemy_green_spitfang_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this green spitfang. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Large snake found in the southern regions that hunts by hurling saliva at its enemies at tremendous speed.
strings.enemy_giant_moth_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this giant moth. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Flies thanks to a magic powder that covers its wings. This powder is known to irritate the airways of many other creatures, including humans.
strings.enemy_giant_tortoise_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this giant tortoise. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A huge tortoise weighting several tons, with a very hard shell covered in sharp spikes.
strings.enemy_dryad_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this dryad. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Elusive magical creature found in the southern woods. Its origin is unknown, but the travelers that spotted it before the corruption struck reported a timid but kind temperament.
strings.enemy_iconoclast_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this iconoclast. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Slaves to the Celestial Goddess, abducted from the worlds she destroyed. Their bodies are modified to allow them to live through raging flames, and their mission is to cleanse the lands designated for the Cleansing.
strings.enemy_oculus_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this oculus. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Flying organic-machine hybrid used to map terrain, find enemy locations and generally gathering information on the battlefield. Equipped with a small but powerful magic cannon that allows, through unknown technology, to replicate a destructive spell usually casted by mages through their rituals.
strings.enemy_celestial_lancer_blight_descriptio: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this celestial lancer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. The backbone of the Celestial Army. These fearless soldiers push through foreign worlds animated by unwavering loyalty, counting on a supernatural agility despite their large size.
strings.enemy_banshee_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this banshee. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A terrifying breed of armored beasts that roam the Barren Wastelands. Due to their presence, this area was uninhabited since the beginning of recorder history, but fortunately they keep to their hunting grounds.
strings.enemy_magic_armor_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this magic armor. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Armor crafted from a unique metal and brought to life through a blend of technology and magic. The city is teeming with these constructs, ever vigilant and prepared to fend off any potential invasion.
strings.enemy_imp_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this imp. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A small, winged servant of the Wizards of Larox, summoned through magic and lacking any will of its own. It is typically used for simple tasks but can also assist in defending the city when needed.
strings.enemy_wizard_of_larox_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this wizard of larox. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A gifted mage, made even more powerful through the endless knowledge of the Laroxians.
strings.enemy_nexus_researcher_blight_descriptio: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this nexus researcher. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Lacking any magical power themselves, they work together to complete the Nexus of Larox and to discover new types of spells.
strings.enemy_berserker_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this berserker. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An ancient warrior armed with twin mithril axes, his fury intensifies with every blow he endures, turning him into an unstoppable force as the battle rages on.
strings.enemy_pterodactyl_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this pterodactyl. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A massive, flying living fossil from the dawn of this world. Remarkably strong, yet astonishingly agile in the air.
strings.enemy_stone_shaman_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this stone shaman. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A mystic wielding a unique form of magic derived from stones unlike anything found on the surface. These stones allow them to command wild beasts with ease and grant them some healing powers.
strings.enemy_terrorsaurus_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this terrorsaurus. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An immense, heavily armored dinosaur—slow-moving but with razor-sharp teeth. It can endure staggering amounts of damage before finally succumbing.
strings.enemy_amanita_obscura_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this amanita obscura. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Purple fungus with white grains. Its flesh contains a paralyzing agent capable of halting respiratory functions in nearly every living creature. It moves slowly but with a rhythmic pattern, hinting at a form of sentience.
strings.enemy_bleak_disciple_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this bleak disciple. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. This humanoid of unknown origin, warped beyond recognition, has dwelled beneath these caverns for millennia. It toils ceaselessly to bring its long-forgotten god back into existence.
strings.enemy_eldritch_hound_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this eldritch hound. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. These twisted, wolf-like creatures relentlessly hunt any creature that dares to approach the underground temple.
strings.enemy_necrobot_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this necrobot. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A soldier resurrected not by magic but through unknown technology, bound to carry out the commands of its masters.
strings.enemy_enforcer_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this enforcer. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A warrior grotesquely altered through agonizing experiments, gifted with immense strength and a towering size.
strings.enemy_phantasm_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this phantasm. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. Almost imperceptible to the naked eye, this extremely fast assassin will meet unprepared victims with a tremendous fate.
strings.enemy_cerebrum_blight_description: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this cerebrum. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A sentient brain encased in nearly indestructible glass. It cannot move, but can manipulate the surrounding world in other ways.
strings.enemy_dreamwrought_beast_blight_descript: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this dreamwrought beast. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An incorporeal creature resembling a horse, with a single horn on its forehead.
strings.enemy_dreamwrought_swarm_blight_descript: The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this dreamwrought swarm. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. An endless multitude of spectral, ravenous insects that tear their prey apart in seconds.
strings.enemy_crusader_blight_description:
The Blight seeping through the land has twisted this crusader. It fights like its kin, but its colours have run and its eyes look somewhere else. Whatever it carries is fouled by the Blight and falls to pieces when touched. A member of one of the many crusades from the eastern cities to eradicate the evil that has been abducting their citizen. They wander the halls aimlessly, having lost their ego over time to the magical influences.
People from these lands seem to naturally display psyonic capabilities, and could present a formidable menace in large numbers.
strings.enemy_breach_keeper_description: What has held the Endless Portal open for a thousand years. It is not the portal, only its doorkeeper, and it has never once let anything pass in the other direction.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_encounter_8: The portal exhales. The thing that has held it open for a thousand years steps out to meet the team.
strings.log_the_lost_expedition_room_16: The Breach Keeper falls, and the portal narrows to a thread, then to nothing. The black water goes still. The temple is not silent, though; somewhere below, the chanting starts again, patient as ever. The team leaves.

LORE_MASTER.name: Lore Master
LORE_MASTER.desc: Accessories grant double HP, Constitution, Dexterity, Intelligence.

SERVUS_UMBRAE.name: Servus Umbrae
SERVUS_UMBRAE.desc: Increase damage by %s per point of Darkness.

NECROSIS_PORPHYRICA.name: Necrosis Porphyrica
NECROSIS_PORPHYRICA.desc: Ignores %s of extra damage from critical hits.

GENUS_VAMPYRI.name: Genus Vampyri
GENUS_VAMPYRI.desc: Lifesteal can overheal, granting a shield of up to %s the max HP value.

CHILLING_FLOW.name: Chilling Flow
CHILLING_FLOW.desc:
%s FREEZE for 1 turn on hit.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn. A frozen flying unit falls and can be hit in melee.

MIND_BENDER.name: Mind Bender
MIND_BENDER.desc: %s to ignore status immunities when applying Status Effects.

STAR_GAZE.name: Star Gaze
STAR_GAZE.desc:
%s PETRIFY for 1 turn on hit.
PETRIFY: This unit can't dodge, takes 15%% increased damage and skips its turn.

ARCANE_SUPPRESSION.name: Arcane Suppression
ARCANE_SUPPRESSION.desc: Deal %s magical damage per turn for each negative Status Effect inflicted by this unit.

TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE.name: Tactical Knowledge
TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE.desc: Ignores %s of target's Defense and Magic Defense.

BEAT_THE_ODDS.name: Beat the Odds
BEAT_THE_ODDS.desc: Rolls three times for damage and uses the best result.

FALSE_LIFE.name: False Life
FALSE_LIFE.desc: After each turn, %s chance to gain the Status False Life. The next time the unit would receive damage, it takes none and this effect is removed.

TRUE_AGONY.name: True Agony
TRUE_AGONY.desc: When False Life is removed by an enemy, deals %s damage to them as retaliation (magical).

MIRROR_OF_ANGUISH.name: Mirror of Anguish
MIRROR_OF_ANGUISH.desc: Gains Retaliate (Physical) equal to Defense, and Retaliate (Magical) equal to Magic Defense.

LIGHTNING_SPEED.name: Lightning Speed
LIGHTNING_SPEED.desc: %s chance to perform an additional attack at the end of the turn.

DIVINE_INTERVENTION.name: Divine Intervention
DIVINE_INTERVENTION.desc: Healing abilities that target all allies have an increased %s chance (additive) of reviving them.

OVERHEAL.name: Overheal
OVERHEAL.desc: If the target is healed beyond their maximum HP, a shield is applied, capped at %s HP.

HEALING_NOVA.name: Healing Nova
HEALING_NOVA.desc: On every enemy death, heal every ally by %s of their missing health.

DoctrineOfAffliction.name: Doctrine of Affliction
DoctrineOfAffliction.desc: Followers of this doctrine believe that suffering is synonymous with strength. They willingly inject themselves with an unknown pathogen that brings unrelenting agony and an insatiable thirst for blood. Over time, they have adapted to endure—and even revel in—the torment of their decaying flesh.

DoctrineOfControl.name: Doctrine of Control
DoctrineOfControl.desc: Adherents of the Doctrine of Control seek absolute dominance over themselves and others. They refine techniques to manipulate their enemies by commanding the elements and wield powerful abilities that grant them access to even the most guarded minds.
DoctrineOfControl.short: Status Effects and Status Effects resistance.

DoctrineOfFortitude.name: Doctrine of Fortitude
DoctrineOfFortitude.desc: Adherents of the Doctrine of Fortitude regard resilience as the ultimate virtue. They subject their bodies to relentless physical trials, pushing themselves to the brink of destruction and beyond. Through sheer determination and unyielding discipline, they transform pain and exhaustion into unshakable strength, forging a will as unbreakable as steel.

DoctrineOfGrace.name: Doctrine of Grace
DoctrineOfGrace.desc: Followers of the Doctrine of Grace are devoted to aiding the injured and the afflicted. They reject violence as a path to power, dedicating themselves instead to alleviating pain and suffering and bringing comfort to those around them.

DoctrineOfIllusion.name: Doctrine of Illusion
DoctrineOfIllusion.desc: Adherents of the Doctrine of Illusion devote themselves to mastering the art of deception. They see reality as malleable, shaped not by truth but by perception. To them, control over one's subjective judgment is the key to true power.

DoctrineOfKnowledge.name: Doctrine of Knowledge
DoctrineOfKnowledge.desc: Followers of this doctrine are jack-of-all-trades, seeking to gain expertise in as many fields as possible. They believe that true power lies in the pursuit of pure knowledge, with its practical application being a secondary—though undeniably valuable—tool.

DoctrineOfRuin.name: Doctrine of Ruin
DoctrineOfRuin.desc: "Attack is the best defense" is the creed of those who follow the Doctrine of Ruin. They swiftly unleash the full potential of their destructive power, paying little to no regards to their own safety.
DoctrineOfRuin.short: Damage at the expense of safety.

DoctrineOfWar.name: Doctrine of War
DoctrineOfWar.desc: Adherents of the Doctrine of War revere conflict as the ultimate crucible for growth and dominance. They dedicate their lives to mastering the art of combat, honing their bodies into lethal weapons. For them, battle is not just a means to an end but a sacred pursuit where strength, strategy, and unrelenting willpower define one's worth.
